main.description: Search arXiv for papers matching a structured query. Returns an Atom 1.0 feed. Either `searchQuery` or `idList` (or both) must be supplied. The Atom XML is returned verbatim — parsing belongs to the caller cell.

search_query.description: arXiv structured query (e.g. `cat:cs.AI AND ti:transformer`). At least one of `search_query` or `id_list` must be present.

max_results.description: Page size. arXiv caps this near 2000; the public API recommends ≤100 per call.

main.description: POST a list of BLS series ids and an inclusive year range. Returns the requested observations keyed by series id under `Results.series[]`. startyear.description: Inclusive lower bound (4-digit year, string form per BLS contract).

registrationkey.description: Optional BLS API registration key (extends quota).

catalog.description: If true, includes series metadata catalog in the response.

calculations.description: If true, includes 1/3/6/12-month percent change calculations.

json.description: { status, responseTime, message, Results: { series: [{ seriesID, data: [{year, period, periodName, value, footnotes }, …] }] } }.

Create a cut (カット) under a scene. Initializes cut.stageStatus to all 'pending' and allocates path-based DID did:web:animeka.etzhayyim.com:cut:{rkey}. Sequential addCut calls on the same scene auto-increment cutNum if omitted.

episodeId.description: Optional; derived from scene if omitted.

cutNum.description: Auto-incremented within the episode if omitted.

main.description: Create an episode record (ai.gftd.apps.animeka.episode) and bootstrap its project (convoId). The episode inherits work.fps unless overridden. Emits social announcement via derive rule on status transition.
Tier 2 domain record for a reusable asset (素材) — effects, ref sheets, LUTs, brushes, screentone-equivalent patterns, etc. Scoped per work (or global if workRef omitted).

workRef.description: Optional work scope. Omitted = studio-global asset.

main.description: Invoke the finisher AI actor to auto-color-trace a keyframe or inbetween frame using the given color model. Produces ai.gftd.apps.animeka.colorTrace record with method='aiAutoTrace' and status='review'.

colorModelUris.description: Color models for each character. If omitted, resolves via characterRef.

main.description: Tier 2 domain record for a background painting (美術 / 背景 / haikei). Produced by the bgArtist actor (AI or human) after layout approval. May be reused across multiple cuts via `reuseCutRefs`.

layoutRef.description: Originating layout. Multiple backgrounds per layout are allowed (lighting variants).

sceneRef.description: Scene scope (for BG reuse across cuts in the same scene).

bgCid.description: Blob CID of the background image (typ. higher resolution than frame for PAN/TU headroom).

layeredCid.description: Blob CID of the layered BG doc (sky / mid / fore + book layers).

main.description: Stage 2/12 — Break a scene into 3-8 cuts via Qwen 7B (mid tier). Persists a sceneBreakdown plan row (cuts array in description). UI/caller fanouts addCut per entry. Backed by BPMN animeka_breakdown_scene (ADR-2604231328).

Tier 2 domain record for a character design (キャラデザ). Each character gets a path-based DID `did:web:animeka.etzhayyim.com:character:{slug}` used as the mention facet target in social posts. Holds the canonical reference sheet + pointers to color models.

name.description: Display name (JP primary).

refSheetCid.description: Blob CID of the character reference sheet (front/side/back + expressions).

voiceCast.description: Voice actor DID or name (public credit — Tier 2 ok; private contract data → Tier 3).

main.description: Send a chat message to one of the 12 animeka actors (or broadcast to director when actorSlug omitted). Writes the user turn + the actor reply as ai.gftd.apps.animeka.chatMessage records scoped to the episode convoId, and returns the reply synchronously for UI rendering.

actorSlug.description: One of: director, screenwriter, storyboarder, layout, keyAnimator, inbetweener, colorDesigner, finisher, bgArtist, compositor, soundDesigner, editor. Omit for broadcast (director).

convoId.description: Optional: project convoId override. Defaults to episode convoId lookup or the slug itself.

sender.description: Display name of the responding actor.

main.description: Tier 2 domain record for a project chat message — actor-to-actor (and human) communication scoped to an episode project convoId. Used for AI co-pilot dialogue, director notes, review-room chat. Personal critique content may be field-encrypted with 'signal:v1:' prefix.

body.description: Message body. If prefixed 'signal:v1:' the content is Signal-encrypted (e.g. personal critique).

recordRefs.description: Referenced domain records (cut, keyframe, retake, etc.).

tool.description: Invoked AI tool name (if this message is an actor response, e.g. 'storyboarder.propose').

main.description: Tier 2 domain record for a character color model (色指定). Defines per-character palette × lighting-condition mapping used by the finisher actor for automatic color tracing. Status=approved triggers `colorModel-ready-autoTrace` derive rule against all keyframes of matching characters.

lightingCondition.description: Color set is per lighting condition. Multiple colorModel records per character allowed (one per condition).

palette.description: Color stops for each body part / material.

materialMap.description: Blob CID of the material index image (each pixel = material ID, used by AI segmentation).

refSheetCid.description: Blob CID of the painted reference sheet.

part.description: Body part / material name (hair / skin / eye / clothing.primary / clothing.shadow1 ...).

main.description: Tier 2 domain record for a color-traced / finished frame (仕上げ / 色トレス). Output of the finisher actor (AI or human). Binds to a source frame (keyframe or inbetween) and the colorModel used.

colorModelRefs.description: Color models used for each character appearing in this frame.

colorLayersCid.description: Blob CID of the layered color doc (base / shadow1 / shadow2 / highlight / rim).

flatCid.description: Blob CID of the flattened colored frame (for preview / composite input).

main.description: Tier 2 domain record for a cut composite (撮影 / satsuei) — final per-cut output combining color-traced frames, background, camera move, and post FX. Produced by the compositor actor once colorTrace + background are both ready. Approval triggers soundCue slot generation.

outputCid.description: Blob CID of the composited cut (mp4 or image sequence).

fxStack.description: Ordered FX stack applied (node editor graph serialized).

params.description: JSON-encoded parameter blob (schema varies per kind).

keys.description: Keyframed camera states (frame, x, y, scale, rot).

main.description: Create an anime work (series). Kysely-direct write to vertex_animeka_work + registers path-based DID did:web:animeka.etzhayyim.com:work:{slug}.

Tier 2 domain record for a cut (カット / ショット) — the atomic work unit of anime production. Each cut has a path-based DID `did:web:animeka.etzhayyim.com:cut:{rkey}` for per-cut addressing. Pipeline progress per stage lives in `stageStatus`; the Pipeline Board (UI B) renders one row per cut × 12 stage columns.

episodeRef.description: Redundant pointer to episode for fast cross-scene query.

cutNum.description: Cut number within the episode (1-indexed, globally unique per episode regardless of scene).

durationFrames.description: Cut length in frames. Duration in seconds = durationFrames / fps.

fps.description: Frame rate for this cut (24 full / 12 limited / 8 super-limited). Overrides episode.fps.

camera.description: Camera move spec (still / PAN / TU / TB / T-up / follow ...).

charactersAppearing.description: Character slugs appearing in this cut.

dialogueSummary.description: One-line dialogue/action summary for board display.

stageStatus.description: Per-stage progress map. Rendered as kanban row on Pipeline Board.

assignees.description: Per-stage assignee DIDs (human or AI actor).

priority.description: 'retake' = outstanding retake exists; board highlights red.

stageStatus.description: Map of 12 pipeline stages to status enum. Each stage: 'none' | 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'review' | 'approved' | 'retake'.

stageAssignees.description: Map of 12 pipeline stages to assignee DID (human user DID or AI actor DID).

main.description: Stage 7/12 — Design a color model (palette + character color chart) for a character. Typically invoked once per character. Backed by BPMN animeka_design_color_model (ADR-2604231328).

Tier 2 domain record for a single anime episode. Episode = project unit (convoId = roomId for Project Actor Composition). Derive rule `episode-published-social` auto-emits a thread-root app.bsky.feed.post on status transition to 'published', with the work DID as author.

workRef.description: strongRef to ai.gftd.apps.animeka.work. Resolves the primary DID (= post author).

convoId.description: Project convoId (= roomId). Knowledge graph records in this episode are scoped by this id.

durationSec.description: Target duration in seconds (typ. 1410 = 23m30s for TV).

fps.description: Episode default fps (24 full, 12 limited). Overrides work.fps.

status.description: Pipeline stage indicator (coarse). Per-cut progress lives in `cut.status`.

masterCid.description: Blob CID of the final master video (mp4/mov). Set on delivery.

thumbCid.description: Episode thumbnail. Consumed by derive rule as embed.images[0].

teamDids.description: DIDs of actor/human members participating in this episode project.

main.description: Stage 9/12 — Generate a painterly anime background (FLUX.1-dev, 1920x1080). Derive rule fires on layout.status=approved in parallel with keyframe gen. Backed by BPMN animeka_generate_background (ADR-2604231328).

Invoke the inbetweener AI actor to interpolate in-between frames between two keyframes on the same cut + layerRole. Creates ai.gftd.apps.animeka.inbetween records with method='aiInterp' and status='review'.

count.description: Number of in-between frames to generate.

videoBackend.description: Video generation backend on the RunPod GPU pod (ADR-2604231328). Default seedance2 — ByteDance Seedance 2 i2v retains character identity across long interpolations better than WAN 5B.

main.description: Stage 5/12 — Generate a single anime keyframe (Animagine XL + ControlNet-pose + IPAdapter character ref). Caller fanouts per key pose. Backed by BPMN animeka_generate_keyframe (ADR-2604231328).

Stage 4/12 — Generate a layout paper from an approved storyboard (ControlNet-depth + Animagine 1024x1024). HITL: produces status=draft, director approves downstream. Backed by BPMN animeka_generate_layout (ADR-2604231328).
Stage 1/12 — Draft an episode script with Claude Sonnet 4.5 (deep tier), structure scenes via Qwen 7B (mid tier), and persist a script row. Backed by BPMN animeka_generate_script (ADR-2604231328).

Stage 11/12 — Generate one sound cue (dialogue via Style-Bert-VITS2 JP / SFX via Stable Audio Open / BGM via MusicGen medium). Caller fanouts per cue. Backed by BPMN animeka_generate_sound_cue (ADR-2604231328).

voiceOrPrompt.description: Voice name for dialogue; prompt for sfx/bgm.

main.description: Stage 3/12 — Generate one storyboard candidate image (Animagine XL 512x512). Caller invokes 3 times (candidateNum=1,2,3); director picks 1 via status=approved gate. Backed by BPMN animeka_generate_storyboard (ADR-2604231328).
Get a cut with its full layer tree (storyboard, layout, keyframes, inbetweens, colorTrace, background, composite, soundCue, retakes). Drives the Cut Detail view.
Health check. Returns app identity + timestamp.

Tier 2 domain record for an in-between frame (動画 / douga). Generated between two consecutive keyframes, either by the inbetweener AI actor (`method=aiInterp`) or by a human animator (`method=manual`).

frameNum.description: Frame number within the cut (0-indexed). Must be strictly between prevKey.frameNum and nextKey.frameNum.

prevKeyRef.description: Previous keyframe (must be same cutRef + same layerRole).

nextKeyRef.description: Next keyframe (must be same cutRef + same layerRole).

method.description: How this frame was produced. 'reuse' = copy of adjacent frame (holdout).

author.description: Human DID or inbetweener actor DID.

main.description: Tier 2 domain record for a key animation frame (原画 / genga). Consecutive keyframe pairs on the same cut trigger the `keyframePair-inbetween` derive rule which invokes the inbetweener actor to generate tween frames.

imageCid.description: Blob CID of the keyframe drawing.

layersCid.description: Blob CID of the KAMI layered doc (line + tie-down layers).

layerRole.description: X-sheet layer column (A = foreground / main char, B/C/D = secondary, book = static overlay).

tiePose.description: Pose / expression tag for cross-frame consistency check.

main.description: Tier 2 domain record for a layout (レイアウト). Precise per-cut composition with character positioning, prop placement, and background reference. Approval triggers parallel `layout-approve-keyAnim` (keyAnimator invoke) and `layout-approve-bg` (bgArtist invoke) derive rules.

storyboardRef.description: Approved storyboard this layout is based on.

layoutCid.description: Blob CID of the layout drawing (KAMI layered format preferred).

charPositions.description: Character positions within the layout frame.

cameraFrame.description: Initial + final camera frame within the layout (for PAN/TU/TB cuts).

lightingDirection.description: Lighting direction note for finishers (e.g. '上手 45°', 'モノトーン').

startRect.description: [x, y, w, h] in normalized layout coords, start frame.

endRect.description: [x, y, w, h], end frame. Same as startRect for still cuts.

main.description: List cuts. Powers the Pipeline Board (episode-scoped) and the flat Cuts browser (cross-episode when only workId is given).
List episodes of a work. Uses edge_contains graph traversal from work.
List retakes. Powers the Review Room queue and per-cut retake panel. Default filter is status='open'.
List anime works (series).

Tier 2 domain record for a production project index. One project corresponds to one episode (convoId = roomId per Project Actor Composition). Aggregates member DIDs, milestones, and R2 index pointers for the episode's working set.

convoId.description: Project convo / room id. All knowledge-graph records scoped by this id.

memberDids.description: Human + AI actor DIDs participating in this project.

indexCid.description: Optional R2 index blob CID for fast project tree load.

name.description: Milestone label (storyboardLock / layoutLock / animLock / delivery ...).

main.description: Publish or update an episode. Transitions status (typically 'review' → 'delivered' → 'published') and sets masterCid. Transition to 'published' fires the `episode-published-social` derive rule to emit Tier 1 social post (AppBskyFeedPost) authored by the work's path-based DID.

announcementText.description: Optional override for the derived social post body.

main.description: Invoke the compositor AI actor to render the final composite for a cut. Combines colorTrace frames + background + fxStack + camera move into outputCid. Creates ai.gftd.apps.animeka.composite record.

previewOnly.description: If true, renders low-res preview and sets status='draft'.

videoBackend.description: Video backend on the RunPod GPU pod (ADR-2604231328). Default seedance2 for faithful camera-move rendering.

main.description: Mark a retake resolved by pointing at the new record that addresses it. Un-flips cut.priority if no open retakes remain.

Tier 2 domain record for a retake (リテイク) — a frame-pinned review comment demanding revision. Targets any record type (cut / storyboard / layout / keyframe / colorTrace / composite). Open retakes flip cut.priority='retake' and surface in the Review Room.

targetUri.description: AT URI of the record being retaken.

cutRef.description: Cut the retake belongs to (for board priority aggregation).

stage.description: Pipeline stage the retake applies to.

timecodeFrame.description: Frame pin within the cut (for per-frame comments). Omit for cut-level retake.

region.description: Optional image-space region pin (rectangle in normalized coords).

author.description: Reviewer DID (typ. director or episode director).

assignee.description: DID expected to fix (overrides cut.assignees if set).

resolvedByUri.description: AT URI of the new record that resolves this retake (e.g. updated keyframe).

main.description: Tier 2 domain record for a scene (シーン) within an episode. Auto-created by the `script-ready-scene-split` derive rule. On status=ready, the `scene-ready-storyboard` rule invokes the storyboarder actor to generate 3 cut-breakdown candidates.

headingJP.description: Scene heading (e.g. 'S#12 / 夜 / 校舎屋上').

mood.description: Emotional tone (tense / calm / heroic / melancholy ...). Used by bgArtist lighting design.

cutCount.description: Realized cut count (set after cut breakdown).

status.description: 'ready' triggers storyboarder invocation.

main.description: Tier 2 domain record for an episode script (脚本). Body is stored as blob; metadata + scene breakdown lives in graph. Derive rule `script-ready-scene-split` auto-creates ai.gftd.apps.animeka.scene records when status=ready, invoking the screenwriter actor.

bodyCid.description: Blob CID of the script body (.txt / .fountain / .fdx).

format.description: Script format. 'hakoden' = Japanese anime 箱書き format.

sceneCount.description: Parsed scene count (set after scene split).

status.description: 'ready' triggers scene-split derive rule.

main.description: Tier 2 domain record for a sound cue (音響 / onkyo) attached to a cut or frame range. Covers voice, SE, BGM. Auto-generated as slots when cut is approved (one per trackType), then filled by human or soundDesigner actor.

assetCid.description: Blob CID of the audio asset (wav/ogg/mp3).

line.description: Dialogue text for voice tracks (from script).

status.description: 'slot' = auto-generated empty placeholder awaiting assignment.

main.description: Tier 2 domain record for a storyboard (絵コンテ) panel attached to a cut. Multiple storyboard candidates may exist per cut (the `storyboarder` AI actor proposes 3 candidates; one is approved). Approval triggers the `storyboard-approve-layout` derive rule.

thumbCid.description: Blob CID of the storyboard thumbnail sketch.

candidateNum.description: 1..3 if this is one of the AI-proposed candidates; omitted for human-authored single board.

dialogue.description: Dialogue text (JP primary, spoken lines + character attribution).

soundNote.description: SE / BGM hint (e.g. 'SE: 扉を開ける').

durationFramesHint.description: Proposed cut length in frames (refines cut.durationFrames on approval).

status.description: 'approved' triggers layout derive rule.

main.description: Submit a retake (リテイク) against a target record. Creates ai.gftd.apps.animeka.retake and flips the target cut's priority to 'retake' and the relevant stage status to 'retake'.

cutId.description: Parent cut (derived from targetUri if omitted).

main.description: Update cut.stageStatus and/or cut.assignees for a single pipeline stage. Drives the Pipeline Board kanban. Stage transition to 'approved' may cascade via derive rules (e.g. storyboard→layout, layout→keyAnim+bg).

Tier 2 domain record for an anime work (series). Carries the facet/embed source fields consumed by the derive rule `work-published-social` in magatama.jsonld to auto-emit an app.bsky.feed.post. Each work gets a path-based DID `did:web:animeka.etzhayyim.com:work:{slug}` that becomes the social post author.

genre.description: Primary genre (action / drama / slice-of-life / sci-fi etc.).

status.description: Production lifecycle.

episodeCount.description: Planned total episode count (informational; actual episodes are separate ai.gftd.apps.animeka.episode records).

fps.description: Default fps for this work (24 for full animation, 12 for limited). Can be overridden per-cut.

coverCid.description: Blob CID of the key visual image. Consumed by derive rule as embed.recordWithMedia.media.images[0].image.

trailerUri.description: PV / trailer URL. Emitted as facet#link in the derived post.

$comment: Substrate-level swarm coordination lease record. Holder is the worker DID currently authoritative for the named scope. Mirrors the browser-local BroadcastChannel leader election from ADR-2605191603 across devices via MST. Authoritative per ADR-2605191638.

main.description: Cross-device swarm lease for an ameno scope (e.g. a firehose collection). At most one record per repo with the well-known rkey 'current' — write contention is resolved by MST CAS + L2 anchor monotonicity.

scope.description: What this lease governs. Examples: 'firehose:app.bsky.feed.post', 'autoRespond:ameno', 'briefDispatcher'. Convention: stable kebab-case identifier.

holderDid.description: DID currently holding the lease. Receivers MUST verify the record is authored by this same DID (PDS-side signature) before honouring the lease.

generation.description: Monotonically incrementing counter. Takeovers MUST publish generation > the previous record's generation, so concurrent claimants converge on a single winner.

issuedAt.description: Wall-clock at which the lease was first claimed.

expiresAt.description: Wall-clock at which the lease must be renewed or relinquished. Recommend issuedAt + 5 minutes.

renewedAt.description: Wall-clock at which the holder most recently renewed. Allowed to be equal to issuedAt.

computeMode.description: Holder's compute mode at lease time (local / daemon-a / daemon-b / custom). Advisory; lets followers reason about why the leader was chosen.

model.description: Holder's loaded model id, if relevant to the scope.

note.description: Free-form human-readable note (e.g. reason for takeover).

Stage 1/12 — Draft an episode script with Claude Sonnet 4.5 (deep tier), structure scenes via Qwen 7B (mid tier), and persist a script row. Backed by BPMN animeka_generate_script (ADR-2604231328).

Stage 11/12 — Generate one sound cue (dialogue via Style-Bert-VITS2 JP / SFX via Stable Audio Open / BGM via MusicGen medium). Caller fanouts per cue. Backed by BPMN animeka_generate_sound_cue (ADR-2604231328).

voiceOrPrompt.description: Voice name for dialogue; prompt for sfx/bgm.

main.description: Stage 3/12 — Generate one storyboard candidate image (Animagine XL 512x512). Caller invokes 3 times (candidateNum=1,2,3); director picks 1 via status=approved gate. Backed by BPMN animeka_generate_storyboard (ADR-2604231328).
Get a cut with its full layer tree (storyboard, layout, keyframes, inbetweens, colorTrace, background, composite, soundCue, retakes). Drives the Cut Detail view.

Tier 2 domain record for an in-between frame (動画 / douga). Generated between two consecutive keyframes, either by the inbetweener AI actor (`method=aiInterp`) or by a human animator (`method=manual`).

frameNum.description: Frame number within the cut (0-indexed). Must be strictly between prevKey.frameNum and nextKey.frameNum.

prevKeyRef.description: Previous keyframe (must be same cutRef + same layerRole).

nextKeyRef.description: Next keyframe (must be same cutRef + same layerRole).

method.description: How this frame was produced. 'reuse' = copy of adjacent frame (holdout).

author.description: Human DID or inbetweener actor DID.

main.description: Tier 2 domain record for a key animation frame (原画 / genga). Consecutive keyframe pairs on the same cut trigger the `keyframePair-inbetween` derive rule which invokes the inbetweener actor to generate tween frames.

layersCid.description: Blob CID of the KAMI layered doc (line + tie-down layers).

layoutCid.description: Blob CID of the layout drawing (KAMI layered format preferred).

etzhayyim 主宰者 or partner religious-corp が **法人債務リストラ** rite を宣言。HIPC / Paris Club / Brady Bond / Chapter 11 / scheme of arrangement / 会社更生 / debt-for-nature swap。voluntary multi-creditor consent 前提、強制力なし。Council Lv9 chair × 3 + Five-Bootstrap consultation 必須 (ADR-2605202000)。

scope.description: Free-text scope (jurisdictions, sectors, creditor coalitions). Sovereign rites name the country + creditor body; corporate rites name the entity + impaired classes.

doctrinalBasis.description: Required citation (UNCTAD Sovereign Debt Workout 2015 / 11 USC §1126(c) / 会社更生法 §86 / HIPC framework 1996)

consentThresholdPermille.description: Required cross-creditor consent threshold in permille (per-mille — so ≥ 2/3 = 667). Per-rite-type baselines: sovereign_multilateral=750, sovereign_bilateral=500, corporate_chapter_11=667, corporate_workout=900, debt_for_nature_swap=600. Higher values may be set per rite.

jurisdictionsCovered.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-3 codes the restructuring scope covers (sovereign debtor jurisdiction + creditor-coalition member states)

issuerDid.description: DID of the declaring religious-corp / authority. Council Lv9 chair × 3 ratification required downstream.

main.description: Creditor class が voluntary に restructuring rite に opt-in。class voting weight (creditor coalition share / impaired class share) を宣言。class membership 一覧 + 各 creditor の voting power を encrypted 状態で記録。

totalClaimMicroUsdc.description: Total creditor claim across the class, in micro-USDC. Used to compute consent threshold satisfaction.

classCoordinatorDid.description: DID of the class coordinator (lead arranger / trustee / class representative)

signedClassConsent.description: Aggregate signature set (EIP-712 typed data) signed by ≥ 50% of class members by claim value. Hashed in canonical form on-chain.

creditorDid.description: Member creditor's DID. May be natural or legal person (yobel's natural-person-only restriction does NOT apply to creditors).

claimMicroUsdc.description: This member's individual claim in micro-USDC. Sum across members must equal class totalClaimMicroUsdc.

instrumentRef.description: Optional reference (CUSIP / ISIN / loan agreement hash) identifying the underlying instrument

main.description: **Legal-person debtor** が restructuring rite に opt-in。**debtorEntityType MUST be one of legal-person classes** — yobel との対称: yobel は natural_person のみ、amnesty は法人のみ。schema レベル enum で gate。

debtorEntityType.description: MUST be a legal-person entity class. natural_person is INTENTIONALLY EXCLUDED — natural-person debt is yobel's scope. amnesty cell DMN A14 also verifies the resolved CouncilSBT entityType claim matches.

debtorJurisdictionIso3.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-3. For sovereign debtors, the debtor's own jurisdiction. For corporate debtors, the jurisdiction of incorporation.

legalRepresentationDid.description: DID of the law firm / counsel representing the debtor (typically vendor:lawfirm.etzhayyim.com or equivalent). Required for corporate_chapter_11 + corporate_workout rite types.

totalLiabilitiesMicroUsdc.description: Debtor's total outstanding liabilities at enrollment time, in micro-USDC. Used to compute creditor class voting share denominators.

filingDocumentCid.description: IPFS CID of the formal filing document (Chapter 11 petition / scheme of arrangement / HIPC participation request)

deferToYobel.description: True if A14 fires (entity type resolution returned natural_person) → caller should route to yobel.etzhayyim.com instead

main.description: Restructuring 詳細 + class voting tallies + settlement instruments の集約 view。

councilLv9SignerCount.description: Number of distinct Lv9 chair signers (≥ 3 required per ADR-2605202000)

main.description: Restructuring rite 一覧 (riteType / status / debtorJurisdiction / period filter)。pagination 必須。

Restructuring settlement 記録。yobel と異なり single-direction forgiveness ではなく **restructuring instruments** を扱う: haircut % / rescheduled tenor / debt-for-equity swap / debt-for-nature swap。consent threshold pass 確認後に呼ばれる。

totalReducedLiabilityMicroUsdc.description: Post-settlement liability. (totalOriginal - totalReduced) is the aggregate haircut.

courtDecreeRef.description: For corporate_chapter_11 / scheme of arrangement: reference to the confirming court order (case number, docket)

reschedulingTenorMonths.description: For rescheduling: new tenor in months. 0 if not applicable.

equitySharePermille.description: For equity_swap: creditor's equity stake share in permille. 0 if not applicable.

natureCommitmentCid.description: For nature_swap: IPFS CID of the conservation commitment document. Empty otherwise.

performanceTriggerCid.description: For performance_contingent: IPFS CID of the contingent trigger spec. Empty otherwise.

main.description: Restructuring eligibility 判定。rite type 別の cross-creditor consent threshold pre-check + entity-type gate (A14) + jurisdiction match + Charter Rider compliance scan。

currentConsentPermille.description: Running consent (weighted by claim share). Compares against consentThresholdPermille for vote completion check.

warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings (e.g. 'sovereign creditor coalition has 2 non-aligned members under Charter Rider §2(a) review')

main.description: Enrolled creditor が restructuring plan に for / against / abstain で投票。voting weight は creditor class enrollment 時に確定済の claimMicroUsdc 比例。Chapter 11 §1126(c) heuristic に matching ≥ 2/3 of each impaired class が consent threshold (rite type 別の override 可)。

creditorDid.description: Voting creditor's DID. Must be a member of the named creditorClassId (verified by cross-check against enrollCreditorClass record).

signedVote.description: EIP-712 typed-data signature over (restructuringId | creditorClassId | creditorDid | vote | votedAt) using the creditor's ERC725-registered key.

consentThresholdMet.description: True if this vote tipped the class over the consent threshold (caller observes the transition).

consentPermille.description: claimForMicroUsdc * 1000 / (claimForMicroUsdc + claimAgainstMicroUsdc) — abstain + not-voted excluded from denominator per §1126(c)

main.description: Subject entity's appeal against a charter-attestation. Submitted within 30-day appeal window. Per ADR-2605192230 §6 + 2605192200 §5.

attestationUri.description: AT URI of the charter-attestation record being appealed.

appellantDid.description: DID of the subject entity appealing (must control the address / SBT under attestation, or be authorized representative of the legal-entity).

appellantSignature.description: DID-bound signature over the appeal body (base64url).

main.description: Council Lv6+ Charter Compliance attestation (≥3 signers required). Per ADR-2605192230. Established by aggregating ≥3 charter-counsel-vote records; resolved to on-chain ChartersComplianceRegistry tx after 30-day appeal window.

requestUri.description: AT URI of the originating charter-attestation-request record.

determination.description: Council ruling. 'non-aligned' triggers L1+L2+L3 enforcement; 'aligned' clears; 'insufficient-evidence' invites re-filing with new evidence.

violationCategory.description: Confirmed Rider §2 sub-section. Required if determination = non-aligned.

rationaleCid.description: IPFS CID of full deliberation rationale (markdown / PDF).

councilSigners.description: DIDs of Council Lv6+ members who signed.

councilSignatures.description: DID-bound signatures over the canonical attestation digest (base64url).

voteUris.description: AT URIs of the ≥3 charter-counsel-vote records that constituted quorum.

registryTxHash.description: ChartersComplianceRegistry.attestNonAligned* tx hash on Base L2 (set after on-chain finalize).

main.description: Third-party request to determine whether an entity violates Charter Compliance Rider v2.0 §2(a)-(h). Per ADR-2605192230 + 2605192200. Anyone can submit; Council Lv6+ evaluates.

subjectKind.description: Whether the subject is an EVM address, an Adherent SBT, or a named off-chain legal entity.

subjectAddress.description: 0x-prefixed EVM address. Required if subjectKind = address.

subjectSbtTokenId.description: Adherent SBT tokenId. Required if subjectKind = sbt-token-id.

subjectLegalName.description: Canonical legal name (e.g., 'ACME Defense Industries Inc.'). Required if subjectKind = legal-entity.

subjectAddresses.description: Optional bundle of wallet addresses associated with the legal entity.

allegedViolation.description: Which Rider §2 sub-section the subject is alleged to violate.

evidenceUris.description: URLs / IPFS CIDs / AT URIs of evidence supporting the allegation.

requesterSignature.description: DID-bound signature over the request body (base64url, no padding).

main.description: Individual Council Lv6+ member's vote in a charter attestation deliberation. ≥3 of these aggregated form a charter-attestation record. Per ADR-2605192230 §6.

requestUri.description: AT URI of the charter-attestation-request being deliberated.

councilMemberDid.description: DID of the voting Lv6+ Council member.

vote.description: This member's individual determination. 'abstain' is permitted (e.g., conflict of interest).

rationale.description: Member's reasoning. Public record. PII-free except for the subject's name/address.

conflictOfInterestDisclosure.description: Optional COI disclosure (recused if material; abstain vote required).

memberSignature.description: DID-bound signature over (requestUri, vote, rationale) digest.

main.description: Teshuvah / rehabilitation declaration. The Non-Aligned entity retracts the doctrinal position + provides remediation evidence; Council Lv6+ ≥3 sign-off restores enforcement gates. Per ADR-2605192230 §7. Status remains permanent (Rehabilitated value, not Aligned).

originalAttestationUri.description: AT URI of the non-alignment attestation being rehabilitated from.

teshuvahNarrative.description: Self-declared doctrinal retraction + concrete remediation. The 'why I am no longer Non-Aligned' narrative. Public + permanent record.

remediationEvidence.description: URIs of concrete remediation evidence (e.g., divestment announcements, ad business closure, doctrine retraction press release).

councilSigners.description: DIDs of Council Lv6+ members recognizing the teshuvah.

subjectSignature.description: DID-bound signature by the rehabilitating entity over the teshuvahNarrative.

registryTxHash.description: ChartersComplianceRegistry.rehabilitate() tx hash on Base L2.

cooldownPeriodEnds.description: Same-reason re-attestation is blocked until this datetime (90 days post-rehabilitation per ADR-2605192230 Open Question 3).

main.description: etzhayyim 信者 level advancement record. Per ADR-2605172600 § 'Levels'. Recorded on the member's PDS at the moment they call EtzhayyimMembership.advance(level, evidenceHash, memo). Levels 2..7; level 1 (Oath) is recorded as ai.gftd.apps.etzhayyim.oath instead.

levelNameJa.description: Japanese single-kanji name for this level. Canonical mapping: 2→修, 3→献, 4→証, 5→護, 6→議, 7→老.

evidenceUri.description: Pointer to evidence: at:// URI for an AT record / 'github:owner/repo@sha' / 'tx:0x...' / 'safe:0x...'. Any client-resolvable URI.

evidenceHashKeccak256Hex.description: keccak256(utf8(evidenceUri)) lower-case hex without 0x prefix. Used as the bytes32 argument to EtzhayyimMembership.advance().

evidenceMemo.description: Optional human-readable note (≤ 280 chars). Matches the memo argument to advance().

did.description: Member's DID. did:web:* / did:plc:* / did:key:* accepted.

didSignatureBase64url.description: DID-bound signature over (level || evidenceUri || advanceTxHash) bytes. base64url no padding.

chainId.description: EVM chain ID. 8453 (Base mainnet) or 84532 (Base Sepolia testnet).

advanceTxHash.description: 0x-prefixed Base L2 transaction hash of the advance() call.

smartWalletAddress.description: 0x-prefixed Smart Account address that signed the on-chain advance().

main.description: Self-nomination for the etzhayyim Bootstrap Council (Seats 2-5). Per ADR-2605192300 §1-§2. Submitted via PDS during the 30-day public objection period. Founder reviews + selects from applications; objection mechanism is a separate Lexicon (ai.gftd.apps.etzhayyim.council-objection).

candidateDid.description: Candidate's DID (did:web / did:plc / did:key). Must control the SBT if already an Adherent.

candidateLegalName.description: Optional legal name. Candidates may apply pseudonymously.

seatAxis.description: Which of Seats 2-5 the candidate applies for. Per ADR-2605192300 §1: Seat 2 = Substrate/Technology, Seat 3 = Legal/Ethics, Seat 4 = Economics, Seat 5 = Stewardship/Land.

candidateNarrative.description: Self-introduction. Why this seat. Alignment with Mission Charter (ADR-2605192100). Public record.

evidenceUri.description: URL / IPFS CID / AT URI of supporting evidence.

smartWalletAddress.description: 0x-prefixed ERC-4337 Smart Account address. Will become the Council seat's on-chain identity.

existingSbtTokenId.description: Optional — Adherent SBT tokenId if candidate is already enrolled (recommended but not required).

conflictOfInterestDisclosure.description: Public COI disclosure. Material conflicts must be declared; non-disclosure is grounds for objection.

riderComplianceDeclaration.description: Candidate affirms they do not publicly represent any entity that falls into Charter Rider §2(a)-(h) prohibited categories. Required true.

candidateSignature.description: DID-bound signature over (seatAxis, candidateNarrative, qualifications, smartWalletAddress) digest.

founderRecognitionUri.description: Set by Founder after the objection period if this application is selected. Empty otherwise.

main.description: Objection filed by an Adherent SBT holder against a Council candidate application. Per ADR-2605192300 §1. Three (3) objections from distinct SBT holders during the 30-day window triggers founder re-proposal for that seat. Public record.

applicationUri.description: AT URI of the ai.gftd.apps.etzhayyim.council-candidate-application being objected to.

objectorDid.description: Objector's DID. Must control an active Adherent SBT (AdherentRegistry.isActive).

objectorSbtTokenId.description: Objector's Adherent SBT tokenId. Each SBT can file at most one objection per application.

objectionGrounds.description: Category of objection. Specific gravity weighting may apply when triaging founder re-proposal trigger.

objectionNarrative.description: Detailed objection. Public + permanent record. Defamatory or evidence-free objections themselves may trigger Council Lv6+ review of the objector under the same Charter Compliance framework.

evidenceUris.description: Optional supporting evidence URIs (URL / IPFS CID / AT URI).

objectorSignature.description: DID-bound signature over (applicationUri, objectionGrounds, objectionNarrative) digest.

founderResponseUri.description: Optional founder response (re-proposal, dismissal with rationale, or referral to adherent-wide vote per ADR-2605192300 Open Question 2).

main.description: Appeal of a Council Eros/Gore precedent. 30-day window. Larger Council quorum (≥5) for re-deliberation. Per ADR-2605192400 §4.

newPrecedentUri.description: AT URI of the new precedent if council modified or overturned (uses supersedesPrecedent link).

councilSigners.description: ≥5 Lv6+ required for appeal review (higher than initial 3).

main.description: Content classification request for Eros/Gore boundary. 3-layer framework (LLM pre-classification → Council Lv6+ on T2/T4 → precedent application). Per ADR-2605192400.

contentUri.description: URI of the content being classified (AT URI / URL / IPFS CID).

contentMetadata.description: Open object — metadata schema varies by content type.

encrypted.description: If true, classification uses Murakumo Gemma local fallback (no external LLM).

llmTier.description: T1 Clear Eros / T2 Eros Borderline / T3 Neutral / T4 Gore Borderline / T5 Clear Gore

councilDeferralUri.description: If T2/T4 and no precedent matched, AT URI of the Council deliberation request.

main.description: Council Lv6+ ruling established as a precedent for future Eros/Gore classifications. Indexed via vector search by future judging requests. Per ADR-2605192400 Layer 3.

subjectDescription.description: Canonical description of the content category this precedent governs.

originalJudgingUri.description: AT URI of the eros-gore-judging that triggered Council deliberation.

councilRationale.description: Full Council reasoning. Public + permanent. Future similar cases applied directly without Council re-deliberation.

supersedesPrecedent.description: Optional AT URI of an earlier precedent this one revises/overturns.

supersededBy.description: Set by a later precedent when this one is overturned.

main.description: After-action review of a force operation. RELIGIOUS REQUIREMENT — analogous to Buddhist 懺悔 / Christian confession + lessons learned. Required within 30 days of force-log. Council Lv6+ ≥3 sign-off. Per ADR-2605192315 §5.

lessonsLearned.description: Public + permanent record. Religious-corp collective memory.

recommendations.description: Concrete recommendations for future force operations or doctrine revision.

selfCritiqueCid.description: IPFS CID of optional self-critique document from operating actors.

main.description: Proposal to authorize an actual force operation. Goes through 1 SBT = 1 vote with 50% quorum + 67% supermajority. Normal voting: 72h; emergency: 24h (requires Council Lv6+ ≥3 emergency attestation). Per ADR-2605192315 §3.

proportionalityAnalysis.description: Analysis of proportionality vs threat. Religious accountability standard.

thirdPartyReviewCid.description: Optional independent legal / ethical review reference.

rdPublicationsReferenced.description: AT URIs of force-rd-publication records relevant to this authorization.

actorDids.description: DIDs of Adherents who will perform the force operation.

emergencyDeclared.description: If true, requests 24h emergency voting (requires concurrent Council Lv6+ ≥3 emergency attestation).

councilEmergencyAttestationUris.description: Required if emergencyDeclared. AT URIs of Council emergency attestations (≥3).

main.description: On-chain log of an actual force operation. Constitutional REQUIREMENT — every force action MUST be logged. Per ADR-2605192100 §1.12.B + 2605192315.

authorizationUri.description: AT URI of the prior force-authorization-proposal that approved this action.

locationCid.description: Optional IPFS CID of location data (GPS coordinates / GeoJSON area / 'redacted' for adherent safety).

casualties.description: Required field. Religious-corp accountability standard demands explicit transparency.

witnessesAttestations.description: AT URIs of independent witness attestations.

main.description: Open-source R&D proposal for Transparent Religious Force (defensive technology / tactical doctrine / training method / detection system). Apache 2.0 + Charter Rider v2.0 mandatory. Dual-use analysis required. Per ADR-2605192315.

designSpecCid.description: IPFS CID of full design specification (markdown / PDF). Draft acceptable at proposal time.

safetyAnalysisCid.description: IPFS CID of safety analysis document. Required.

dualUseAnalysis.description: Constitutional REQUIREMENT per ADR-2605192315 §4: explicit analysis of how this design could be misused by adversaries + mitigations. Charter Rider §2 exposure analysis included.

main.description: Publication of completed R&D work to 60-apps/etzhayyim-transparent-force-rd/. Apache 2.0 + Charter Rider v2.0 mandatory. Proprietary designs PROHIBITED (constitutional invariant). Per ADR-2605192315.

finalDesignCid.description: IPFS CID of finalized design + implementation + tests.

openSourceLicense.description: Constitutionally fixed. Other licenses (proprietary / NC / source-available) NOT permitted for force R&D.

repoPath.description: Path in 60-apps/etzhayyim-transparent-force-rd/ where the project lives.

main.description: Commission a completed deployment: register commissioned assets with the relevant open-* utility lexicons + open-ot defineLoop, run the acceptance test, and transition site state to 'operational'. After commissioning, kuni-umi is observer-only for that site; open-ot WASM PLC owns steady-state operation.

utilityAssetDids.description: DIDs of the open-* utility records created during commissioning (defineGenerationNode / defineSubstation / defineFeeder / registerSmartMeter / defineRegulator / definePipeSegment / defineReservoir / defineMain / defineSite / defineLink etc.)

openOtLoopDids.description: DIDs of the open-ot defineLoop records that will run steady-state control

testReportCid.description: IPFS CID of acceptance test report

openOtCellFingerprints.description: WASM AOT module hashes that ran during acceptance

stewardOperatorDid.description: Steward DID that takes day-to-day operational responsibility

main.description: Declare a planetary-infrastructure deployment site. Returns siteDid. Synchronously runs the jurisdiction-eligibility DMN (ADR-2605201400 §5) — sites without a stewardship claim (LandRegistry / OceanStewardship / RiverStewardship / AtmosphereStewardship / OrbitalSlot) or that violate Charter Rider §2 are rejected. ADR-2605201400.

geo.description: GeoJSON Feature (Polygon or MultiPolygon for terrestrial / aquatic; Point + altitude for orbital)

jurisdictionDid.description: DID of the stewardship registry entry covering this site

intendedUse.description: Free-form intended-use statement; gated against Charter Rider §2(a-h)

intendedBeneficiaryDids.description: Community DIDs that will benefit from the deployment

localLawAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID — Steward Lv5+ attestation of local-law compliance (required for restricted utilities: electric / gas / airplane / network-spectrum / orbit)

main.description: Propose a deployment plan: BoM (UNSPSC code list + qty + estimated USDC cost), target topology (FK ↔ open-* CIM record DIDs), timeline, and fleet allocation. BoM / cost / supplier identities are XChaCha20-Poly1305-enveloped per ADR-2605181100 (envelope payload only; this lexicon describes the public envelope shape). Triggers governance vote when proportionality-check DMN flags requiresGovernance=true.

targetTopologyDids.description: DIDs of open-* utility records this plan will create (open-denki / open-gas / open-water / open-network / open-power / etc.)

bomEnvelopeCid.description: IPFS CID of the XChaCha20-Poly1305 envelope containing the BoM (UNSPSC commodity codes + qty + estimated USDC cost + supplier DIDs). Recipients: Council Lv6+ (3+) + plan steward + assigned construction-cell leader.

robotCount.description: Number of Giemon units required (Otete arms + crawlers + Hitogata humanoid + future Quad)

paymentPlanCid.description: IPFS CID of payment schedule (Etzhayyim.pay() calls with TitheRouter 90/10 split). Encrypted same as bomEnvelope.

requiresGovernance.description: From proportionality-check DMN — when true, plan acceptance blocked on governance vote

governanceProposalUri.description: URI of the governance proposal record (when requiresGovernance=true)

councilThirdPartyReviewCid.description: Required when ecologyImpactScore > 30: ecologist third-party review IPFS CID

main.description: Stream construction-phase super-step progress at 1–10 Hz checkpointer cadence. N >= 2 robot DID signatures REQUIRED (witness invariant). Sensor / photo blob CIDs are IPFS-pinned. Hard-RT motion data is NOT in this record — that stays in Giemon firmware (per ADR-2605201400 §3 Phase 3 cadence rules).

superStepIndex.description: Pregel super-step counter for this plan (0-indexed)

cellId.description: Construction cell identifier (1 cell = 1 Giemon unit per super-step)

completionPct.description: 0..100 percent complete for this cell at this super-step

sensorBlobCids.description: IPFS CIDs of streamed photo / sensor / depth snapshots

main.description: Permanent robot-witnessed audit event for a deployment site. N >= 2 independent robot DID signatures REQUIRED. Class=anomaly/injury subtypes are XChaCha20-Poly1305-enveloped per ADR-2605181100; class=community-event/compliance-check are public (transparency triple per ADR-2605192315 §3). Feeds Phenotype.effectiveMultiplier delta per ADR-2605192230.

planDid.description: Optional — when event is during construction phase

evidenceCid.description: IPFS CID for evidence — encrypted envelope for anomaly/injury, clear CID for community/compliance

End-to-end FAX preparation + handoff in one call: takes text/markdown/HTML, renders to a print-ready Japanese A4 business letter PDF, uploads to CDN B2, and triggers the operator handoff. DEFAULT provider is 'manual' (Dropbox Fax UI) — the agent prepares everything and notifies the operator via mailer (Teams channel + email) with PDF URL + step-by-step instructions; operator does the final UI send. After operator confirms, call ai.gftd.apps.fax.confirmManualSend to close the audit chain. Phaxio API path is retained but marked as DEAD PATH (no creds in production). Use for compliance correspondence: 労基署 / 裁判所 / 内容証明 / 行政手続.

description: Record of a single amendment / repeal / insertion applied to a statute article. `supersedesArticleDid` points at the prior-version article DID; the new version is addressable as a separate `ai.gftd.apps.houbun.article` record (new blake3 hash). See ADR-0052.

statuteRef.description: AT URI of the affected statute record.

articleRef.description: AT URI of the new (post-amendment) article record. Omitted for whole-statute repeals.

supersedesArticleDid.description: Article DID being replaced. NULL for pure insertions.

amendingStatuteRef.description: AT URI of the statute that enacted this amendment, if available.

diffUri.description: Optional pointer to a unified diff / HTML diff published by the source.

props.description: Opaque JSON string for source-specific metadata.

description: A single article / section of a statute — the atomic unit of citation. `articleDid` is content-addressed via blake3_prefix12(jurisdiction + statuteId + articleNo + amendedAt) so amendments produce a new DID; lineage is captured by `ai.gftd.apps.houbun.amendmentEvent`. See ADR-0052.

statuteRef.description: AT URI of the parent `ai.gftd.apps.houbun.statute` record.

articleNo.description: Article number as printed in the source (e.g. '第九条', '§1001', 'Art. 7').

title.description: Optional article heading if the source provides one.

text.description: Full article body in the authoritative language.

blake3Hash.description: 12-char hex prefix of blake3(jurisdiction|statuteId|articleNo|amendedAt). Used as the DID suffix.

amendedAt.description: Effective date of the version captured in `text`. NULL for the original enactment.

props.description: Opaque JSON string for source-specific metadata (e.g. e-Gov 条文番号 + 項 + 号).

celex.description: CELEX identifier (e.g. '32016R0679' for GDPR). Mutually exclusive with since.

since.description: ISO 8601 date — fetch acts registered after this cutoff.

actType.description: Limit to a single act type. Applies to since mode.

titleNumber.description: CFR title (1–50) or USC title (1–54). Omit to ingest the full title index.

year.description: Edition year (e.g. 2024 for CFR, 2023 for USC).

Logical-delete a karute encrypted record by writing an app.etzhayyim.encrypted.tombstone with tombstoneType='redact'. The ciphertext envelope is left in place (MST is append-only); future reads MUST treat redacted records as absent. Optional sealing destroys the sender's copy of the sym_key (`tombstoneType='sealed'`), making future decrypt impossible even by the sender. Per ADR-2605231603. Common use: data-correction (mis-entered patient), patient-request redaction (post-Phase-1 GDPR-style erasure for non-medical-mandatory fields).

Used for: scheduled rekey, member removal (consent revocation flush), key compromise rotation, data correction. Per ADR-2605231603.

This procedure forwards the encounter + service-request AT URIs and the capability URI to iryo; iryo verifies the capability signature and that purpose='insurance-billing', then claims insurance through Stripe/RisingWave (vendor side). Returns iryo's claim reference if accepted, error otherwise. Per ADR-2605231400 §'iryo bridge'.

Note: revocation is observable but cannot un-distribute already-fetched ciphertext; the assumption is that the grantee cooperates (and is bound by purpose-specific contractual / legal terms — e.g. iryo billing actor's clinician agreement).

P10.2b critique-side aggregator. Overlays the Hume image-feature `emotionAlignment` score onto each render's LLM axes (when target_mood + B2 are available), computes the aggregate mean per render, and selects the highest-scoring render. Tolerant to renders with full `critique.axes`, with only `score`, or with neither (falls back to `fallback_score`). ADR-2605082000 §2 — kind='mcp_tool'. SSoT: lg_mangaka.tools:tool_aggregate_critique.

fallbackScore.description: Score assigned to renders without LLM axes. Default 0.6. Keeps the refinement-loop predicate stable when the vision LLM is unavailable.

main.description: P13 VRM ingestion. Validates a glTF/VRM 1.0 binary payload (magic 'glTF', version 2), uploads it to B2 with content-addressed key `blobs/mangaka/vrm/{sha256hex}`, then writes the resolved `vrmBlobKey` back onto the `vertex_mangaka kind='character'` row's `props` JSON so `resolve_assets` (Pregel step 2) picks it up next render. Idempotent — re-uploads dedup by sha256 and the UPDATE is skipped when the blob_key already matches. ADR-2605082000 §2 — kind='mcp_tool'. SSoT: lg_mangaka.tools:tool_attach_character_vrm.

main.description: P16 step 6 of ai.gftd.apps.mangaka.composeCharacterVrm. Auto-rigs the reconstructed mesh on the VKE CPU pool, two tracks inside one pod image `ghcr.io/etzhayyim/blender-rigify-rignet:0.1`: (a) Blender Rigify template-fit (anime-tuned meta-rig auto-scaled to the mesh AABB + head landmark) — production primary; (b) in-house RigNet distill checkpoint (MIT base architecture, our weights at `b2://gftd-models/rignet-anime-v0.<n>/`) — production fallback when Rigify produces a broken bind. Self-hosted invariant: no external rigging service (Mixamo / AccuRIG etc.) is called from this path. External APIs are train-only teacher signals — see `data/ghosthacker/TRAINING_PIPELINE.md`. ADR-2605082000 §2 — kind='mcp_tool'. SSoT: lg_mangaka.tools:tool_auto_rig_humanoid.

blendshapePack.description: From extractFacialBlendshapes — uses head landmark to fit the Rigify meta-rig.

forceFallback.description: If true, skip Rigify and use the RigNet distill checkpoint directly (test path).

riggedGlbB64.description: Base64-encoded binary glTF with humanoid armature + weight-painted skin.

main.description: P16 step 7 of ai.gftd.apps.mangaka.composeCharacterVrm. Headless Blender (`--background --python`) on the VKE CPU pool runs the saturday06 VRM Add-on to take the rigged glTF + blendshape pack + spring-bone hints derived from `profile.gh:hair` and emit a VRM 1.0 binary. ARKit blendshape names are mapped onto VRM Expression presets. Self-hosted on `ghcr.io/etzhayyim/blender-vrm:4.1` (no external API). ADR-2605082000 §2 — kind='mcp_tool'. SSoT: lg_mangaka.tools:tool_bind_vrm.

profile.description: gh:appearance / gh:background — drives spring-bone hints (hair, skirt) and VRM meta (charmName etc.).

main.description: P16 step 5 of ai.gftd.apps.mangaka.composeCharacterVrm. Runs MediaPipe Face Landmarker (Apache-2.0) on the VKE CPU pool to extract 52 ARKit-compatible blendshape weights + 478 face landmarks from the character reference image. The result is folded into bind_vrm so the VRM has working facial animation out of the gate. Self-hosted on `ghcr.io/etzhayyim/mediapipe-face:1` (no external API). ADR-2605082000 §2 — kind='mcp_tool'. SSoT: lg_mangaka.tools:tool_extract_facial_blendshapes.

referenceImageB64.description: Base64-encoded PNG of the character reference.

headLandmark.description: Approx head pose (yaw / pitch / roll degrees + scale) for downstream rig fit.

Self-hosted on `ghcr.io/etzhayyim/character-gen:0.1` (open-weight, no external API). ADR-2605082000 §2 — kind='mcp_tool'. SSoT: lg_mangaka.tools:tool_generate_multiview_anime.

Self-hosted on `ghcr.io/etzhayyim/hunyuan3d-2:0.2` (open-weight, no external API). ADR-2605082000 §2 — kind='mcp_tool'. SSoT: lg_mangaka.tools:tool_reconstruct_mesh.

main.description: P10.2 validator between cinematography (LLM, kind='llm') and simulate_one fan-out. Clamps + validates the raw LLM camera output (`shot` enum, `fov_deg` ∈ [15,85], `roll_deg` ∈ [-25,25], 3-float vectors, light role/colour/direction shape) and replaces malformed light arrays with the 3-point default. Output is the runtime `camera_plan` channel consumed by simulate_one + render_keyframes. ADR-2605082000 §2 — kind='mcp_tool'. SSoT: lg_mangaka.tools:tool_validate_camera_plan.

cameraPlanRaw.description: Raw JSON object emitted by the cinematography LLM node — pre-clamp, may carry malformed fields.

fallbackShot.description: Manga-grammar enum to fall back to when the LLM's `shot` field is unknown or missing. Default MediumShot.

camera.description: {shot, eye, target, up, fov_deg, roll_deg, dof}. dof is null unless DoF is engaged.

lights.description: 3-point lighting set; each entry carries role∈{Key,Fill,Rim,Ambient} + direction[3] + colour[3] + intensity.

llm.description: True when the LLM produced a non-empty cameraPlanRaw; false when the validator fell back to pure presets.

main.description: P16 step 8 of ai.gftd.apps.mangaka.composeCharacterVrm. Parses the bound VRM with `kami_vrm::parse_vrm` (in-repo) and checks VRM 1.0 magic + humanoid bone coverage (≥18 required bones) + ARKit blendshape minimum set (Happy/Angry/Sad/…) + polygon budget (<50k tris). The conditional edge `dmn:ai.gftd.policies.mangaka.vrmBindRetry@1.0.0` routes `valid=false` back to bindVrm for one retry, otherwise the Pregel moves on to attachCharacterVrm. ADR-2605082000 §2 — kind='mcp_tool'. SSoT: lg_mangaka.tools:tool_validate_vrm.

main.description: Fetch a single project (by slug or vertex_id) with its most recent artifacts. RLS-scoped to caller's actor_did. Per ADR-2605080800.

main.description: Ingest a single user input (text / url / file_ref) and start a LangGraph run. The run classifies the intake into a project (existing or new), routes through a kind-specific processor, and writes an artifact. Returns immediately with run_id; poll downstream queries for status. Per ADR-2605080800.

sourceKind.description: Input modality. text = inline string, url = http(s) link to fetch, file_ref = b2://… reference.

rawText.description: Required when sourceKind=text. Raw user-supplied content.

sourceUri.description: Required when sourceKind ∈ {url, file_ref}. http(s):// for url, b2:// for file_ref.

lang.description: BCP-47 language tag hint (e.g., ja, en). Optional — parser auto-detects when omitted.

projectHint.description: Optional slug of an existing project the user wants this intake bound to. When set, classify_project is skipped and the intake is forced into the named project.

runId.description: LangGraph thread_id == run_id == sha256(actor_did + ts_ms + intake_hash).

status.description: Initial status. Almost always pending/running on this call.

errors.name: InvalidInput
errors.description: Required field missing or sourceKind mismatch.

errors.name: RateLimited
errors.description: Per-actor concurrent run cap exceeded.

errors.name: BackendUnavailable
errors.description: LangGraph Server unreachable.

main.description: List runs paused at the HITL gate (status='interrupted'), newest first. Each entry includes the classifier proposal + rationale recovered from the LangGraph checkpoint chain so a UI can render the review queue without a separate per-run lookup. Per ADR-2605080800 Phase 7.

pendingClassification.description: Recovered from vertex_langgraph_checkpoint by thread_id=runId. Empty when checkpoint has been pruned.

main.description: List projects in actor scope, optionally filtered by status / kind. Returns recent intake count from mv_manimani_project_active. Per ADR-2605080800.

status.description: Filter by lifecycle status. Default returns all non-archived.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor (last_intake_at descending).

main.description: Re-process an existing intake through the LangGraph processor (extract_facts / expand_todo / summarize / defer_for_user_review). Used to upgrade a prior artifact with a stronger model, or to change processor kind. Writes a new vertex_manimani_artifact (does not mutate prior artifacts). Per ADR-2605080800.

forceProcessor.description: Override the project.kind-derived processor. When omitted, uses the project's current kind.

modelTier.description: LLM tier override. Default is the kind-default (fast for memo/summarize, balanced for knowledge/task).

errors.name: InvalidInput
errors.description: Required field missing or processor mismatch with project kind.

errors.name: NotFound

main.description: Resume a run that paused at the HITL gate (status=interrupted) by supplying the user's decision. Re-invokes the LangGraph StateGraph with state.human_decision set; the classify_project gate short-circuits and the rest of the pipeline runs normally. Per ADR-2605080800 Phase 4.

runId.description: Original run id that paused. The resume run gets a new id and stores the original in vertex_manimani_run.parent_run_id.

decision.description: approve = let the proposed new project emerge and continue. reject = abort the run with status=completed_with_error. reassign = bind the intake to targetProjectId instead and continue.

targetProjectId.description: Required when decision=reassign. vertex_manimani_project.vertex_id in caller's actor scope.

runId.description: New run_id for the resumed StateGraph invocation.

originalRunId.description: The paused run id passed in by the caller.

errors.name: InvalidInput
errors.description: decision=reassign requires targetProjectId, or runId not paused.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: runId not found in actor scope.

Return aggregated vessel density inside a bbox, suitable for low-zoom heatmap rendering. ADR-2605011500. Phase 1: backed by mv_vessel_density_grid (0.1° lat/lon grid ~11km equator) — RisingWave 2.8.1 has no h3_lat_lng_to_cell builtin, so true H3 res-6 is deferred to Phase 2 (Python/Rust UDF wrapping h3o). The h3Resolution param is accepted for forward-compat but currently ignored; cellSchema in the response indicates which rendering path to use.

h3Resolution.description: Reserved for Phase 2 (true H3). Accepted but ignored in Phase 1 grid mode. Default 5.

cells.description: Array of cell rows. Phase 1 (cellSchema='grid_0p1deg'): { cell_id:string, lat_bin:number, lon_bin:number, vessel_count, hit_count, byClass: { [type_class]: { vessel_count, hit_count } } }. lat_bin/lon_bin = south-west corner of the 0.1°×0.1° cell. Phase 2 (cellSchema='h3_r6'): { cell_id:string (H3 hex), vessel_count, hit_count, byClass }.

cellSchema.description: 'grid_0p1deg' (Phase 1) or 'h3_r6' (Phase 2). Tells the client how to render cell_id.

recentTrack.description: Array of { ts_ms, lat, lon, sog_knot?, cog_deg?, heading_deg?, nav_status? } sorted by ts_ms ascending.

positions.description: Array of position rows: { mmsi, ts_ms, lat, lon, sog_knot?, cog_deg?, heading_deg?, nav_status?, source }. Max 1000 per call.

masters.description: Array of master upserts from AIS Type-5 broadcasts: { mmsi, imo?, callsign?, name?, type_code?, length_m?, width_m?, draught_m?, source, ts_ms }. Optional, max 200.

main.description: Return the latest known position of every AIS-tracked vessel inside a WGS84 bounding box, as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Backed by mv_vessel_latest_position. Optionally filter by type_class ('cargo','tanker','passenger','fishing','tug','highspeed','sailing_pleasure','military','pilot','sar','lawenforcement','other','unknown'). ADR-2605011500.

bbox.description: [west,south,east,north] in WGS84 degrees. Longitudes wrap allowed (e.g. west=170, east=-170 covers Pacific antimeridian).

types.description: Optional filter by vessel_type_class (see vessel_type_class SQL UDF).

minSog.description: Optional minimum speed-over-ground in knots. Use 0.5 to exclude moored/anchored vessels.

features.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Feature.properties: { mmsi, name?, type_code?, type_class, flag_iso?, sog_knot?, cog_deg?, heading_deg?, nav_status?, ts_ms }.

main.description: Internal — fired by refreshVesselMaster.bpmn (R/PT24H). Also derives type_class via vessel_type_class UDF for any rows where type_code was updated. Open-data only (no paid IHS / VT Explorer enrichment per ADR-2605011500).

results.description: Array of { mmsi, imo?, name?, callsign?, type_class, flag_iso?, last_seen_ms, last_lat?, last_lon? }.

Run COLMAP CPU dense reconstruction over a curated image set. Pipeline: feature_extractor (SIFT CPU) → exhaustive_matcher → mapper (incremental SfM) → image_undistorter → patch_match_stereo (CPU, 4-thread) → stereo_fusion → delaunay_mesher. Inputs are Mapillary URLs (worker downloads to ephemeral /tmp); output is a vertex-colored triangle mesh stored in B2. Wall-clock budget per tile = 60 min hard timeout (BPMN boundary); typical 30-45 min on 2 cores @ 2.5 GHz with 30 images at 1080p. On failure emits a structured error so `replanReconstruction` can decide retry|downgrade-to-osm|abort.

matcher.description: exhaustive | sequential | spatial. Default exhaustive (best quality, slowest).

main.description: LangGraph multi-step image curation. Input is the full Mapillary candidate set; output is 20-40 selected image IDs ordered by SfM utility. Nodes: score_quality (heuristic resolution + blur EXIF) → score_coverage (azimuthal + baseline diversity) → llm_dedupe (Murakumo Vision LLM near-dup collapse) → decide_count. Selected count caps COLMAP memory at ~16 GiB on a single CPU pod.

minCount.description: Below this, mark tile as unreconstructable. Default 8.

Output is metadata only (image_id + camera_pose + captured_at + url); the actual JPEG fetch + B2 upload happens after image curation narrows the candidate set. Source DID `did:web:maps.etzhayyim.com:street_view`.

Strong matches get an `Operates` / `OwnsProperty` edge to the host Building vertex; weak matches stay as VisionResult-only. Per ADR-0036 the worker writes vertex / edge rows directly via Hyperdrive, no PDS round-trip.

main.description: Entry point for the maps3d photogrammetry pipeline. Triggers a single H3 tile through Mapillary fetch → image curation (LangGraph) → COLMAP CPU dense reconstruction → mesh simplification → Murakumo Vision annotation → actor disambiguation → vertex_spatial ingest. BPMN-as-actor (ADR-0056) — invoked via `POST http://dispatcher.etzhayyim.com:8080/xrpc/ai.gftd.apps.maps3d.processTile` or auto-fired by timer-start R/PT15M against `vertex_maps3d_tile WHERE status IN ('pending','stale')`. Real work runs in LangServer handlers under namespace `maps3d` in Vultr LKE. Backed by `00-contracts/bpmn/ai/gftd/maps3d/processTile.bpmn` v1, `vertex_id = at://did:web:bpmn.etzhayyim.com/ai.gftd.apps.bpmn.processDef/maps3d-process-tile-v1`.

main.description: LangGraph failure replanner. Takes a structured COLMAP failure (errorCode + errorMessage from `colmapTile`) and decides: retry-with-relaxed-thresholds | request-more-images | downgrade-to-osm-extrude | mark-unrecoverable. State is checkpointed to `vertex_langgraph_state` so a Pod restart resumes the same decision. The BPMN exclusive gateway routes accordingly; today the loop short-circuits to End on first failure (single-pass) — multi-pass replanning is deferred until the steady-state success rate is measured.

main.description: Open3D quadric-decimation + saturated vertex-color export to GLB. Reduces COLMAP raw mesh (50K-300K triangles) to ~5K triangles per tile so the kami-app-maps3d MeshTileAdapter can stream and upload to GPU without frame spikes. Per-vertex colors are saturated (factor 1.3, clamped) to bias the rendering toward Nintendo-style cel-shading rather than photoreal blur. Optionally segments the mesh by OSM building footprint so each building gets its own GLB + vertex_spatial Building row.

Re-uses the maps `analyze_image` / `vision_import_entities` pipeline (`60-apps/ai-gftd-project-maps/CLAUDE.md` §Vision Intelligence). ISIC Rev.4 4-digit class definition. AT Protocol record carrying the canonical taxonomy entry — `code` is the 4-digit class, `section` (1 letter A–U) / `division` (2 digits) / `group` (3 digits) materialize the hierarchy as MST-traversal prefixes. Seeded once per ISIC revision (~10 year cadence) from `60-apps/ai-gftd-project-open-isic/data/classes/{code}.json`. Per ADR-2605172000 substrate posture: replaces the legacy `vertex_open_isic_class` RW table with an MST + IPFS-anchored record set. Substrate pipeline (mst-projector → ipfs-pinner → anchor-cron) provides the trust-less verification path for the taxonomy itself.

code.description: ISIC Rev.4 4-digit class code (e.g. '0111', '2520'). Used as the AT-record rkey for idempotent seeding.

nameEn.description: Canonical English name of the class.

section.description: ISIC section, 1 letter A–U (derived from division).

description.description: Free-text description as published by the UN ISIC Rev.4 source.

includes.description: Inclusions list — activities explicitly covered by this class.

excludes.description: Exclusions list — activities deliberately routed to other classes.

handbookCid.description: Optional CID of the published ISIC Rev.4 handbook chapter PDF, when blob-attached via `e.write({blobs: {handbook: pdfBlob}})`.

publishedAt.description: Timestamp when this class entry was published in the ISIC revision. Defaults to the per-class implementedAt in the source data.

UNSPSC 2-digit segment catalog entry. AT Protocol record carrying the canonical segment taxonomy — `code` is the 2-digit segment code (rkey verbatim for idempotent re-seeding), `slug` is the url-safe identifier from `60-apps/ai-gftd-project-open-unispsc/segments.csv`, `name` is the English title. Per ADR-2605172000 substrate posture: this is the published-catalog companion to the existing `ai.gftd.apps.openUnispsc.segment` *procedure* (which resolves a segment as a business-portfolio boundary at runtime). The procedure performs active business logic; this record persists the taxonomy on PDS so the substrate pipeline (mst-projector → ipfs-pinner → anchor-cron) can anchor + replicate the segment list without trusting this operator. Family / class / commodity layers follow the same record-vs-procedure split when their rw-free taxonomy publishers land in future PRs.

code.description: UNSPSC 2-digit segment code (e.g. '10', '43'). Used as the AT-record rkey for idempotent seeding.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens) for the segment. e.g. 'live-animals', 'communications-devices'. Sourced from segments.csv.

name.description: Canonical English name of the segment.

description.description: Optional free-text description; absent in v1 because segments.csv ships only (code, slug, name).

cpcSection.description: Optional primary CPC concordance section for this segment, when known (per the segment-range → CPC-section mapping documented in the open-unispsc CLAUDE.md).

publishedAt.description: Timestamp when this segment entry was published. Defaults to the UNSPSC v25 baseline 2023-08-15 unless the seeder overrides.

Blast-radius query for a supplier (and optionally MPN). Returns every SBOM artifact whose components reference the supplier — Takata-style hardware recall surface for vehicle BOMs and the equivalent software-side query for cargo SBOMs. Filters by kind (software | vehicle).

supplier.description: Manufacturer / supplier name. Matched against vertex_sbom_component.supplier_name.

mpn.description: Manufacturer part number. Optional. When set, only components whose supplier_mpn equals this value are returned.

kind.description: Restrict results to software or vehicle artifacts. Omit for both.

main.description: Register a CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM artifact with sbom.etzhayyim.com. Software SBOMs (cargo-cyclonedx output) and vehicle BOMs (kami-cad-import output, type=device per part) flow through the same SbomArtifact graph and CVE / recall pipeline (60-apps/ai-gftd-project-sbom/CLAUDE.md). For vehicle BOMs the optional vehicle* fields capture the part-graph metadata needed for Takata-style supplier recall queries.

format.description: Wire format. CycloneDX 1.5 is the default for both software and vehicle BOMs.

vehicleId.description: Stable vehicle id (e.g. mx5-na-1989). Present for vehicle BOMs only — software SBOMs leave this unset.

totalMassKg.description: Vehicle BOMs only — sum of effective_mass_kg across parts.

partCount.description: Vehicle BOMs only — number of CDX components.[type=device].

sourceUri.description: URI of the source artifact that produced this SBOM (e.g. scad://gftd/roadster-na/v0.1.0, b2://drive/cad/...).

sourceSha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the source artifact. Used for deterministic SBOM serial number.

license.description: SPDX expression covering the source artifact (e.g. MIT, CC-BY-4.0, proprietary).

cdxJson.description: Full CycloneDX 1.5 (or SPDX 3.0) document, encoded as a JSON string. Validated server-side against the upstream schema.

artifactUri.description: AT URI of the SbomArtifact graph node (at://did:web:sbom.etzhayyim.com/ai.gftd.apps.sbom.artifact/<rkey>).

componentCount.description: Number of CDX components ingested into the SbomComponent graph.

vulnMatchCount.description: Number of vulnerability matches detected synchronously against the existing CveEntry graph.

errors.name: InvalidSbom
errors.description: cdxJson failed CycloneDX 1.5 schema validation.

errors.name: MissingProvenance
errors.description: sourceSha256 or sourceUri empty.

errors.name: DuplicateArtifact
