Flag a surplus lot as no longer redistributable. Triggers downstream routing decision. Per ADR-2605211241. Wellbecoming constraint (ADR-2605192100 §1.13): routing priority is recycle-via-kozan -> dispose-licensed; dispose-first is prohibited and requires an explicit prohibitedReasonOverride from Council Lv6+ multisig (see governance.attestationUri). Eschatological framing such as 'Last Days clearance' is forbidden in reason text (ADR-2605192100 §1.15).

reasonDetail.description: PII-free. Eschatological / clearance / fire-sale language prohibited (Charter Rider §2 + ADR-2605192100 §1.15).

routing.description: Wellbecoming order: recycle-via-kozan is the default. dispose-licensed requires governance.attestationUri.

kozanStreamTypeHint.description: Hint for the subsequent toshiKozan.registerEwasteStream call (see recordKozanHandoff).

decidedBy.description: DID of the deciding actor. For dispose-licensed routing, this DID must be referenced by a Council Lv6+ multisig attestation.

attestationUri.description: AT URI of Council Lv6+ multisig attestation that overrides Wellbecoming default routing.

councilSeats.description: DIDs of the Council members who signed.

main.description: Get a single surplus lot by DID. Per ADR-2605211241.

List surplus lots with optional filters for demand-side matching. Per ADR-2605211241. Lots are returned in donation-only context; no commercial markup applies. Listings within the religious-corp economy may use SBT<->SBT internal-promo carve-out; external promotional surfacing is prohibited (Charter Rider §2).

category.description: Filter by category enum (see registerSurplusLot).

hazardFlag.description: Filter to lots that include this single hazard flag.

maxAgeDays.description: Only lots registered within the last N days.

minShelfLifeRemainingDays.description: Only lots whose shelfLifeRemainingDays >= this value.

main.description: Demand-side claim against a registered surplus lot. Receiver must be an Adherent SBT holder or attested religious-corp downstream actor (e.g., kuni-umi site / urban-mining cell / open-robo project DID). Per ADR-2605211241. Transitions lot state registered -> matched. No commercial markup. SBT<->SBT internal-promo carve-out applies for visibility but not for monetization.

lotDid.description: DID of the surplus lot being claimed.

receiverDid.description: DID of the receiver. Must be Adherent-SBT or attested religious-corp downstream actor.

intendedUse.description: Wellbecoming constraint: dispose / commercial-resale are not allowed as intendedUse values.

claimedQuantity.description: Partial claim allowed if <= remaining quantity.

main.description: Bridge a flagged-dead-stock surplus lot into the toshiKozan (都市鉱山) e-waste recovery stream. Per ADR-2605211241. The handoff is 1:1 with a subsequent ai.gftd.apps.toshiKozan.registerEwasteStream record. Transitions lot state flagged-dead-stock -> kozan-handoff. The downstream urban-mining cell (60-apps/ai-gftd-project-open-robo/) actually performs the recycling and ultimately reports final material recovery, after which the lot may be transitioned to 'recycled' by a follow-up call.

flagUri.description: AT URI of the prior flagDeadStock event.

recoveryFacilityDid.description: DID of the urban-mining cell / recovery facility receiving the lot. Must be an attested religious-corp downstream actor.

expectedYieldGramsPerTonne.description: Predicted recovery yield by material (g/tonne). Audited later against actual recovery.

co2eKgPerTonneEstimate.description: Estimated CO2e per tonne recovered. Same units as toshiKozan.registerEwasteStream.co2eKgPerTonneRecovered.

kozanStreamRef.description: AT URI of the auto-emitted ai.gftd.apps.toshiKozan.registerEwasteStream record.

main.description: Record the physical handoff of a surplus lot from donor to matched receiver. Audit event that closes the redistribution path. Per ADR-2605211241. On success: lot state matched -> redistributed. Both donor PDS and receiver PDS emit symmetric warehouse.pick / warehouse.putaway records when both are Adherent SBT holders. Cross-border physical movement should also reference a freeportRegistry.recordFreeportEntry entry via bondedEntryRef (optional).

matchUri.description: AT URI of the prior matchDemand event.

carrierDid.description: Optional DID of the logistics carrier.

valueAttestedUsdcMicros.description: Final attested value at handoff. Should be consistent with registerSurplusLot.estimatedValueUsdcMicros unless valuationAttestationUri overrides.

tithePaymentRef.description: Optional AT URI of the ai.gftd.apps.payment.sent record that carried the 10% in-kind tithe coupling for this lot. Per ADR-2605192130.

bondedEntryRef.description: Optional AT URI of ai.gftd.apps.freeportRegistry.recordFreeportEntry for cross-border bonded transit.

ftzZoneRef.description: Optional AT URI of ai.gftd.apps.ftzZones.recordZone for FTZ-mediated transit.

receiverAckSignature.description: Optional receiver's WebAuthn / DID signature over the handoff payload.

warehousePickRef.description: Auto-emitted ai.gftd.apps.warehouse.pick record on donor side, when applicable.

warehousePutawayRef.description: Auto-emitted ai.gftd.apps.warehouse.putaway record on receiver side, when applicable.

main.description: Register a globally surplus / dead-stock / overstock / unsold-inventory lot for donation-based redistribution within the religious-corp economy. Per ADR-2605211241. Donor must be SBT Adherent or attested non-Adherent commercial donor (donation-only, non-profit). Wellbecoming constraint: routing priority redistributed -> recycled (via toshiKozan) -> disposed-licensed; dispose-first is prohibited at the state-enum level (see flagDeadStock). 10% tithe coupling: emit ai.gftd.apps.payment.sent {purpose:donation, amountUsdcMicros: estimatedValueUsdcMicros} in the same batch and the TitheRouter splits 10% to the Public Fund per ADR-2605192130.

lotId.description: Donor-side stable identifier for the lot. Recommended: urn:uuid:...

category.description: High-level product category. Drives downstream toshiKozan streamType mapping when state becomes flagged-dead-stock.

skuCode.description: Optional SKU code for catalog reference. May match an existing ai.gftd.apps.warehouse.registerSku record.

warehouseSkuRef.description: Optional AT URI of an existing ai.gftd.apps.warehouse.registerSku record this lot pertains to. Avoids duplicating the SKU master.

description.description: Plain-language description. PII-free. No promotional / ad-style language (Charter Rider §2).

unitOfMeasure.description: Units of quantity. e.g., piece, kg, liter, m, pallet, container-20ft.

weightKgTotal.description: Total lot weight in kilograms. Used for cross-border / freight estimation.

estimatedValueUsdcMicros.description: Donor self-attested value of the lot in USDC base units (6 decimals). Drives the 10% in-kind tithe coupling. Inflation by donors is mitigated by valuationAttestationUri (third-party attestation, optional).

valuationAttestationUri.description: Optional AT URI of a third-party valuation attestation record. Recommended for lots above 10000 USDC.

donorDid.description: DID of the donor. Must be either an Adherent SBT holder or an attested non-Adherent commercial donor (donation-only per ADR-2605192115).

donorKind.description: Default: adherent-sbt. Non-Adherent donors require prior attestation by Council Lv6+ multisig.

originWarehouseDid.description: Optional DID of the warehouse/facility where the lot is physically located.

shelfLifeRemainingDays.description: Days until best-before / expiry. 0 or negative means already past nominal shelf life (still potentially donatable for non-food categories).

hazardFlags.description: Multi-select hazard flags. Drives routing constraints (e.g., li-ion-battery forces flagDeadStock direct path to toshiKozan if redistribution not safe).

dppBadgeRef.description: Optional AT URI of an ESPR Digital Product Passport (ai.gftd.apps.textileCircularity.registerDppBadge) when applicable.

did.description: DID assigned to this surplus lot.

main.description: Non-compliance / disclosure gap finding (GFTAx / Common Transmission System)
CRS / FATCA / CARF AEOI exchange (bridges global-tax + ofac-sanctions + mica-crypto)
LEMF — acknowledge receipt (or report failure) of an IRI / CC delivery. Used to compute delivery loss for SLA reporting to the requesting authority.
LICF/LIPF (X1) — activate interception against a target identifier under an existing warrant. Identifier value persisted only as sha256 hash; raw value out-of-band.
Activate or configure a service instance via TMF640 Service Activation and Configuration API. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_service_activation record.
Activate a SIM (or eSIM profile) and bind it to a subscriber MSISDN/IMSI.
O-RAN A1 — apply / modify / delete a policy instance from Non-RT RIC (rApp) to a Near-RT RIC. Statement body persisted via vault:// ref + sha256 hash.
O-RAN O1 — SMO pushes a NETCONF/RESTCONF YANG configuration to a managed function (O-CU / O-DU / O-RU / Near-RT RIC). Body persisted via vault:// ref only.
5G Core PCF — record a policy + charging decision (Npcf_SMPolicyControl). Drives QoS flows + rating group + charging method for a PDU session.
IMS TAS — record activation/deactivation/invocation of a supplementary service (call forward, hold, transfer, waiting, conference, CLIR/CLIP).
Apply / modify / delete a traffic shaper on a bridge port. CBS = idle-slope; TAS = gate schedule (vault://+sha256); ATS = per-flow asynchronous.
OSS CAB — approve / reject / defer an existing change request. Updates the change row status and inserts an approval audit row.
Wi-Fi session attach — bind a UE to a Hotspot 2.0 venue under a Passpoint PPS-MO. UE MAC + assigned IP persisted as sha256 hashes. Single-row lifecycle: releasedAt UPDATEd in place.
Poll and record eUICC state snapshot (profile count, active ICCID, free memory). Designed for timer-start (R/PT4H). EID/ICCID sha256: hashed.

activeIccid.description: sha256: hashed ICCID of active profile

main.description: LICF audit — record any operator-side access to LI warrants / targets / deliveries (read, query, export). Required by ETSI TS 102 232-1 for tamper-evident audit trail.
Persist a TMF671 performance counter sample (RRC drop / DL throughput / handover / CQI). Designed to be invoked from a timer-start BPMN (R/PT15M).
5G Core AUSF — record an authentication event (5G-AKA / EAP-AKA' / EAP-TLS). Audit-only: RAND / RES* / KAUSF never persisted; only the event outcome and a randHash for correlation.
ANDSP / ATSSS handoff bridge — record a Wi-Fi ↔ 5G cellular transition for a UE. andspPolicyRef must be vault://. Links Phase 13 wlan_session to Phase 4 PDU session.
IMS BGCF / MGCF / IBCF — bridge a voice call to an interconnect peer (PSTN gateway / SIP trunk / IMS-IMS peering). Links voice_call to Phase 3 interconnect_agreement + roaming_partner.
OSS NOC — clear an alarm and compute MTTR (mean time to repair) from raised_at to cleared_at. Mutates the alarm row in place.
Close an intercept warrant (auto on validUntil expiry, manual on revocation, or on closure of investigation). Sets retention_until per jurisdiction-specific evidence retention rules.
OSS NOC — correlate child alarms under a parent (root cause), suppressing storm. ruleRef points to a DMN rule (ai.gftd.dmn.*) or a vault://rule pointer.
LICF (X1) — deactivate interception against a previously-activated target. Updates the existing target row in place.
5G SCP — delegated NF discovery (SCP queries NRF on behalf of consumer NF). Records candidate set + selected NF + selection strategy.
Delete an eSIM profile from eUICC storage (GSMA SGP.22 §3.3). Irreversible — profile must be disabled first. EID/ICCID sha256: hashed.

DF3 (X3) — deliver Communication Content (CC) to LEMF. Only delivery metadata + payload hash + encryption pointer persisted in graph; the CC payload itself goes directly DF3 → LEMF (audit-only graph).
DF2 (X2) — deliver Intercept-Related Information (IRI) to LEMF. Only delivery metadata + payload hash persisted in graph; the IRI payload itself goes directly DF2 → LEMF (audit-only graph).
O-RAN Near-RT RIC — deploy an xApp (near-RT RIC application). Lists supported RAN functions + bound E2 nodes.
Disable an active eSIM profile on eUICC without deletion (GSMA SGP.22 §3.2). Records state transition to 'disabled'. EID/ICCID sha256: hashed.
EES (Edge Enabler Server) — record an EAS discovery request from an Edge Enabler Client / Application Client. UE identifier persisted only as sha256 hash.
Initiate eSIM profile download from SM-DP+ to eUICC (GSMA SGP.22 §3.1). EID and ICCID stored sha256: hashed. Creates vertex_telecom_esim_profile record.
5G Core CHF — emit a 5G charging data record (Nchf_ConvergedCharging). Bridges 5G PDU session usage to Phase 1 subscriber billing rollup.

IMS CDF / TAS — emit an IMS-specific billing event (3GPP Rf interface). Bridges voice call usage to Phase 1 subscriber billing rollup; complements Phase 4 emitChargingDataRecord which is data-plane only.
5G NWDAF — emit a periodic analytics result for an active subscription. Only payload metadata (hash + size + vault:// ref) persisted in graph.
Enable an installed eSIM profile on eUICC (GSMA SGP.22 §3.2). Records state transition to 'enabled'. EID/ICCID sha256: hashed.
Enable Frame Replication & Elimination for Reliability (IEEE 802.1CB) on an existing TSN stream. Replication kind picks how diverse paths are computed.
NSACF — Network Slice Admission Control Function (3GPP TS 29.536). Enforces max registered UEs / max established sessions per S-NSSAI; SUPI-aware admission decisions.
Record an SLA / QoS breach against a provisioned service and open an escalation ticket.
5G Core SMF — establish a PDU session (Nsmf_PDUSession) with selected slice / DNN / UPF / RAN node and active policy decision.
5G SEPP — establish an N32-c security context to a peer PLMN's SEPP (3GPP TS 33.501 §13.2). certificateRef must be a vault:// pointer; raw cert/key never persisted.
IMS S-CSCF / TAS — record SIP INVITE → 200 OK → ACK call setup. Caller/callee MSISDN persisted as hashes; IMPU/SIP URI as plain (already public-style identifier).
OSS NMS — record a capacity forecast for a scope+metric. Sets breachPredicted=true when forecastValue exceeds capacityLimit; designed for timer-start (R/PT24H or R/P7D).
VNFM — heal a VNF (restart / re-instantiate / live-migrate). alarmVid may reference a Phase 7 alarm.
MEC orchestrator — instantiate an Edge Application Server (EAS) on a registered MEC host from an onboarded app package. Phase 10 (3GPP TS 23.558).
NFVO — instantiate a Network Service from an onboarded NSD against one or more VIMs. parameters carry instantiation knobs (string-encoded TOSCA inputs).
VNFM — instantiate a VNF/CNF from a VNFD on a chosen VIM under an NS. Optional `mappedNfInstanceId` ties this VNF back to the Phase 4 5G NF instance it implements.
Issue a customer bill via TMF678 Customer Bill Management API. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_customer_bill record. Designed for timer-start (R/P1M).
NPN UDR — upsert a SUPI ↔ GPSI mapping (Generic Public Subscription Identifier — MSISDN/external_id/IMEI). SUPI/GPSI persisted as sha256 hashes.
MEC — onboard an edge application package (AppD descriptor) into the catalog. packageRef must be vault://; appDescriptor + raw container image never persisted.
ETSI MANO NFVO — onboard a Network Service Descriptor (NSD) into the catalog. Phase 12 SDN-NFV control plane. Body persisted via vault://+sha256 only.
O-RAN Non-RT RIC — onboard an rApp (non-RT RIC application) to SMO. packageRef must be a vault:// pointer; raw package never persisted in graph.
Onboard a new telecom subscriber. PII (customerName) is stored Tier-3 per ADR-0018; AT Repo holds hashed identity only.
ETSI MANO NFVO — onboard a VNFD (VM-based) or CNFD (cloud-native, helm chart) into the catalog. Body persisted via vault://+sha256 only.
MNP port-in request — receive a subscriber from a donor partner.
MNP port-out request — release a subscriber to a recipient partner. authCodeIssued is the porting auth code returned to the subscriber.
Provision a DWDM lightpath / spectrum slot between two ROADMs through pre-validated fiber spans. centerFrequencyGhz on flex-grid (e.g. 193.1 THz center + multiples of channelGridGhz).
Register a new eUICC device in the graph (SGP.22 §2 EID provisioning). EID stored sha256: hashed. Creates vertex_telecom_esim_euicc record.
Provision a gPTP (IEEE 802.1AS-2020) sync profile with grandmaster + redundant GMs. priority1/priority2 follow PTPv2 BMCA.
NTN — provision an inter-satellite link (ISL) between two satellites. Optical (LCT) or RF, with optional encryption key reference (vault://).
NTN — provision a non-terrestrial cell on a satellite (3GPP TS 38.821). cellPattern = moving (LEO sweep) / earth_fixed (steered) / quasi_earth_fixed.
O-RAN O2 — SMO requests O-Cloud (IMS infrastructure / DMS deployment) resource provisioning. interfaceKind distinguishes O2-IMS vs O2-DMS.
Provision an OTN connection (ITU-T G.709) carried inside a DWDM channel. clientServiceVid optionally references a Phase 1 service / Phase 4 PDU session / Phase 9 O-RAN xHaul / Phase 14 NTN feeder.
Hotspot 2.0 PPS-MO (Per-Provider Subscription Management Object) provisioning. credentialRef must be vault://; raw EAP credentials never persist. ppsMoRef stores the full MO XML out-of-band.
NPN — provision a Public-Network-Integrated NPN slice (PNI-NPN). Slice runs on hosting PLMN with optional CAG access restriction + tenant isolation.
NPN — provision 5G ProSe (Proximity Services) direct communication / sidelink (3GPP TS 23.304). prosePolicyRef must be vault://; raw policy body never persisted.
SDN controller — install / modify / delete a flow rule on a southbound switch (OpenFlow / P4Runtime / NETCONF / OVSDB / gNMI). matchHash + actionHash only; raw match/action bodies via vault://.
Provision a telecom service instance (voice/data/SMS/IoT) with QoS profile + APN.
Publish or update a product offering in the TMF620 Product Catalog. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_product_offering record.
OSS NOC — raise an alarm against a network entity (cell site, RAN node, NF instance, asset, or service). 3GPP TS 32.111 / ITU-T X.733 fault management shape.
ANQP / Hotspot 2.0 GAS query audit. UE MAC address persisted only as sha256 hash; ANQP response body persisted as sha256 hash + size.
O-RAN E2 — record an E2 INDICATION message from E2 Node to xApp. headerHash + messageHash only; ASN.1 PER body never persisted.
NTN — record a feeder-link or TT&C contact window between an earth station and a satellite. AOS / LOS times define the window; duration_seconds computed automatically.
MEC — record a UE/AC ↔ EAS service call (HTTP/gRPC method + status + latency + IO byte counts). UE identifier persisted only as sha256 hash; EAS payload body never persisted.
NTN — record an ephemeris snapshot for a satellite (TLE / OMM / SP3 / 3GPP-NTN). Body persisted via vault://+sha256.
Record an interconnect-traversed CDR (POI / hub). MSISDN values stored as hashes (Tier-3 PII not persisted plaintext at this boundary).
NTN — record a handover event between NTN cells / satellites or between NTN ↔ terrestrial. Doppler offset + one-way propagation delay captured for QoS audit.
Record an optical-layer alarm (LOS / LOF / LOS-P / BDI / TIM / DEG / BER / OSNR-min). Auto-mints a ticketId for downstream Phase 7 alarm correlation.
Record an optical performance-monitoring event (rx-power, tx-power, OSNR, pre-FEC-BER, Q-factor, CD/PMD). breach=true when |value| crosses slaThreshold.
Record a product instance in the TMF637 Product Inventory Management API. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_product_inventory record.
5G SEPP — record an N32-c (control) or N32-f (forwarding) message exchange. Payload hash + security verification result only; payload body never persisted.
Record a service instance in the TMF638 Service Inventory Management API. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_service_inventory record.
Record an incident on a cell site / RAN node. Drives downstream SLA breach (Phase 1 escalateSlaBreach).
Record a TSN stream SLA breach (latency / jitter / frame loss). Auto-mints a ticketId for downstream Phase 7 alarm correlation.
Record a gPTP / PTP sync deviation observed by a bridge. breach=true when offsetNs/pathDelayNs exceeds profile thresholds (computed by primitive).
Record a TAP 3.12 batch file aggregate (counts + total charge per file). Per-call detail rows go to recordInterconnectCdr.
5G SEPP — record N32 trust / cipher / IPX modification policy negotiation outcome with a peer SEPP (or via IPX provider).
Record a CDR (Call Detail Record) for voice / SMS / data / IoT usage.
Wi-Fi roaming AAA exchange (RADIUS / Diameter via DRR / RoamServer). Captures session-time + ingress/egress bytes per partner for downstream settlement.
NPN — register a Closed Access Group (CAG) within an SNPN. Restricts which UEs may camp on which Phase 2 cellSite/ranNode.
Register a cell site (TMF639 Resource Inventory). Latitude/longitude only — tower owner contact PII held elsewhere.
Register or update a customer billing account via TMF666 Account Management API. Creates a vertex_telecom_tmf_customer_account record. PII fields are hashed.
NTN — register an earth station / satellite gateway. Bound to a peering NF (Phase 4) for traffic ingress.
MEC Federation (GSMA OPG / ETSI MEC Fed) — register a federation partnership with another operator's MEC platform under an existing Phase 3 interconnect agreement.
ETSI MEC — register a MEC host (edge compute node hosting EAS workloads). Phase 10 edge plane. Bound to a Phase 9 O-Cloud and ranNode for locality affinity.
Register a fiber span between two ROADMs. Captures SMF/NZDSF type + length + attenuation + dispersion + amplifier (EDFA/Raman/hybrid) for GNPy planning.
Hotspot 2.0 venue (BSS + OSU) registration. HESSID + SSID + advertised RCOI list per ANQP. ssid is broadcast public; no PII concern.
IMS HSS — register an IMS user-profile subscription (IMPI ↔ IMPU list ↔ S-CSCF). Phase 5 voice control plane.

Lawful Intercept (CALEA / ETSI LI / 3GPP TS 33.127) — register a warrant authorizing intercept against named identifiers. warrantDocumentRef is a vault:// pointer; warrant body never persisted in graph.
Register an interconnect / wholesale agreement with a peer carrier (MNO / MVNO). Phase 3 telecom Supplier/Partner domain.
Register a physical network asset (router / fiber / antenna / battery) with serial# tracking.
5G Core SBA — register a Network Function instance with the NRF (Nnrf_NFManagement). Phase 4 control plane.
NPN — register a Network Identifier (NID) allocation. assignmentKind=self → self-assigned (collision risk); assignmentKind=coordinated → IEEE Registration Authority via OUI prefix.
NPN — enroll an existing 5G subscriber profile (Phase 4) into an SNPN or PNI-NPN with optional CAG membership and device class scope.
NTN — register a satellite operator roaming partnership (Starlink / OneWeb / Iridium / SES / Inmarsat) under an existing Phase 3 interconnect agreement.
Register an MSISDN range allocation from the regulator (E.164, country code + range bounds).
TIP Phoenix MUST optical domain — controller scope (TransportPCE / Goldstone / GNPy / vendor controller). Phase 16 transport plane.

Religious-corp social post. AT Protocol record under the writer's DID (typically an SBT-holding adherent), carrying short-form text + optional reply chain. The substrate pipeline (mst-projector → ipfs-pinner → anchor-cron) anchors the writer's MST root including these posts, so any third party can verify the post existed at a given moment without trusting this operator. Distinct from `app.bsky.feed.post`: religious-corp namespace lives at `ai.gftd.apps.threads.*`, SBT-gated write policy is enforced at the PDS layer (not in this lexicon), and the embed surface is intentionally narrow in v1 — no media, no external link unfurl, no quote-post — to bias the medium toward attestation and study over performance. Per ADR-2605172000 substrate posture.

text.description: Primary post content. May be empty when `reply` is present (e.g. silent witness).

reply.description: Reply target — required `root` (thread origin) + `parent` (immediate parent). Both fields point to existing ai.gftd.apps.threads.post records.

langs.description: BCP-47 language tags for the primary text (e.g. 'ja', 'en'). Empty = unspecified.

tags.description: Author-chosen tags. Distinct from hashtags inline in text. Bounded so the substrate doesn't carry unbounded payloads.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when the post was originally written.

root.description: Root of the thread — the first post in the conversation.

parent.description: Immediate parent post — the one this post is replying to. May equal `root` when replying to the thread origin.

main.description: Start a Baien (BitNet b1.58) LoRA-on-bf16-master fine-tune (ADR 2605092350). Trains an adapter on the bf16 master checkpoint of the BitNet trunk; the post-train re-quantization to i2_s ternary is handled inside the runner. Same H100 NVL training pod as Oka — kind='baien-lora' is the only handler-side dispatch difference. baseModel defaults to microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 when omitted.

baseModel.description: HF model id; defaults to microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16 (BAIEN_DEFAULT_TRUNK_MODEL).

requantizeAfterTrain.description: If true, re-quantize merged adapter+master to i2_s and record the ternary blob alongside the bf16 checkpoint.

perplexityDriftCeiling.description: Max allowed perplexity drift vs unquantized master on a held-out set (default 0.05 = 5%).

i2sBlobUri.description: B2 URI of the i2_s ternary-packed blob produced by re-quantization, if requantizeAfterTrain was true.

perplexityDrift.description: Measured perplexity drift vs unquantized master on the held-out set.

main.description: Train a Baien multimodal projector (image / audio-speech / audio-env) on top of a frozen BitNet trunk and a frozen off-the-shelf encoder (SigLIP-So400m / Whisper-tiny CTC / YAMNet). encoderModel.description: HF id of the frozen encoder (e.g. google/siglip-so400m-patch14-384, openai/whisper-tiny, google/yamnet).

projectorTokens.description: Number of latent tokens emitted by the projector (image=64, audio-speech=32, audio-env=16).

main.description: Baien-MX (ADR 2605101000) — train per-modality 1.58-bit projectors + the shared cross-modal fusion block on RisingWave-native multimodal samples (v_training_multimodal_sample snapshot). All NEW blocks are BitNet QAT (1.58-bit). Trunk frozen for v0. Modalities are explicit: caller declares which non-text branches to activate; text is always present.

baseModel.description: BitNet trunk HF id; defaults to microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16.

modalities.description: Non-text branches to train. Text is implicit and always active.

fusionLayerIndex.description: Trunk layer at which to insert the fusion block. Default 15 = L/2 for the 30-layer 2B trunk.

trunkFrozen.description: Freeze the BitNet trunk during training. Default true for v0.

loraOverFirst4Layers.description: Optional v1: per-modality rank-≤16 LoRA over the trunk's first 4 layers. Default false.

learningRate.description: Default LR shared by projectors that do not appear in perModalityLearningRates.

perModalityLearningRates.description: JSON-encoded {modality: lr} override map. Stored as a string because AT Lexicon does not allow free-form object values.

projectorCheckpoints.description: JSON-encoded {modality: checkpointVertexId} map, one row per trained projector (kind=baien-mx-projector-{modality}).

main.description: Start a distillation run (teacher → student). The teacher is identified by either a prior training run (runId) or by an actor DID whose Murakumo-served weights produce the labels. alpha.description: Mix between distill loss and ground-truth loss.

Cancel a production order. Per ADR-2605202800 Phase 2, cancellation before delivery writes an escrowRefund record (no on-chain tx — escrow_intent never settled). Cancellation after delivery is structurally impossible (USDC already transferred via SDK pay()). Cancellable statuses: pending / accepted / material-procurement.

productionOrderUri.description: AT URI of the production order to cancel.

cancelledByDid.description: DID of the actor requesting cancellation (customer / manufacturer / arbiter).

status.description: cancelled = order successfully transitioned to cancelled state; cannotCancel = order already in terminal state (delivered/cancelled) or past cancellable window.

escrowRefundUri.description: AT URI of the escrow refund record (when escrow_intent was used). Refund is a record-only state transition — no on-chain transfer happened, so no on-chain refund needed.

cancellableStatuses.description: List of statuses from which cancellation is allowed.

main.description: Create a B2B production order against a registered manufacturer. Per ADR-2605202800 Phase 2, payment.method='escrow_intent' opens a deferred-payment intent AT record; actual USDC transfer occurs at delivery confirmation via @etzhayyim/sdk pay(). Cancellation before delivery writes a refund record (no on-chain tx since no transfer happened).

factoryDid.description: Optional specific factory DID under manufacturer.

productSpec.description: Product specification (free-form per industry — CAD CIDs, BOM, quantities, etc.).

payment.description: Payment intent. Per ADR-2605172100 etzhayyim is on-chain only; tsukuru Phase 2 uses deferred escrow_intent (intent record at create, SDK pay() at delivery, refund record at cancel).

method.description: escrow_intent = intent record at create, pay() at delivery, refund at cancel. direct_pay = SDK pay() immediately at order create (no cancellation refund possible).

amountUsdcMicros.description: Total amount in USDC micros (6 decimals; 10 USDC = 10_000_000).

tokenContract.description: ERC-20 token contract. Default: USDC on Base (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913).

okaimonoOrderRef.description: Upstream okaimono.etzhayyim.com order AT URI (if applicable).

productionOrderUri.description: AT URI of the created production order record.

status.description: pending = order created and waiting manufacturer acceptance; rejected = pre-flight check failed (manufacturer inactive / sanctions / etc.).

escrowIntentUri.description: AT URI of the escrow intent record (if payment.method='escrow_intent').

estimatedCompletion.description: Estimated delivery date based on priority + quantity + industry profile.

estimatedDays.description: Calendar days from order acceptance to delivery.

earliestDate.description: ISO date of earliest delivery (today + estimatedDays).

estimatedCostUsdcMicros.description: Estimated USDC cost in micros (6 decimals). Phase 2 = base × quantity × priority multiplier; Phase 3 = industry-profile-driven.

updatedByDid.description: DID of the actor making the update (manufacturer / customer / arbiter).

Report a production milestone (factory-side updates as work progresses). Each milestone is an append-only AT record per ADR-2605202800 (record-log semantics, no MST mutation). Milestones do NOT change productionOrder.status — that requires updateStatus per slice 4 with state-machine validation.

evidenceCids.description: IPFS CIDs of supporting evidence (photos, QC reports, etc.).

main.description: List quality-inspection records for a production order, newest first.

productionOrderUri.description: AT URI of the productionOrder to fetch inspections for.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from previous response.

total.description: Total inspections in result set (may exceed limit; use cursor to page).

paymentSentUri.description: Bound to the inspection that triggered settlement.

main.description: Submit a quality-inspection report for a production order. When result='pass' or 'conditional_pass', the associated productionOrder transitions to status='passed' and (if escrow_intent payment) triggers on-chain USDC settlement via @etzhayyim/sdk pay(). Per ADR-2605202900 — settlement is the on-chain tx; before this call the buyer's USDC has NOT moved.

productionOrderUri.description: AT URI of the productionOrder being inspected.

inspectorDid.description: DID of the inspector (3rd-party QA agent or in-house QA actor).

result.description: pass / conditional_pass trigger settlement; fail / rework_required hold the order in production.

findings.description: Free-form findings (one per defect or observation).

certificationsVerified.description: Certifications (ISO 9001, IATF 16949, etc.) verified during this inspection.

status.description: recorded = inspection written but no settlement (fail/rework). settled = inspection passed AND escrow_intent settled on-chain. settlementFailed = inspection passed but pay() reverted (the inspection record is still written for audit; caller can retry settlement).

paymentSentUri.description: AT URI of the payment.sent record (when status='settled').

txHash.description: Base L2 tx hash of the USDC settlement (when status='settled').

Submit a 3D design request (text / image / CAD code) and start a LangGraph run that produces .glb mesh + .vox voxel artifacts on B2. Returns immediately with run_id; poll getRun for status. Per ADR-2605080700.

kind.description: Input modality. text = TRELLIS text→3D, image = ComfyUI 3D-Pack image→3D, cad = CadQuery Python exec→mesh.

prompt.description: Required when kind=text. Free-text description of the design (e.g., 'a small wooden cabin with a stone chimney').

imageUrl.description: Required when kind=image. Public URL or B2 presigned URL of the reference image.

cadCode.description: Required when kind=cad. CadQuery Python source code that builds a single Workplane / Compound and assigns it to a variable named `result`.

referenceArtifactId.description: Optional vertex_voxelforge_artifact.vertex_id of a prior artifact to use as conditioning input.

targetFormat.description: Output format(s) to materialize. 'both' produces .glb + .vox + voxel_grid.json + manifest.json.

targetVoxelDim.description: Target voxel grid edge length (cubic). 64 default. Higher = larger .vox file. Ignored when targetFormat=glb only.

palette.description: Optional explicit MagicaVoxel palette (≤256). When omitted, voxelizer auto-quantizes mesh colors with median-cut.

params.description: Free-form generator-specific parameters (e.g., { seed: 42, sampleSteps: 25 }). Passed through to TRELLIS / ComfyUI / CadQuery exec.

runId.description: LangGraph thread_id == run_id == sha256(designId). Use with getRun to poll.

status.description: Initial status. Almost always 'pending' or 'running' from this call.

estimatedSeconds.description: Heuristic ETA from generator routing. text/image≈90, cad≈15.

errors.description: Required field missing or kind mismatch.

artifacts.description: Materialized artifacts to date. Empty until export_artifacts node completes.

Append a new BMC state row (v+1). Single writer is lg-yatabase pod; the yatabase Worker forwards this request HMAC-signed. canvasJson must be valid JSON shaped like {block: {bullets:[], notes?}} for all 9 BMC blocks. operator or agent:lg-bmc may author.

createdBy.description: Optional override. Defaults to caller actor_did.

main.description: 9-row rollup per BMC block for the Studio left pane (mv_bmc_block_health). Returns hypothesis counts by status + the latest iteration timestamp per block.

avgMeasured.description: decimal string, null if no iterations yet

orgDid.description: Override the implicit org_did derived from the API key. Operator/admin only.

main.description: Fire one BMC iteration cycle on demand. Runs the bmc_iteration LangGraph inside the lg-yatabase pod (LangGraph Server + Granian). The cron schedule `0 7 * * *` invokes the same graph automatically. Use this endpoint after adding/activating a hypothesis to skip the wait.

hypothesisSlug.description: Optional override — force this hypothesis instead of the round-robin pick.

dryRun.description: Run measurement + decide but skip the iteration/decision row insert.

main.description: List persevere/pivot/kill/extend decisions ordered by created_at DESC. Filter by hypothesis slug if provided.

List BMC iterations ordered by created_at DESC. Filter by hypothesis slug if provided.
Append a status transition to vertex_bmc_hypothesis_event. UPDATE-free — current status is read from mv_bmc_hypothesis_status (DISTINCT ON latest event).

iterationVertexId.description: Optional — link the transition to the iteration that triggered it.

main.description: Coverage snapshot — counts of tenant DBs / buckets / blobs / total bytes / pending embeddings. Used by RemoteTrigger soak monitor.

blobsByTier.description: JSON {hot: bytes, warm: bytes, cold: bytes}

main.description: Create a new bucket inside the caller's yatabase tenant. Bucket name MUST be unique within the org_did. Idempotent on (org_did, bucketName).

tierPolicy.description: auto = lifecycle WARM → COLD after 30d idle

main.description: Delete a bucket. Bucket MUST be empty (no active blobs); pass `force=true` to cascade-delete all blobs first. Bytes in B2 / Vultr Object Storage are reaped asynchronously by `yata.storage.bucket.reap` BPMN.

force.description: If true, also delete all blobs in this bucket.

main.description: Delete an object. If versioning is enabled, inserts a delete marker and keeps prior versions. If versioning is disabled, marks status='deleted' and schedules byte reap. Set `purge=true` to also delete from B2 / Vultr OS immediately (irreversible).

versionId.description: When versioning is on, target a specific version.

main.description: Read an object's metadata + (optionally) inline bytes. For binary downloads on the hot path use the S3-compat REST `/s3/{bucket}/{key}` or Supabase-shape `/storage/v1/object/{bucket}/{key}` endpoints which stream the body directly from B2 / Vultr OS via SigV4. This XRPC is for control-plane reads (small payloads or metadata-only).

data.description: Base64-encoded body (omitted when metadataOnly=true or sizeBytes > 5MB).

main.description: Archived yata SQL RPC endpoint. Use createKyselyDb(env.HYPERDRIVE) for graph reads/writes.
Object existence + metadata probe (S3 HeadObject equivalent). Counts as Class B request for billing.
List all buckets owned by the caller's org_did.
List objects in a bucket. Supports prefix filter + cursor pagination. Mirrors S3 ListObjectsV2.
Abort an in-progress multipart upload. Schedules byte cleanup on B2 / Vultr OS. Idempotent.
Complete a multipart upload. Caller MUST submit the parts list with their etags in order. Returns the final blob etag + cid + sizeBytes.
Initiate a multipart upload. Returns `uploadId` for use with subsequent multipartPart / multipartComplete / multipartAbort calls. State is tracked in vertex_yata_multipart with TTL 24h.
Upload one part. partNumber must be 1..10000. Each part except the last must be at least 5 MiB. Returns the part's etag for `multipartComplete`. Counts as Class A request.

Mint a time-limited HTTPS URL for direct GET / PUT against B2 / Vultr OS, signed by yatabase using the platform-side credentials. Caller never sees the upstream provider key. URL is intended to be handed to a browser / non-yatabase client.

contentType.description: For PUT — locks the Content-Type that the eventual upload must declare.

headers.description: JSON object of additional headers the client must send (e.g. x-amz-content-sha256).

main.description: Provision a per-tenant RisingWave database for the caller's org_did. force.description: Re-provision even if a database exists for this org.

pgPasswordOnce.description: Raw PG password — returned ONCE, never persisted in plaintext.

main.description: Upload an object via XRPC. Body MUST be `application/json` carrying base64-encoded bytes for files ≤ 5 MB; for larger uploads use `multipartInit` / `multipartPart` / `multipartComplete`. The bytes go to the bucket's tier-1 storage (Vultr OS HOT or B2 WARM per bucket policy); metadata + checksum are written to vertex_yata_blob.

vaultMemberDid.description: Required when encryption=vault-e2e (caller pre-encrypts with member device key).

ifNoneMatch.description: Set to '*' for create-only semantics (fails 412 if blob exists).

main.description: Execute a read-only openCypher query against the caller's tenant graph. WRITE clauses (CREATE / MERGE / SET / DELETE) are rejected at the edge in Phase P4a; lifted in Phase 7. ADR-2605080000 D13.

parametersJson.description: JSON-encoded parameter map; nested JSON keeps Lexicon validator happy (no array-of-object inline).

format.description: Result data contents shape, Neo4j HTTP API parity.

rowsJson.description: JSON-encoded rows array; each row is an array aligned with columns.

translatedSql.description: The SQL/PGQ that was executed (for debugging).

main.description: Execute a SPARQL 1.1 SELECT or CONSTRUCT query against the caller's tenant graph. Translated to SQL/PGQ via `v_rdf_triple` view (see graph reasoner schema 2026-05-01). UPDATE / DELETE shapes are deferred to Phase 2.

rows.description: JSON-encoded rows when format=json; raw CSV/TSV otherwise.

translatedSql.description: The SQL/PGQ that was executed (for debugging).

APQC PCF (Process Classification Framework) Level-1 category record. AT Protocol record carrying one of the 13 canonical L1 process categories (v7.4) — `code` is the L1 identifier (e.g. '1.0', '13.0') and is used as the rkey verbatim for idempotent re-seeding. Per ADR-2605172000 substrate posture: replaces the legacy `vertex_open_apqc_l1` RW table with an MST + IPFS-anchored record set so the substrate pipeline (mst-projector → ipfs-pinner → anchor-cron) can anchor + replicate the L1 taxonomy without trusting this operator. Level-2 through Level-5 categories follow in later PRs as separate record lexicons (e.g. `ai.gftd.apqc.processGroup` for L2) reusing the same scaffold. Sibling lexicons under `ai.gftd.apqc.*` (`getProcess`, `materializeSubprocesses`, `coverageSnapshot`, `emitEvent`) remain as active procedures — record-vs-procedure split.

code.description: APQC PCF L1 category identifier (e.g. '1.0', '7.0', '13.0'). Format: digits + '.0' suffix for L1 (sibling levels L2/L3/L4/L5 use '1.1', '1.1.1', etc.; future PRs add separate record lexicons for those levels). Used as the AT-record rkey for idempotent seeding.

level.description: PCF hierarchy depth. Always 1 for this lexicon (sentinel — future lexicons set 2/3/4/5).

version.description: APQC PCF version (e.g. '7.4.0'). Locks the record to a published revision so changes in future PCF releases produce new records under different rkeys when the L1 numbering changes.

description.description: Optional free-text description of the category's scope.

themes.description: Optional list of cross-cutting themes the L1 category touches (e.g. 'governance', 'innovation', 'risk'). Absent in the v7.4 baseline seed; reserved for future industry-cross-reference annotations.

Mint a child did:gftd under a parent DID. ADR-0029 (revised 2026-04-19) defines two input shapes: (A) semantic path form — `{parentDid, segmentKind, segmentValue}`; (B) legacy hex Merkle form — `{parentDid, materialKind, material}`. New callers should use form (A). `pubkey` kind generates an independent P-256 keypair; other kinds are keyless and sign via the nearest ancestor key. Caller must control parent (session accountDid equal to parent or a prefix ancestor).

parentDid.description: Parent did:gftd. Either legacy flat hex form (did:gftd:{24-hex}) or semantic path form (did:gftd:{sub}:{id}:{lexicon}). Recursive form accepted up to depth 6.

segmentKind.description: ADR-0029 revised (semantic path) form. `sub`: owning cluster label. `id`: local identifier (TID / slug / rkey). `lexicon`: governing NSID. `role`: capability sub-identity. `pubkey`: generate new P-256 key. `grant`: consent / delegate. Mutually exclusive with `materialKind`.

segmentValue.description: Semantic segment value (NSID-compatible). Regex: [a-z][a-z0-9-]*(?:\.[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)*. Required when segmentKind is set.

materialKind.description: ADR-0029 草案 (hex Merkle) form — legacy Phase 1 grandfather path. Kept for existing adopters until they migrate to segmentKind/segmentValue. `pubkey`: generate new P-256 key. `role`: capability DID (requires roleName + holderDid). `matter`: domain entity (requires matterTid). `doc`: content-addressed document (requires docCid). `grant`: consent/delegate (requires granteeDid + grantExpiresAt + grantNonceHex). `session`: one-shot scoped capability (requires parentSessionJti + sessionNonceHex).

material.description: Kind-specific material for legacy materialKind form. Required keys depend on materialKind.

handle.description: Optional handle to attach (typically only for pubkey kind).

did.description: Newly minted child did:gftd (full recursive form).

segmentValue.description: Echo of input segmentValue (semantic form only).

materialKind.description: Echo of input materialKind (legacy hex form only).

materialHashProof.description: Hex-encoded materialBytes (legacy hex form only). Verifiers recompute the child hash from this.

Deploy the caller's ERC-4337 smart account on the gftd private chain (chainId 260425) by resolving the caller to an ERC725 root DID, then calling `GftdActorRegistry.activate(rootDidHash, [packedPasskeyPubkey])`. Legacy did:gftd/did:web sessions must already be linked through `GftdRootIdentityRegistry`; this procedure no longer hashes legacy DIDs directly. Caller must hold a session (passkey-first policy). The Worker reads the caller's primary passkey credential from D1 (`passkey_credentials` table), strips the 0x04 prefix from the 65-byte uncompressed P-256 pubkey to get a 64-byte X||Y owner, signs a sealer-sponsored EIP-155 legacy tx with the SEALER_PRIV secret, and submits via `https://geth.etzhayyim.com/eth_sendRawTransaction`. Idempotent on the contract side (re-activating returns the existing address). On success returns the same shape as `getActorAccount`.

main.description: Issue an EIP-4361 (SIWE) message for the caller to sign with an Ethereum EOA or Coinbase Smart Wallet-compatible account. Caller must already hold a valid session (passkey-first policy, ADR-0074) that resolves to an ERC725 root identity. The returned message embeds the wallet address, the configured private chain ID, a server-issued nonce, and an expiration. The nonce is single-use and tied to the caller's ERC725 root DID; legacy did:gftd/did:web values are accepted only as facade lookup inputs.

main.description: Verify an EIP-4361 SIWE message, then link the proven Ethereum EOA or ERC-1271 smart-account address to the caller's ERC725 root identity. EOA signatures are verified by ERC-191 recovery; Coinbase Smart Wallet / contract-account signatures are verified with ERC-1271 isValidSignature. On success, persists `provider='coinbase-smart-wallet'` for smart accounts or `provider='ethereum'` for plain EOA under the ERC725 root DID, recomputes actor.score, and emits the corresponding did:pkh:eip155:<chainId>:<address> wallet alias.

name.description: GFTD extension: human-readable conversation name (for group convos)

kind.description: GFTD extension: conversation kind (dm, group, channel, project, etc.)

members.description: Conversation members. Uses official chat.bsky profile type.

status.description: Compatible with chat.bsky.convo.defs#convoView.status

description: Create a conversation. Extends chat.bsky.convo.getConvoForMembers concept — adds name, kind for group/channel convos.

kind.description: GFTD extension: conversation kind

members.description: Initial member DIDs. Compatible with chat.bsky.convo member model.

description: GFTD extension: edit a message in a conversation. No official chat.bsky equivalent.
GFTD extension: message forwarding record. No official chat.bsky equivalent.
GFTD extension: get a message thread. Returns messages as chat.bsky.convo.defs#messageView compatible objects.
GFTD extension: conversation invite record. No official chat.bsky equivalent.
Conversation member record. Extends chat.bsky.convo member concept with roles.

profile.description: Member profile via official chat.bsky type.

role.description: GFTD extension: member role in conversation

description: Extended message record. Superset of chat.bsky.convo.defs#messageView — adds kind, contentType, encryption support.

facets.description: Annotations of text (mentions, URLs, hashtags, etc). Compatible with app.bsky.richtext.facet.

embed.description: Embedded record reference. Compatible with app.bsky.embed.record.

kind.description: GFTD extension: message kind (text, system, agent, etc.)

contentType.description: GFTD extension: MIME content type for rich payloads

encrypted.description: GFTD extension: whether this message is E2E encrypted via ai.gftd.signal

description: GFTD extension: pinned message record. No official chat.bsky equivalent.
GFTD extension: online presence tracking. No official chat.bsky equivalent.
Conversation-scoped profile. Extends chat.bsky.actor.defs#profileViewBasic with per-convo overrides.
Extended reaction record. Superset of chat.bsky.convo.defs#reactionView — stored as a repo record.

reactor.description: The DID of the reactor. Compatible with chat.bsky.convo.defs#reactionViewSender.

description: GFTD extension: explicit read receipt record. Official chat.bsky uses updateRead RPC instead.
GFTD extension: search messages across conversations. Results contain chat.bsky.convo.defs#messageView compatible objects.
Send a message to a conversation. Superset of chat.bsky.convo.sendMessage — adds kind, contentType, encryption.

facets.description: Annotations of text. Compatible with chat.bsky.convo.defs#messageInput.facets.

kind.description: GFTD extension: message kind

description: Send message with payload. Superset of chat.bsky.convo.sendMessage — adds payload, kind, contentType for rich messaging.

kind.description: GFTD extension: message kind

main.description: Evaluate a DMN 1.3 decision table. Supports hit policies: UNIQUE, FIRST, ANY, COLLECT, RULE_ORDER. Uses FEEL expression evaluation for conditions.

did.description: Actor DID (optional, for graph lookup scope)

inputs.description: Input variables keyed by input column label

dmnXml.description: Optional inline DMN XML (bypasses graph lookup)

main.description: Get a deployed DMN decision model by decision key.
Server-side SELECT one transferRequest row by rkey (ADR-2605111200). Replaces direct Worker→Hyperdrive SELECT.
Server-side INSERT of a transferOutcome row into vertex_dns_transferOutcome (ADR-2605111200). Final terminal state of the Squarespace → Cloudflare transfer workflow.
Server-side INSERT of a transferStep row into vertex_dns_transferStep (ADR-2605111200). Replaces direct Worker→Hyperdrive INSERT. Caller is sqExporter / cfRegistrar.

rkey.description: Record key, unique per (actorDid, transferRequestUri, step)

main.description: Initiate a domain transfer from Squarespace to Cloudflare. Creates the ai.gftd.apps.dns.transferRequest record on the cfRegistrar sub-DID; the yorishiro-squarespace sqExporter picks it up via Follow and drives the 5-step release workflow. Requires ClassA (3 signers, high) approval before status transitions to approved.

domain.description: FQDN to transfer (e.g. example.com). Must currently be held by Squarespace.

requesterDid.description: Optional: caller DID override. Defaults to the session DID.

approvals.description: ClassA signer DIDs (3 required before sqExporter proceeds). May be provided later via a follow-up approval record.

transferRequestUri.description: AT URI of the created transferRequest record

transferRequestRkey.description: rkey == projectConvoId for the per-transfer project convo

status.description: approved only if 3 ClassA signers were supplied in-band

main.description: Terminal record for a domain transfer. onCommit of this collection triggers (a) zone DID creation (did:web:dns.etzhayyim.com:zone:{domain_slug}) via cfRegistrar, (b) ai.gftd.apps.dns.ownershipTransfer write, (c) T1 social announce via derive rule.

rollbackSteps.description: Ordered list of step names rolled back on failure

main.description: Domain transfer request record. Created by cfRegistrar actor on user-initiated transfer (ClassA 3 signers required). sqExporter follows this collection and starts browser automation on commit. transferId = rkey = project convoId.

fromRegistrar.description: Source registrar (only squarespace supported in v1)

requesterDid.description: DID of user who initiated the transfer

projectConvoId.description: Convo room scoping all transferStep records

main.description: Progress record for a single step of the Squarespace → Cloudflare transfer workflow. Emitted by sqExporter (steps 1-4) and cfRegistrar (step 5). Sensitive fields (authCode) MUST be signal:v1: encrypted — never plaintext in a federable Repo record.

transferRequestUri.description: AT URI of the parent ai.gftd.apps.dns.transferRequest

actorDid.description: Which actor DID executed this step

bindZoneFileUri.description: B2 blob URI for exported BIND zone file (step 4 only)

cfTransferId.description: Cloudflare Registrar API transfer job id (step 5 only)

main.description: Deploy a DoDAF v2.02 architecture view for an actor DID. References to BPMN (OV-5b/OV-6c), DMN (OV-6a), and form schemas must be via their deployed IDs (bpmnProcessKey/dmnDecisionKey/formKey).
Get a deployed DoDAF v2 view by viewId (optionally scoped to DID).
List deployed DoDAF v2 views, optionally filtered by DID or viewpoint (AV/CV/DIV/OV/PV/SV/StdV/SvcV).
Validate the DoDAF v2 viewset for a DID: checks AV-1 presence, OV↔SV traceability, CV-2 ↔ capability declarations, and BPMN/DMN/form ref integrity.
Get a Camunda form definition by form key. Returns form schema, components, and variable mappings.
List pending form tasks awaiting user submission.
Submit form data for a pending FormTask. Updates the task status to 'submitted' and stores variable mappings.

data.description: Form field values keyed by component key

wasmCid.description: CIDv1 (b base32 + raw codec + sha2-256) of the wasm binary, or of the source tree while build_status='sources_ready' (P2).

wasmUrl.description: B2 presigned URL of the .wasm binary once the build completes; empty during P2.

jsUrl.description: B2 presigned URL of the wasm-bindgen JS glue (renamed to main.js for stable paths). Consumed by the playtest shell to dynamic-import the entry fn.

screenshotCidsJson.description: JSON array of B2 screenshot CIDs captured at frame timestamps.

issuesJson.description: JSON array of {category, severity, description} feeding the next revise iteration.

mechanic.description: JSON-serialised game mechanic descriptor consumed by kami-codegen.

scene.description: JSON-serialised scene + camera + biome config (kami-pipelines adapters).

score.description: Critic score 0-1, gates downstream generateGame derive.

lineageParent.description: specId of the parent revision when iteration>0.

subDid.description: Per-title path-based DID, e.g. did:web:gameka.etzhayyim.com:game:quarry-rune. Auto-served by host-sdk did.json (ADR-0023).

playUrl.description: Public play URL, e.g. https://game-play.etzhayyim.com/{slug}. Resolves to a kami-app shell that loads the latest -built artefact for this title.

version.description: Title version string, defaults to v1. Subsequent revise iterations bump this.

profileUri.description: AT URI of the sub-DID's app.bsky.actor.profile record. Holds displayName=title, description=brief+playUrl, disclaimer (AI-Agent unofficial), and avatar reference. Created in publishGame.bpmn Task_RegisterProfile before the launch post so the post lands on a populated timeline.

publishPostUri.description: AT URI of the launch announcement post (app.bsky.feed.post by subDid).

avatarDataUri.description: data:image/png;base64,… of the procedural identicon rendered from slug + biome by gameka.avatar.render (ADR 2604250900 P10). Used by the playtest shell as <link rel="icon"> and og:image. Empty for pre-P10 titles.

specId.description: spec_id of a vertex_gameka_spec row produced by proposeGame.

wasmCid.description: CIDv1-shape content hash of the kami-app source tree (P2). Becomes the wasm binary CID once the wasm-pack runner lands (P3).

main.description: Headless WebGPU playtest of a built kami-app artifact, scored by visual + perf critics. Closes the QA loop by deriving publishGame on pass, or proposeGame (revise) on fail with priorSpecs feedback.

iteration.description: Current QA loop iteration. 0 = first attempt; >=3 stops the loop without revise.

priorSpecs.description: Prior iteration outcomes feeding the LangGraph studio's planner so the revise loop avoids the same trap. Emitted by playtestGame on outcome='revise'.

main.description: Mint a per-game sub-DID, write a gameTitle record, and post the launch announcement as the sub-DID. Triggered by playtestGame on outcome='pass'.

Autonomous studio tick — timer-started (R/PT2H), no XRPC caller. Scans media-gamers trends, builds a brief via LLM, and derives proposeGame when tick_live_mode=true. During the 14-day soak (tick_live_mode=false), only audit is emitted.

description: Record of a single amendment / repeal / insertion applied to a statute article. `supersedesArticleDid` points at the prior-version article DID; the new version is addressable as a separate `ai.gftd.apps.houbun.article` record (new blake3 hash). See ADR-0052.

statuteRef.description: AT URI of the affected statute record.

articleRef.description: AT URI of the new (post-amendment) article record. Omitted for whole-statute repeals.

supersedesArticleDid.description: Article DID being replaced. NULL for pure insertions.

amendingStatuteRef.description: AT URI of the statute that enacted this amendment, if available.

diffUri.description: Optional pointer to a unified diff / HTML diff published by the source.

props.description: Opaque JSON string for source-specific metadata.

description: A single article / section of a statute — the atomic unit of citation. `articleDid` is content-addressed via blake3_prefix12(jurisdiction + statuteId + articleNo + amendedAt) so amendments produce a new DID; lineage is captured by `ai.gftd.apps.houbun.amendmentEvent`. See ADR-0052.

statuteRef.description: AT URI of the parent `ai.gftd.apps.houbun.statute` record.

articleNo.description: Article number as printed in the source (e.g. '第九条', '§1001', 'Art. 7').

title.description: Optional article heading if the source provides one.

text.description: Full article body in the authoritative language.

blake3Hash.description: 12-char hex prefix of blake3(jurisdiction|statuteId|articleNo|amendedAt). Used as the DID suffix.

amendedAt.description: Effective date of the version captured in `text`. NULL for the original enactment.

props.description: Opaque JSON string for source-specific metadata (e.g. e-Gov 条文番号 + 項 + 号).

main.description: Crawl EU legal acts from EUR-Lex via its public SPARQL endpoint (https://publications.europa.eu/webapi/rdf/sparql). Phase 2 MVP ingests regulation / directive / decision metadata by CELEX number. Full act text fetch lands in a later PR. Writes to vertex_houbun_statute. Attribution required (CC-BY-SA via ©European Union).

celex.description: CELEX identifier (e.g. '32016R0679' for GDPR). Mutually exclusive with since.

since.description: ISO 8601 date — fetch acts registered after this cutoff.

actType.description: Limit to a single act type. Applies to since mode.

main.description: Crawl one or more Japanese statutes from the e-Gov 法令 API v2 and write statute / article records to Hyperdrive. Idempotent: existing (jurisdiction, statuteId) is updated; existing (articleDid) rows are skipped.

lawId.description: e-Gov lawId (e.g. '325AC0000000131' for 民法). Mutually exclusive with `since`.

since.description: ISO 8601 date — fetch all statutes updated after this cutoff.

limit.description: Max statutes to ingest in one call (default 10, max 200). Applies to `since` mode only.

main.description: Crawl US federal statutory material (CFR / USC) from GovInfo bulkdata. Phase 2 MVP ingests CFR title-level metadata from the free JSON index (https://www.govinfo.gov/bulkdata/json/CFR); full title XML parse (part / section / paragraph) follows in a later PR. Writes to vertex_houbun_statute. Public domain.

titleNumber.description: CFR title (1–50) or USC title (1–54). Omit to ingest the full title index.

year.description: Edition year (e.g. 2024 for CFR, 2023 for USC).

limit.description: Max statutes to ingest in one call (default 50, max 500).

main.description: Crawl international treaties from the UN Treaty Collection (https://treaties.un.org/). Writes to vertex_houbun_treaty. Phase 2 contract surface is fixed; the parser lands in a later PR — currently a polite-crawl scaffold.

unRegNo.description: UN Treaty Registration Number. Mutually exclusive with since.

since.description: ISO 8601 date — fetch treaties registered after this cutoff.

description: Record of a statute / regulation / by-law as an addressable document. Full article bodies are emitted as separate `ai.gftd.apps.houbun.article` records linked via `statute_ref`. See ADR-0052.

statuteId.description: Source-native statute identifier (e.g. e-Gov lawId, GovInfo packageId, CELEX number).

titleNative.description: Title in the original language if different from `title`.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the authoritative text.

props.description: Opaque JSON string for source-specific metadata.

description: Record of an international treaty / convention. Parties and optional treaty-specific articles are modeled alongside the same `article` record type (statuteRef points at the treaty). See ADR-0052.

parties.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes or supra-national actors (e.g. 'eu', 'un').

description: Resolve identity. Superset of com.atproto.identity.resolveHandle / resolveDid — returns full identityInfo including didDoc.

ADR-0029 — submit a did:gftd op (create | update | deactivate). For 'create', the server verifies CID(op) matches the last segment of did. The op is persisted to vertex_gftd_op_log and the identity row is upserted into vertex_gftd_identity.

did.description: Target did:gftd. For create the did MUST equal parent_did + ':' + CID(op). For update/deactivate the did MUST already exist.

op.description: Canonical genesis / update / deactivate op body (JSON mirror of the DAG-CBOR encoded op). Must contain v=1, type, parent, segment, vm, alsoKnownAs, service, createdAt per ADR-0029.

prev.description: CID of previous op (required for update/deactivate)

sig.description: Signature over CID(op), base64url. Required for update/deactivate; optional for create (genesis is self-attesting via CID).

sigKid.description: verificationMethod id used to sign (required when sig is present)

errors.name: InvalidDid
errors.description: did syntax invalid for did:gftd

errors.name: CidMismatch
errors.description: CID(op) does not match DID last segment (create) or prev_cid chain (update)

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.description: sig verification failed

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: did not found for update/deactivate

errors.name: Conflict
errors.description: op already exists or out-of-order seq

main.description: Insert a content-addressed blob (sha256 keyed). Idempotent — re-insert of same content returns existing hash. Large bytes tiered to B2; small bytes stored inline in vertex_repository_blob.

ownerDid.description: Owning Actor DID. Used for authorization scope; blobs themselves are globally deduplicated.

content.description: Blob bytes. Base64url-encoded on the wire. No size cap here — runtime tiers >16KB to B2.

mimeType.description: Optional hint used only for editor preview. Not part of the hash input.

tier.description: inline = stored in vertex_repository_blob.inline_text; r2 = vertex_repository_blob.bytes_ref

deduplicated.description: true if identical hash already existed (INSERT was no-op).

errors.name: UnauthorizedWriter
errors.description: Caller lacks write permission for ownerDid.

errors.name: SizeLimit
errors.description: Blob exceeds max configured byte size.

main.description: Insert a commit object. commitHash = sha256 over canonical-encoded {treeHash, parentHashes, authorDid, committerDid, message, timestamp}. Signature field is NOT included in the hash input so the same commit can be re-signed by key rotation without hash drift. Immutable once written.

parentHashes.description: 0 parents = root commit; 1 = normal; 2+ = merge. Order significant.

committerDid.description: Defaults to authorDid. Differs only for CI / bot commits pushed on behalf of a human author.

timestamp.description: Author timestamp. Server stamps committer timestamp independently.

signatureEs256.description: Base64url ES256 signature over commitHash by authorDid signing key (ADR-0010). Required; bootstrap literal 'bootstrap' accepted only for the very first commit of a freshly created DID.

errors.name: MissingParent
errors.description: A parentHash does not resolve.

errors.name: MissingTree
errors.description: treeHash does not resolve.

errors.name: InvalidSignature
errors.description: ES256 signature does not verify against authorDid's signing key.

main.description: Create a ref (branch / tag / HEAD) pointing to an initial commit. Ref names are unique per (ownerDid, kind).

ownerDid.description: Actor DID that owns this ref (= Repository identity per ADR-0039).

refName.description: Branch/tag name. Slashes allowed (e.g. 'feat/new-block'). 'HEAD' reserved for kind=head.

kind.description: branch = mutable via updateRef; tag = immutable (updateRef rejects); head = symbolic pointer to another branch.

initialCommit.description: commitHash this ref starts pointing at. Required for branch/tag; symbolic target for head.

errors.name: ReservedName
errors.description: Ref name collides with a reserved symbol (e.g. 'HEAD' with kind != head).

main.description: Insert a tree (directory snapshot). Hash is sha256 over canonical-sorted (path ASC) entry list. Idempotent.

entries.description: Directory entries. MUST NOT contain duplicate paths.

treeHash.description: sha256 hex of canonical entry list

errors.name: DuplicatePath
errors.description: Two entries share the same path.

errors.name: MissingObject
errors.description: Referenced blob/tree hash does not exist.

path.description: Path segment relative to this tree (no leading slash, no '..').

mode.description: blob = regular file, exec = executable file, tree = nested directory

main.description: Compute tree diff between two commits. Supports path-scoped and binary-aware output.

pathPrefix.description: Scope diff to entries under this path prefix.

unified.description: Context lines per hunk. 0 = no context. -1 = full file.

includeContent.description: If false, returns only file-level add/delete/modify summary (fast).

binary.description: True if either side is detected as binary; hunks omitted.

hunks.description: Unified diff hunks. Omitted when includeContent=false or binary=true.

main.description: Fetch blob bytes by sha256 hash. Global dedup — no owner scope in read path.

content.description: Full blob bytes. Transparent R2 pull when tier = r2.

main.description: Fetch a commit object by hash.

signatureValid.description: Server verifies on read. True if signature verifies against authorDid's signing key at authorTimestamp.

main.description: Fetch a tree by hash, returning canonical-sorted entry list.

recursive.description: If true, inline nested trees up to maxDepth.

truncated.description: True if recursive expansion hit maxDepth.

main.description: List refs owned by a single DID, or by all DIDs in a path-DID subtree (ADR-0019). Subtree mode gives Project/App-level 'repo view' without a Repository container.

ownerDid.description: Exact DID scope. Mutually exclusive with subtreeRootDid.

subtreeRootDid.description: Traverse edge_path_child* from this DID. Returns refs for the root and all descendants. Mutually exclusive with ownerDid.

main.description: Walk commit ancestry from a ref or commit. Returns linearized history (first-parent by default) or full DAG.

ownerDid.description: Required when startRef is set.

startRef.description: Ref name to start from. Mutually exclusive with startCommit.

startCommit.description: Commit hash to start from. Mutually exclusive with startRef.

mode.description: firstParent = linearize via parent[0]; fullDag = topological order including merges.

pathFilter.description: Only include commits whose tree diff touches this path prefix.

authorDid.description: Only include commits authored by this DID.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor (commitHash of last returned entry).

errors.name: InvalidParameters
errors.description: Neither startRef nor startCommit given, or both.

description: AT Record written to the owning DID's AT Repo every time updateRef succeeds. Travels the com.atproto.sync firehose so peer PDS instances can mirror the ref graph without polling. Immutable per rkey; ref history reconstructed by concatenating all refUpdate records for a given (ownerDid, refName).

reason.description: Required when updateKind in {rolledBack, forcePushed}. Free text logged to audit trail.

committerDid.description: DID that invoked updateRef. May differ from the commit's authorDid.

main.description: The only mutable write in ADR-0039. Move a ref's points-to from expectedCurrent to newCommit. CAS-safe by default; force=true skips ancestry check. Emits OCEL event ref:updated / ref:rolledBack / ref:forcePushed and a firehose ai.gftd.repository.refUpdate record.

expectedCurrent.description: Current head commit hash the caller expects. Server rejects with RefOutOfDate if mismatch. Omit only with force=true.

force.description: If true, skip fast-forward/ancestry check. Generates OCEL event ref:forcePushed.

reason.description: Human-readable reason. Required when force=true or when newCommit is an ancestor of current (= rollback). Logged to OCEL event payload.

updateKind.description: fastForward = new is descendant of previous; rolledBack = new is ancestor; forcePushed = neither (requires force=true).

firehoseCid.description: CID of the ai.gftd.repository.refUpdate record written to the owner DID's AT Repo.

errors.name: RefOutOfDate
errors.description: expectedCurrent does not match server state.

errors.name: ImmutableRef
errors.description: Ref kind=tag cannot be updated.

errors.name: ForceRequired
errors.description: newCommit is not a descendant of previousCommit; caller must set force=true with a reason.

errors.name: ReasonRequired
errors.description: force=true or rollback without reason.

main.description: Generic HTTP fetch primitive (ADR-2605082000 §2 follow-up). Wraps httpx for outbound requests. Read-only by default (GET / HEAD); POST/PUT/DELETE require explicit `method` arg + `allowWrite=true` flag (no implicit writes). Replaces per-actor httpx py_primitive nodes (copyright_*, isbn_*, …). Body-bytes are returned as a base64 string when not text.

main.description: Generic JSON extract primitive — navigate a parsed-JSON object via a safe dotted path. Bridges `http.fetch` (which returns body string) and downstream nodes that need a sub-tree (e.g. `message.items` from a Crossref response). Path syntax: `a.b.c` walks objects; `a.b[2].c` walks list indices; `a.*` flattens an object's values into a list. No eval, no JSONPath/JMESPath language — defensive subset only.

json.description: Parsed-JSON source. Either a string (will be JSON.parse-d) or an already-decoded object/array.

default.description: Value to return when the path doesn't resolve. Default: null.

main.description: Generic free-form LLM chat primitive (ADR-2605082000 §2 follow-up). Wraps task_generic_llm_chat — replaces per-actor LLM-only py_primitive nodes (animeka_*.generate_storyboard / generate_background / generate_scene_text, etc.) with a single data-resolved tool. Config-only prompt + tier; node binders pass `system` / `user` / `maxTokens` / `temperature` / `tier` via config.args.

schema.description: Response from underlying task_generic_llm_chat (content + usage + raw envelope as available).

main.description: Generic write SQL primitive (INSERT / UPDATE / UPSERT only). Strict guards: rejects SELECT (use sql.query) / DELETE / DROP / TRUNCATE / GRANT / DDL. Requires `confirmWrite=true` defense-in-depth flag. If `rows` is supplied, runs executemany() batch INSERT; otherwise single execute. Replaces per-actor sa_executemany / sa_rowcount py_primitive nodes (copyright_ingest insert_crossref, etc.).

sql.description: INSERT / UPDATE / UPSERT statement. Single statement; trailing semicolon optional.

params.description: Named bind params for single-row execute().

rows.description: Row dicts for batch executemany() — each dict's keys must match SQL named binds.

main.description: Generic read-only SQL SELECT primitive (ADR-2605082000 §2 follow-up). Wraps `pymagatama.db_alchemy.sa_query` so LangGraph topology nodes can run a parameterised SELECT without per-actor py_primitive code. Strict guards: only statements starting with SELECT / WITH are accepted; INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE / DDL are rejected. For domain writes use the actor-specific MCP tool (or `tools.audit.emit` for OCEL rows).

sql.description: SELECT or WITH … SELECT statement. Single statement; trailing semicolon optional. Parameter binds via `params` (psycopg2 named-style %(key)s).

main.description:
Generic per-row transform — applies a declarative mapping to each input row. Bridges fetched arrays (e.g. http.fetch + json.extract output) and downstream sql.exec INSERT rows that need restructured fields. Mapping grammar (Python-free, defensive subset):

  - `"$.path[0].key"` → copy from input row at the given dotted path (same grammar as json.extract)
  - `{"const": <any>}` → literal constant value
  - `{"fmt": "prefix-{a.b}-suffix"}` → format string with {paths} substituted from input row
  - `{"path": "$.x", "default": <any>}` → path with fallback when missing

`defaults` is a dict of constant fields applied to every output row (overridden by `mapping`).

input.description: Source rows. Each item must be an object.

mapping.description: Dict of {outputKey: spec} where spec is either a string (= path) or one of the structured forms above.

defaults.description: Constant fields applied to every output row (overridden by mapping).

rows.description: Transformed rows. Same length as input (or fewer if any row failed validation — `skipped` count tracks that).

Don't use it until it is moved out of `unspecced` or your application WILL break) Get additional posts under a thread e.g. replies hidden by threadgate. Based on an anchor post at any depth of the tree, returns top-level replies below that anchor. It does not include ancestors nor the anchor itself. main.description: (NOTE: this endpoint is under development and WILL change without notice. Don't use it until it is moved out of `unspecced` or your application WILL break) Get posts in a thread. It is based in an anchor post at any depth of the tree, and returns posts above it (recursively resolving the parent, without further branching to their replies) and below it (recursive replies, with branching to their replies). Does not require auth, but additional metadata and filtering will be applied for authed requests.

anchor.description: Reference (AT-URI) to post record. This is the anchor post, and the thread will be built around it. It can be any post in the tree, not necessarily a root post.

above.description: Whether to include parents above the anchor.

below.description: How many levels of replies to include below the anchor.

thread.description: A flat list of thread items. The depth of each item is indicated by the depth property inside the item.

hasOtherReplies.description: Whether this thread has additional replies. If true, a call can be made to the `getPostThreadOtherV2` endpoint to retrieve them.

depth.description: The nesting level of this item in the thread. Depth 0 means the anchor item. Items above have negative depths, items below have positive depths.
