description: AT Protocol projection of an AgentAuthorityToken (AAT) mint event on Base L2 (per ADR-2605231500). One record per AAT, indexed by the on-chain tokenId. The AAT is a soulbound ERC-721 + ERC-5192 token analogous to AdherentRegistry but for AI agents: a human Steward (who holds an Adherent SBT) delegates a scoped, revocable authority to one agent DID. Constitutional: AAT MUST NOT confer voting power (only Adherent SBT = 1 human = 1 vote per ADR-2605192100 §1.16). AAT is the authority chain that lets AI agents drive UNSPSC commodity flows end-to-end without being mistaken for human members.

tokenId.description: Base L2 AgentAuthorityToken ERC-721 token ID (monotonic, starting at 1 per OpenZeppelin convention).

agentDid.description: DID of the AI agent receiving the AAT. Typically `did:web:c{unspsc-code}.etzhayyim.com` for UNSPSC commodity agents (per 2026-05-23 commit 9cd4fe73d).

stewardDid.description: DID of the human Steward delegating authority. MUST hold an Adherent SBT (verified on-chain via AdherentRegistry.locked(stewardAdherentTokenId)). Revocable by the Steward or by Council multisig.

stewardAdherentTokenId.description: Adherent SBT token ID that grounds the delegation. Allows verifiers to trace agent action → human Steward → constitutional accountability.

mintTxHash.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte transaction hash of the AgentAuthorityToken.mint() call. Prefix `0x`, lowercase.

scope.description: What the agent is allowed to do — UNSPSC prefixes, esign purposes, per-envelope value cap.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the AAT auto-revokes. MUST be present (no perpetual authority).

revokedAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp when the AAT was manually revoked (by Steward or Council). Absence means the AAT is currently valid.

revocationReason.description: Free-form Markdown reason for revocation. Present iff revokedAt is set.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of AAT mint observation.

unspscPrefixes.description: UNSPSC code prefixes the agent may handle (e.g., `4322` for laboratory + medical supplies). Empty array means no scope; `00` means all codes (Council-only authority).

purposes.description: Which `app.etzhayyim.esign.envelope.purpose` enum values the AAT permits. MUST exclude `purchase`/`sale`/`subscription`/`lease`/`tip` — those are not valid Charter-aligned purposes.

valueCap.description: Per-envelope value ceiling. Phase 1 interpretation: maximum item count per envelope. Phase 2 interpretation: maximum USDC-equivalent (6 decimals) per envelope. valueCap=0 means no value gate at this AAT (rely on Council escalation threshold in the per-UNSPSC processManifest).

main.description: Audit event — substrate-level emission for any operation that touches encrypted records, consent capabilities, or tombstones. Stored in the audit subject's PDS (the actor designated as `auditWebhookDid`). Public record by design — auditability is the constitutional invariant; the event carries no PHI because it only references CIDs and DIDs. Per ADR-2605231700.

actorDid.description: Who performed the action (clinician / agent / pharmacy / iryo)

context.description: Optional non-PHI structured context (e.g. iryoClaimRef, ipAddressHash, sessionId hash)

ipPrefixHash.description: First-3-octets hash, NOT full IP — avoids tracking, gives ASN-class info

auditChainPrev.description: CID of the previous audit.event from the same auditor — forms a hash-chain

main.description: Patient-issued, DID-bound, scope-limited, time-bound delegation token. Grants the `granteeDid` permission to operate on a defined set of resources (typically `app.etzhayyim.karute.*` AT URIs) under a specific stated purpose. Always signed by the granter; revocable. Used as the bridging primitive between etzhayyim (PHI custody) and vendor iryo.gftd.ai (insurance billing) and any third-party EHR / second-opinion clinic. Per ADR-2605231400.

granterDid.description: DID of the principal granting access (patient or authorized representative)

granteeDid.description: DID of the recipient actor authorized to act

purpose.description: Stated purpose — narrows the lawful basis of the grantee's processing. `deploy-execution` is the agent-led-deploy authority extension per ADR-2605232000 — bound to a specific agent DID with scope = deploy.* NSIDs.

scope.description: Lexicon NSIDs the grantee may read (e.g. ['app.etzhayyim.karute.encounter']). Use wildcards sparingly; least-privilege is the default.

resourceUris.description: Optional explicit AT URI allowlist. When empty, all records under `scope` collections in `granterDid`'s PDS are in-scope.

downstreamRedistribution.description: If false, grantee MUST NOT re-issue derived capabilities to other actors

auditWebhookDid.description: Optional auditor DID that receives an event each time the capability is invoked

delegationPath.description: Optional DID chain proving this capability was issued under a parent capability (e.g. a guardian capability for a minor patient)

signature.description: Ed25519 signature by `granterDid` over the canonicalized payload (everything except signature itself)

main.description: Ephemeral scoped JWT issued by `e7m agent-token` for agent-led deploy steps. Per ADR-2605232000. The token itself is a JWS (Ed25519); this record captures the audit-meta projection of issued tokens (token CID is hash-of-JWS-payload). Lives in the issuer's PDS, NOT the agent's — issuer-DID is the principal of record.

issuerDid.description: DID of the human or system that issued the token (typically a Steward)

agentDid.description: DID of the agent the token is bound to (e.g., did:web:claude-agent.etzhayyim.com)

capabilityUri.description: AT URI of the parent app.etzhayyim.consent.capability authorizing this token issuance

scopes.description: Action NSIDs the token permits. e.g., ['deploy.cfWorker:karute-did-web', 'deploy.k8s:lg-karute', 'deploy.pages:karute']

jwsHash.description: SHA-256 hex of the issued JWS string (the token value never persists; only its hash for audit correlation)

auditEventUri.description: AT URI of the app.etzhayyim.audit.event record for this issuance (eventType='deploy.token.issued')

main.description: Audit record for an agent-led deploy stage. Written by the agent after each `e7m actor deploy --only <stage>` step completes. Per ADR-2605232000. Public record — carries no PHI, only DIDs + target NSIDs + outcome + L2-anchor-pending-seq.

stewardDid.description: DID of the human Steward who issued the capability authorizing this deploy

capabilityUri.description: AT URI of the parent consent capability (purpose=deploy-execution)

agentTokenJwsHash.description: SHA-256 of the JWS used for this specific call (correlates to app.etzhayyim.deploy.agentToken.jwsHash)

nsid.description: e.g. deploy.cfWorker / deploy.k8s.deployment / deploy.k8s.service / deploy.pages / deploy.docker.image

identifier.description: Concrete resource name (e.g. karute-did-web / lg-karute / karute-pages / ghcr.io/etzhayyim/lg-karute)

command.description: Sanitized command executed (no secrets); e.g. 'wrangler deploy' / 'kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml'

commitSha.description: git commit the deploy was built from

keyId.description: DID-doc verification method id of agentDid

description: Per-recipient key-wrap for an app.etzhayyim.encrypted.record. Symmetric record key encrypted under a Signal session between sender DID and recipient DID. Recipient enumerates this collection in their own PDS to discover read-caps. One keyWrap record per (encrypted record, recipient) pair. Per ADR-2605181100.

recordUri.description: AT URI of the encrypted record this key unlocks. Optional — recipient can also discover records by enumerating keyId matches.

ciphertext.description: libsignal-encrypted (symmetric record key). Decrypts via the established Signal session between sender and recipient.

signalSessionId.description: Identifier of the Signal session under which `ciphertext` was produced. Recipient SDK uses this to select the correct session for decrypt.

description: Tahoe-pattern AEAD ciphertext envelope on AT Protocol MST. Plaintext is an arbitrary CBOR-encoded record (typically an inner-lexicon body). The CID over this envelope inherits the MST verify-cap and L2 anchor finality from ADR-2605172000. Read-cap = symmetric key (XChaCha20-Poly1305) distributed via app.etzhayyim.encrypted.keyWrap. Per ADR-2605181100.

nonce.description: AEAD nonce, unique per record. 24 bytes for XChaCha20-Poly1305.

ciphertext.description: AEAD ciphertext over CBOR(plaintext). AAD MUST bind the record's own CID to prevent intra-MST swap attacks.

innerType.description: Lexicon NSID describing the plaintext body shape after decryption. Optional metadata for routing/UI; not authoritative until plaintext is decoded and validated.

keyId.description: Hash prefix (base32 hex, first 16 chars) of the symmetric key. Recipients use this to locate the matching app.etzhayyim.encrypted.keyWrap record in their own PDS.

pad.description: Padding scheme applied to plaintext before AEAD. Omitted = no padding. Per ADR-2605181200.

sender.description: DID that authored this encrypted record. Verifiable against the PDS commit signature.

ciphertextBlob.description: Out-of-line ciphertext for payloads larger than the inline 1 MiB limit. If set, the inline ciphertext field is empty and decryption reads the IPFS-pinned blob instead.

description: DID ↔ Signal identity binding. Published by an actor in their own PDS to assert which libsignal IdentityKey is canonical for their DID. The signature, verifiable against the DID document's signing key, prevents a malicious PDS from substituting a different Signal identity. Per ADR-2605181100.

did.description: Self-DID. MUST equal the repo owner.

signalIdentityKey.description: libsignal IdentityKey public component. 32 bytes Curve25519.

signalRegistrationId.description: libsignal registration id (14-bit per Signal protocol).

signedPreKey.description: libsignal signed pre-key public component. Optional — apps without offline-first sender requirement may omit.

signedPreKeySignature.description: libsignal Curve25519 signature over signedPreKey, by signalIdentityKey.

signature.description: Signature over CBOR({did, signalIdentityKey, signalRegistrationId, signedPreKey?, signedPreKeyId?, signedPreKeySignature?, createdAt}) by the DID document's signing key. Verifier MUST resolve the DID document fresh.

main.description: Tombstone for a logical record that has been rekeyed or 'deleted'. AT Protocol MST is append-only — a tombstone is the only operationally meaningful 'delete' on the substrate. It binds the prior envelope CID to either (a) a successor envelope CID (rekey), (b) a 'redacted' marker (logical delete; no successor), or (c) a 'sealed' marker (key destroyed; ciphertext intentionally orphaned). Per ADR-2605231603.

supersededCid.description: CID of the previous app.etzhayyim.encrypted.record envelope being tombstoned

supersededKeyId.description: keyId of the previous envelope (matches keyWrap.keyId)

supersededAtUri.description: AT URI of the previous envelope record

tombstoneType.description: rekey: a successor envelope with a fresh sym_key exists. redact: logical delete, no successor. sealed: key intentionally destroyed (e.g. revocation of all key-wraps + sender forgets the sym_key).

successorCid.description: CID of the successor envelope (REQUIRED when tombstoneType='rekey')

scope.description: single-record tombstones one envelope. channel-window tombstones every envelope written by `actorDid` in the inclusive time window [windowStart, windowEnd]. group-rekey tombstones every envelope whose recipient set included the removed member.

actorDid.description: DID issuing the tombstone — MUST be the original sender for rekey/sealed, or a charter-authorized actor (e.g. Council) for regulator-order

auditWebhookDids.description: DIDs that should receive an app.etzhayyim.audit.event for this tombstone

description: Receipt emitted by anchor-cron after it writes a completed esign envelope's hash to Base L2 (and, when `councilMirror` is true on the source envelope, also to the geth-private constitutional chain). Establishes the third (and optional fourth) layer of the 4-layer substrate per ADR-2605192245 / ADR-2605231230.

envelopeUri.description: AT URI of the envelope that was anchored.

completedEventUri.description: AT URI of the `completedEvent` that triggered anchoring.

documentSha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the document committed on-chain (copied for indexer convenience).

baseAnchor.description: Anchor receipt on Base L2 (mainnet or Sepolia testnet during phase 2).

councilMirrorAnchor.description: Mirror anchor on the geth-private constitutional chain. Present iff the source envelope had `councilMirror=true`.

chainId.description: EIP-155 chain ID. Base mainnet = 8453, Base Sepolia = 84532, geth-private constitutional = 91101 (per ADR-2605192245).

contractAddress.description: Lowercase hex-encoded 20-byte contract address that holds the anchor (`EsignAnchor.sol` or equivalent). Prefix `0x`.

blockNumber.description: Block number containing the anchoring transaction.

description: Emitted when every signer in an `app.etzhayyim.esign.envelope` has produced a valid `app.etzhayyim.esign.signature`. This record is the trigger for anchor-cron to pick up the envelope and write an L2 anchor receipt. Immutable — does not change as anchoring progresses (anchor outcome is recorded separately in `app.etzhayyim.esign.anchoredEvent`).

envelopeUri.description: AT URI of the completed envelope.

documentCid.description: IPFS CID of the signed document (copy of envelope.documentCid for indexer convenience).

documentSha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the document (copy of envelope.documentSha256 for indexer convenience).

signatureUris.description: AT URIs of every `app.etzhayyim.esign.signature` record that closed the envelope. Order matches the envelope's `signers` array; for `parallel` order this reflects completion order.

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at the moment the final signature was accepted.

description: A named signer declines an envelope. The Worker transitions the envelope to terminal `declined` state and notifies the requester. Decline is irreversible — re-signing requires a fresh envelope via `requestEnvelope`.

reason.description: Free-form decline reason (Markdown). Surfaces in the requester's notification thread.

errors.name: NotASigner
errors.description: signerDid is not in the envelope's signers array.

errors.name: EnvelopeNotOpen
errors.description: Envelope is already in a terminal state.

description: A document-signing envelope native to the religious-corp substrate (per ADR-2605231230). The PDF/document body lives on IPFS (referenced by `documentCid`); only metadata + signer roster lives on MST. Signers authenticate with DID + WebAuthn passkey assertions (no email/OAuth/SMS OTP). Completion produces an `app.etzhayyim.esign.completedEvent`, which is later anchored to Base L2 by anchor-cron yielding an `app.etzhayyim.esign.anchoredEvent`. Document signing for religious-corp documents MUST use this lexicon — DocuSign/Adobe/RazorpaySign passthroughs (`ai.gftd.apps.lawfirm.eSign*`) are reserved for fiat receipts and external counsel intake per ADR-2605192115 §4.

requesterDid.description: DID of the principal that issued the envelope. Must hold the WebAuthn key controlling the requester role.

subject.description: Human-readable subject line for the envelope (no PII; metadata only).

documentCid.description: IPFS CIDv1 (raw codec, sha2-256, base32 lower) of the canonical document body (typically a PDF). Pinned by ipfs-pinner.

documentSha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the canonical document bytes. Required as a defense-in-depth hash independent of IPFS multihash. Prefix `0x`, lowercase.

documentMimeType.description: MIME type of the canonical document body. Default `application/pdf`.

signers.description: Ordered list of signer DIDs. Order matters when `signingOrder` is `sequential`.

signingOrder.description: How signers must complete. `sequential` enforces the array order; `parallel` accepts any order.

requiredMembershipTier.description: Optional gating: if set, all signers must hold the named membership tier (per ADR-2605172700). Empty/omitted means no tier check.

purpose.description: Charter-aligned purpose tag. Constrains which template families may be used (per ADR-2605192115 §3 + Charter Rider v2.0 §2(b)(c)). The four commodity-flow values (`donation-in-kind`, `internal-allocation`, `surplus-routing`, `operational-supply`) are added per ADR-2605231500 for AAT-bound agent-driven UNSPSC flows.

subjectClassifications.description: Optional list of classification-system subjects the envelope concerns. Used by agent-driven UNSPSC flows (per ADR-2605231500) to bind envelopes to commodity / occupation / process catalog actors. UNSPSC actors at `did:web:c{code}.etzhayyim.com` receive notification fan-out on completion.

commodityManifestUri.description: Optional AT URI of an `app.etzhayyim.esign.commodityManifest` record carrying a multi-commodity batch manifest. When present, the envelope covers all commodities listed in the manifest (1 envelope = N commodity codes, batching pattern per ADR-2605231500).

requesterAgentAuthorityRef.description: Optional AT URI of an `app.etzhayyim.agent.authority` record proving AAT-bound delegated authority. Required when `requesterDid` is an AI agent (not a human Adherent SBT holder); absent when the requester is a human signing in their personal capacity. Per ADR-2605231500.

charterAttestationRef.description: Optional snapshot of the ChartersComplianceRegistry attestation captured at envelope creation. Allows downstream verifiers to detect attestation drift between mint time and signing time.

sanctionsScreenRef.description: Optional snapshot of the sanctions screening result captured at envelope creation. References the sanctions actor's per-counterparty screening record.

councilEscalationRequired.description: Derived flag — when true, requester-only signing is insufficient and the envelope requires Council Lv6+ ≥3 multisig. Set by the orchestrator based on the matching UNSPSC processManifest's councilEscalationThreshold.

customsRef.description: Optional AT URI of a customs declaration record. Required when the matching UNSPSC processManifest has customsRequired=true.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 deadline after which the envelope auto-transitions to `expired`.

status.description: Current envelope state. State machine: draft → requested → partially_signed → completed → anchored (terminal). Branches: declined / expired (terminal).

councilMirror.description: When true, the `anchoredEvent` MUST also mirror to the geth-private constitutional chain (per ADR-2605192245 4-layer pattern). Required for council-resolution / land-donation / force-rd-consent / public-fund-disbursement.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of envelope creation.

scheme.description: Classification system. `unspsc` = UNSPSC commodity code (per 2026-05-23 commit 9cd4fe73d); `isco` = ISCO-08 occupation code (per `20-actors/isco/`); `apqc` = APQC PCF process ID (per `00-contracts/lexicons/ai/gftd/apqc/`); `bunken` = bibliographic identifier (per `20-actors/bunken/`); other = free-form, document in adjacent record.

code.description: Identifier within the scheme (e.g., `43221501` for UNSPSC, `2611` for ISCO, `3.2.1.1` for APQC).

did.description: Optional DID of the classification actor (e.g., `did:web:c43221501.etzhayyim.com` for UNSPSC). When present, notification fan-out posts to this DID.

schemeId.description: Optional sub-scheme identifier for multi-scheme classifications like Bunken (`ndl:bib`, `lccn`, `viaf`, `doi`, `ark`, etc., per `20-actors/bunken/CLAUDE.md`).

description: Issue a new document-signing envelope. The Worker pins the document body to IPFS (via ipfs-pinner), writes the `app.etzhayyim.esign.envelope` record to MST, and notifies every signer DID through `app.bsky.feed.post` mentions plus a `wproto.convo` thread. Charter purpose tag MUST be set; `general` is reserved for low-stakes internal documents only.

requesterDid.description: DID of the principal issuing the envelope. MUST match the authenticated session DID.

subject.description: Optional human-readable subject line.

documentBase64.description: Base64-encoded canonical document body. Worker pins this to IPFS and stores only the CID + sha256 on the envelope record.

documentMimeType.description: MIME type of the document. Default `application/pdf`.

purpose.description: Charter-aligned purpose tag. Commodity-flow values (`donation-in-kind`, `internal-allocation`, `surplus-routing`, `operational-supply`) require `requesterAgentAuthorityRef` when the requester is an AAT-bound agent (per ADR-2605231500).

requesterAgentAuthorityRef.description: AT URI of the AAT (`app.etzhayyim.agent.authority`) backing this request. Required when the requester is an AI agent; the Worker verifies the AAT scope covers the requested purpose + (if applicable) UNSPSC subject classifications. Per ADR-2605231500.

subjectClassifications.description: Optional classification-system subjects this envelope is about. Persists onto `envelope.subjectClassifications`.

commodityManifestUri.description: Optional AT URI of an existing commodityManifest record. If absent and `subjectClassifications` describes a UNSPSC batch, the Worker creates the manifest record from the agent-supplied items array.

customsRef.description: Optional AT URI of the customs declaration record. Required when the matching UNSPSC processManifest has customsRequired=true.

councilMirror.description: Force geth-private mirror anchoring. Auto-true when `purpose` is council-resolution / land-donation / force-rd-consent / public-fund-disbursement.

expiresInDays.description: Days until the envelope auto-expires. Default 14.

errors.name: InvalidSigner
errors.description: One or more signer DIDs are not resolvable, or lack the required membership tier.

errors.name: DocumentTooLarge
errors.description: Document exceeds 8 MiB. Use the chunked pin path (not yet implemented in Phase 0).

errors.name: CharterViolation
errors.description: Purpose tag conflicts with Charter Rider §2 — for example, an advertising or for-profit-sale document.

errors.name: InvalidAgentAuthority
errors.description: requesterAgentAuthorityRef is missing, revoked, expired, or its scope does not cover the requested purpose / UNSPSC subjects.

errors.name: CharterAttestationFailed
errors.description: ChartersComplianceRegistry attestation lookup failed (no current attestation covers this purpose + classification).

errors.name: SanctionsDeny
errors.description: Sanctions screening of the counterparty or destination returned a deny.

errors.name: ForceAuthorizationRequired
errors.description: UNSPSC processManifest marks this code as force-sensitive but ForceAuthorization.preAttest() has not been satisfied.

errors.name: CouncilEscalationRequired
errors.description: Envelope value/count exceeds the per-commodity councilEscalationThreshold; requester-only signing not permitted — submit via Council multisig path.

description: An individual signer's signature on an `app.etzhayyim.esign.envelope`. The signer authenticates with a WebAuthn passkey (ES256 or EdDSA) bound to their DID via the DID key registration; the WebAuthn assertion (clientDataJSON + authenticatorData + signature) is recorded for non-repudiation. The encrypted assertion bytes use the Signal key-wrap envelope per ADR-2605181100. Append-only — declines use `app.etzhayyim.esign.declineEnvelope` instead.

envelopeUri.description: AT URI of the `app.etzhayyim.esign.envelope` being signed.

signerDid.description: DID of the signer. MUST appear in the envelope's `signers` array.

documentSha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the document the signer attests to. MUST equal envelope.documentSha256 (defense against envelope tampering between request and sign).

webauthnCredentialId.description: Base64url-encoded WebAuthn credential ID used to sign. The credential is pre-registered against signer's DID via `app.etzhayyim.member.adherent` or a future passkey-registration record.

webauthnAlgorithm.description: COSE algorithm identifier of the WebAuthn key.

assertionEnvelope.description: XChaCha20-Poly1305 envelope (Signal key-wrap per ADR-2605181100) containing the WebAuthn assertion JSON ({clientDataJSON, authenticatorData, signature}). Encrypted-at-rest because clientDataJSON contains the challenge which is sensitive when correlated with envelope rkey.

challengeSha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the WebAuthn challenge that was signed (replay defense — challenge MUST equal sha256(envelopeUri || signerDid || nonce)). Public so verifiers can recompute without decrypting the envelope.

userAgent.description: Optional client UA string at sign time. Metadata only — not authoritative.

signerAgentAuthorityRef.description: Optional AT URI of the signer's AAT (`app.etzhayyim.agent.authority`). Present when the signer is an AI agent acting under delegated authority; absent when the signer is a human Adherent signing in their own capacity. Per ADR-2605231500. Verifiers MUST check that the AAT scope covers the envelope's purpose at sign time.

description: Submit a WebAuthn passkey signature for an envelope. The Worker verifies the assertion against the signer's DID-registered credential, recomputes the challenge hash, and writes an `app.etzhayyim.esign.signature` record. When the envelope's signer set is fully closed, the Worker also emits a `completedEvent` in the same call.

completedEventUri.description: Present iff this signature closed the envelope.

errors.name: NotASigner
errors.description: signerDid is not in the envelope's signers array.

errors.name: OutOfOrder
errors.description: Envelope.signingOrder is sequential and signerDid is not the next expected signer.

errors.name: WebauthnVerifyFailed
errors.description: Assertion did not verify against the signer's DID-registered credential.

errors.name: ChallengeMismatch
errors.description: clientDataJSON challenge does not equal sha256(envelopeUri || signerDid || nonce).

errors.name: EnvelopeNotOpen
errors.description: Envelope status is not `requested` / `partially_signed` (already completed / declined / expired).

errors.name: DocumentHashMismatch
errors.description: The signer's assertion references a documentSha256 different from envelope.documentSha256.

description: A constitutionally inalienable land donation to the etzhayyim Land Trust. Per ADR-2605192245 (4-layer permanent record) + ADR-2605192100 §1.11 (Earth as Tree of Life body). The on-chain side mints a non-transferable LandRegistry NFT to the Land Trust treasury; this Lexicon record is the AT Protocol counterpart (Layer 4-adjacent — references the on-chain NFT and the IPFS-pinned content). Once recorded, this donation is WAQF-EQUIVALENT INALIENABLE — no transfer, sale, burn, or substitution is permitted. See `90-docs/2605220540-first-land-donation-walkthrough.md`.

donorDid.description: DID of the donor at the moment of donation. Per `FORK-BOOTSTRAP.md` constitutional invariant #2, donor must operate a religious DID (did:web / did:plc / did:key).

parcelName.description: Human-readable parcel name as the donor wishes it to be recorded. Religious-corps may add stewardship-given names later; the donor's original name is preserved here.

jurisdictionalId.description: State-cadastre identifier(s). May include multiple if the parcel straddles jurisdictions (semicolon-separated). The religious-corp records this for transparency; it does not assert state recognition of the donation.

geojsonCid.description: IPFS CID of the RFC 7946 GeoJSON FeatureCollection defining the parcel boundary.

titleCidEncrypted.description: IPFS CID of the donor's title document, XChaCha20-Poly1305-wrapped per ADR-2605181100 (`app.etzhayyim.encrypted.land-title.*`). Decryption is permitted to: donor, Council Seat 5 (Stewardship/Land), Council Seat 1 (Founder).

environmentalCid.description: IPFS CID of the environmental statement (free-form markdown + photo references).

photoCids.description: Optional IPFS CIDs of supplementary photos (current land state, boundary markers, biodiversity evidence, etc.).

tokenId.description: Base L2 LandRegistry ERC-721 token ID (unsigned, no implied units — token IDs are unitless serial integers).

txHash.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte transaction hash of the LandRegistry.donate() call. Prefix `0x`, lowercase. Used to anchor the Layer-1 on-chain NFT to this Layer-4-adjacent AT Protocol record.

stewardDids.description: DIDs of named stewards. The donor's DID may be included (typical) or omitted (anonymous stewardship via Council Seat 5 only). Stewards retain voice over land management but never ownership. Per ADR-2605192245.

donorNoteRef.description: Optional AT URI of an `app.etzhayyim.encrypted.donation-note` record carrying a private message from the donor to the Council. Use when the donor wishes to record reasoning or context confidentially.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at the moment of donation submission.

description: Update the stewardship roster for a previously-donated land parcel. The on-chain LandRegistry NFT is NEVER transferred (per ADR-2605192245 inalienability); only the stewardship voice is rotated. This record is authored by Council Seat 5 (Stewardship/Land) typically with consent from the outgoing steward(s). Use cases: voluntary withdrawal, incapacitation, named-successor activation, Council-initiated rotation when stewards become unreachable.

donationRef.description: AT URI of the originating `app.etzhayyim.give.land.donation` record this succession amends.

previousStewardDids.description: DIDs that held stewardship voice prior to this succession. Inclusive — list all who are being rotated out, in addition to any continuing stewards.

newStewardDids.description: DIDs that hold stewardship voice after this succession. May overlap with previousStewardDids (partial rotation).

reason.description: Single-value enum: 'voluntary-withdrawal' | 'incapacitation' | 'named-successor-activation' | 'council-initiated' | 'donor-passing' | 'other'. The reason must be substantively justifiable to ≥3 Council seats post-bootstrap; founder-attested during bootstrap.

narrative.description: Free-form markdown narrative explaining the context. Used for transparency and Council deliberation; not legally binding.

attestorDid.description: DID of the Council seat (typically Seat 5 Stewardship/Land, or Seat 1 Founder during bootstrap) attesting this succession. Multi-attestation (≥3-of-5 Council post-bootstrap) is recorded via co-equal sibling records under the same at-uri prefix.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this succession was recorded.

description: A USDC donation to etzhayyim. The on-chain side is TitheRouter.donate() on Base L2 (atomically routes 90% to treasury, 10% to Public Fund Safe). This Lexicon record is the AT Protocol counterpart — donor's authoring record (donor DID, amount in USDC micros, purpose, transaction hash, optional encrypted note). Per ADR-2605192115 (donation enum + 10% Tithe), ADR-2605192130 (Public Fund), ADR-2605192100 §1.6 (middleman elimination). See `90-docs/2605220440-first-donation-walkthrough.md`. Allowed purposes are RESTRICTED to external religious-corp flows; SBT-carveout internal purposes belong on `app.etzhayyim.member.internal.*` Lexicons (not yet authored) — NOT here.

donorDid.description: DID of the donor at the moment of donation. Per `FORK-BOOTSTRAP.md` constitutional invariant #2, donor must operate a religious DID (did:web / did:plc / did:key).

amountMicros.description: Donation amount in USDC micros (6 decimal places). 1 USDC = 1000000 micros. Integer-with-implied-units per ADR-2605190900 (no float types in Lexicons). Minimum 1 micro (= 0.000001 USDC) to prevent dust-spam records.

purpose.description: Donation purpose enum. Restricted to externally-permitted values per ADR-2605192115 §1.3 + §3.3. Single value, lowercase, hyphenated.

txHash.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte transaction hash of the TitheRouter.donate() call (or LandRegistry interaction for in-kind donations bridged through escrow). Prefix `0x`, lowercase. Used to anchor this AT Protocol record to the on-chain Layer-1 event.

splitTxHash.description: Optional hex-encoded transaction hash of the Public Fund 10% split. In typical operation this is the same transaction as txHash (atomic split inside TitheRouter); recorded separately when the split occurs as a follow-up tx (e.g., during chaos-rehearsal Scenario 8 testing).

noteRef.description: Optional AT URI of an `app.etzhayyim.encrypted.donation-note` record carrying a private message from the donor to the treasury Council seat. Use when the donor wishes to record reasoning or context confidentially. Encrypted per ADR-2605181100.

noteHashOnchain.description: Optional hex-encoded SHA-256 of the plaintext note (prefix `0x`, lowercase). Stored on-chain in the TitheRouter event; used to prove a specific note plaintext corresponds to this donation without revealing the plaintext.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at the moment of donation submission.

description: Council deliberation proposal. Typically transmitted as the plaintext body of an app.etzhayyim.encrypted.record (innerType=this NSID) so council membership scopes who can read. Per ADR-2605181100 + uhl-right-neural council pattern.

body.description: Discussion body. Markdown allowed. Larger documents should be referenced by `attachments` IPFS CID instead of inlined.

author.description: DID of the council member who proposed.

category.description: Project-specific category. For uhl-right-neural: 'medical-referral' | 'ethics-review' | 'data-export' | 'protocol-amendment' | 'other'.

refs.description: Related AT URIs (prior proposals, evidence records, etc.).

attachments.description: IPFS CIDs for large attachments. Encryption of the attachment payload is the caller's responsibility (typically same symmetric key as the envelope, separately AEAD'd).

description: Council member's vote on a proposal. Transmitted as the plaintext body of an app.etzhayyim.encrypted.record so vote privacy holds at the substrate layer (only council members with the read-cap can tally). Per ADR-2605181100 + uhl-right-neural council pattern.

proposalUri.description: AT URI of the app.etzhayyim.encrypted.record carrying the proposal.

rationale.description: Optional explanation. Visible only to other council members with the read-cap.

main.description: FHIR R5 CarePlan — 在宅療養計画書. Inner type of app.etzhayyim.encrypted.record envelope. Phase 3 (zaitaku). Bound to a homecareEpisode.

caregiverDids.description: Family caregivers / 介護福祉士 with DID

reviewIntervalDays.description: Cadence at which the plan is reviewed and updated

performedAtRefs.description: AT URIs of homeVisit records that executed this activity

FHIR R5 MedicationDispense — pharmacy hand-off record. Inner type of app.etzhayyim.encrypted.record envelope. Created by pharmacist DID upon dispensing a MedicationRequest.

substitutionPerformed.description: true if pharmacist substituted (e.g. generic for brand)

patientCounselling.description: 服薬指導内容 (drug education delivered to patient)

main.description: FHIR R5 Encounter resource (inner type of app.etzhayyim.encrypted.record). Represents a single visit/admission/home-care episode.

encounterType.description: SNOMED CT codes for visit purpose (e.g. 11429006 Consultation)

department.description: 診療科 — e.g. 内科, 整形外科

reasonReferenceConditionRefs.description: AT URIs of related Condition records (within encrypted scope)
