managingFacilityDid.description: did:web of the 在宅医療事業者

careTeamDids.description: All clinicians + caregivers in the episode (MD/NP/RN/PT/OT/ST/MSW/Pharmacist/Caregiver)

diagnosisRefs.description: AT URIs of Condition records central to the episode

advanceDirective.description: 事前指示書 (ACP) — limited PHI-encrypted summary

main.description: Single 訪問診療 / 訪問看護 visit within a homecareEpisode. Specialization of Encounter (encounterClass='home'). Inner type of app.etzhayyim.encrypted.record envelope.

visitorDid.description: did:web of clinician who performed the visit

locationGeo.description: Coarse-grained geo for billing (JP 在宅医療 distance-based fees). Full address is on the patient record only.

interventions.description: Drips / dressing changes / catheter exchange / oxygen titration / counselling — specific procedures performed during the visit

vitalsObservationRefs.description: AT URIs of Observation records recorded during this visit

soapNoteRef.description: AT URI of the SOAP note for this visit (1:1)

escalation.description: If the visit ended with an escalation (call MD / transfer to hospital / death confirmation)

main.description: FHIR R5 MedicationRequest (処方). Inner type of app.etzhayyim.encrypted.record envelope. interactionFlags is computed by upstream agent.chat step and persisted in publicMeta.

interactionFlags.description: Computed by agent.chat upstream. Persists in encrypted record AND mirrored in publicMeta (severity only).

yjCode.description: JP YJ code (個別医薬品コード)

route.description: PO / IV / IM / SC / topical / inhaled

main.description: FHIR R5 Observation (vital signs, lab results, imaging findings, social-history measures). Inner type of app.etzhayyim.encrypted.record envelope. AT Lexicon has no float → all numeric values use integer with scale10 / scale100 hint in the code's unit field.

scale.description: 10 for x10, 100 for x100. 1 for whole numbers.

quantity.description: AT Lexicon float-free: use valueScaled + scale (e.g. 367 with scale=10 represents 36.7)

unit.description: UCUM code, e.g. mm[Hg], /min, Cel, kg, %

main.description: FHIR R5 Patient resource (inner type of app.etzhayyim.encrypted.record envelope). ALL fields are PHI and persist only inside the encrypted ciphertext. Never write this record type directly to MST.

identifiers.description: FHIR Identifier[] — e.g. 保険証番号, MRN. system + value pairs.

patientDid.description: did:plc:... or did:web:... of the patient as an etzhayyim actor

system.description: URI for namespace, e.g. urn:oid:1.2.392.200119.6.... for JP MRN

payerSystem.description: e.g. 社保, 国保, private

main.description: FHIR R5 ServiceRequest (検査・画像・処置・指導オーダー). Inner type of app.etzhayyim.encrypted.record envelope.

resultObservationDids.description: AT URIs of Observation records once result is in

main.description: SOAP progress note (FHIR R5 Composition with section type=SOAP). Inner type of app.etzhayyim.encrypted.record envelope.

subjective.description: S — 患者の主観的訴え (主訴・現病歴・既往歴・社会歴)

assessment.description: A — 鑑別を含む評価。Condition record refs と code をひも付け

objectiveBlock.description: O — 客観的所見。バイタル・身体所見・検査結果

vitals.description: Summary view; canonical timeseries lives in Observation records

temperatureCelsius10.description: Temp × 10 (e.g. 367 = 36.7°C). AT Lexicon has no float.

differentialOf.description: Refers to another assessmentItem index if differential

planBlock.description: P — 治療計画。医薬品・検査・処置・指導・フォローアップ

description: Knowledge graph edge. Substrate-native KG layer per ADR-2605190900. An edge is an RDF-style quad (subject, predicate, object|literal, context). Subjects and objects reference app.etzhayyim.kg.node records by at-uri or by nodeId. SPARQL semantics; OWL semantics NOT implied.

subject.description: Subject node reference. AT-URI of an app.etzhayyim.kg.node record, or a node.nodeId value.

predicate.description: Predicate token or IRI. Conventional short tokens: 'depends_on', 'related', 'supersedes', 'superseded_by', 'uses-lexicon', 'projects-from', 'anchored-at', 'owns', 'asserts', 'authoritative-for'. Full IRIs allowed for inter-graph alignment.

object.description: Object node reference (object-typed edge). AT-URI or nodeId. Mutually exclusive with 'literal' — exactly one of {object, literal} MUST be set.

literal.description: Literal value (literal-typed edge, e.g. 'has-version' -> '1.2.3'). Mutually exclusive with 'object' — exactly one of {object, literal} MUST be set.

weight.description: Optional numeric weight for weighted-graph algorithms. Scale 0-1000 (permille: weight/1000 = normalized 0.0-1.0). Per AT Protocol Lexicon v1: no float types; use integer with implied units.

context.description: Optional named-graph / provenance pointer. Typically the AT-URI of the record that asserts this edge (e.g. an ADR or a module manifest). Equivalent to the fourth term of an RDF quad.

source.description: Projection source, parallel to kg.node.source. Examples: 'deps.toml', 'adr-frontmatter', 'lexicon-refs', 'manual'.

createdAt.description: Record creation time. RFC 3339.

description: Knowledge graph node. Substrate-native KG layer per ADR-2605190900. A node is a typed, content-addressed entity (ADR, module, lexicon, L2 contract, DNS record, actor cell, capability, institution, etc.). Edges connecting nodes use app.etzhayyim.kg.edge.

nodeId.description: Stable identifier for the node. Examples: at-uri (at://did:plc:.../app.etzhayyim.kg.node/<rkey>), did (did:web:etzhayyim.com), urn (urn:adr:2605190900), http(s) URL, or app-defined token (e.g. 'adr:2605190900', 'module:20-actors/magatama').

nodeType.description: Type token or IRI. Conventional short tokens: 'adr', 'module', 'lexicon', 'l2-contract', 'dns-record', 'actor-cell', 'capability', 'institution', 'person', 'organization'. Full IRIs allowed for inter-graph alignment.

summary.description: Optional short prose description of the node.

payload.description: Optional structured payload. Prefer application/cbor (IPLD DAG-CBOR) for content-addressed linkage; application/json or application/ld+json acceptable for simpler cases. The blob CID is the natural content address of the payload.

source.description: Projection source. Examples: 'deps.toml', 'adr-frontmatter', 'lexicon-refs', 'module-manifest', 'manual'. The kg-projector sets this automatically; manually-authored nodes use 'manual'.

createdAt.description: Record creation time. RFC 3339.

description: Read-only SPARQL 1.1 query endpoint for the etzhayyim Knowledge Graph (ADR-2605190900 stage K2.b). Served by the kg-appview ephemeral in-memory store rebuilt from MST + IPFS on cold start; never mutates substrate. SPARQL UPDATE keywords (INSERT / DELETE / LOAD / CLEAR / CREATE / DROP / COPY / MOVE / ADD) are rejected with HTTP 403. Response encoding depends on the SPARQL form: SELECT and ASK default to application/sparql-results+json (override with format=xml or format=csv); CONSTRUCT and DESCRIBE default to text/turtle (override with format=ntriples or format=rdfxml).

query.description: SPARQL 1.1 query string. Must be SELECT / ASK / CONSTRUCT / DESCRIBE. UPDATE forms are rejected.

format.description: Optional response-format override. Use 'json' / 'xml' / 'csv' for SELECT/ASK; 'turtle' / 'ntriples' / 'rdfxml' for CONSTRUCT/DESCRIBE. If omitted, Accept-header negotiation falls back to the format defaults documented at the lexicon level.

output.description: SPARQL Query Results JSON for SELECT/ASK, or text/turtle (or the format requested via the format parameter) for CONSTRUCT/DESCRIBE. The HTTP Content-Type header carries the actual encoding chosen by the server.

errors.name: InvalidQuery
errors.description: The provided SPARQL string failed to parse or evaluate. The server returns the parser/evaluator message in the response body.

errors.name: UpdateNotAllowed
errors.description: The provided SPARQL contained an UPDATE keyword. This endpoint is read-only by design (ADR-2605190900 K2 RW-free guarantee).

description: Records a jurisdictional or property-rights challenge against a parcel held in the etzhayyim Land Trust. The land donation is constitutionally inalienable per ADR-2605192245 — the challenge does NOT unwind the donation, regardless of outcome. This record exists for transparent documentation per ADR-2605192315 (Transparent Religious Force). Resolution requires Council Seat 5 (Stewardship/Land) + Seat 3 (Legal/Ethics) deliberation; Council attestation ≥3-of-5 multisig post-bootstrap.

landDonationRef.description: AT URI of the `app.etzhayyim.give.land.donation` record being challenged.

challengerCategory.description: Who is challenging. Single value, lowercase, hyphenated.

challengerJurisdiction.description: State / national / international jurisdiction identifier (e.g., 'JP', 'US-CA', 'EU', 'ICC'). Free-form to accommodate multi-jurisdictional reality.

claimSummary.description: Markdown summary of the claim against the parcel. Public — no encryption (transparent per ADR-2605192315).

evidenceCids.description: IPFS CIDs of evidence documents (court filings, claim documents, photos, surveys). May include both challenger-submitted and religious-corp-counter evidence.

councilDeliberationRef.description: Optional AT URI of the `app.etzhayyim.governance.proposal` record where Council deliberated the challenge.

resolutionStatus.description: Current resolution state. Single value, lowercase, hyphenated.

resolutionNarrative.description: Markdown narrative of the resolution. Required when resolutionStatus is non-filed/deliberating. Note: 'resolved-stewardship-amended' indicates the challenge prompted a stewardship-roster change via `app.etzhayyim.give.land.stewardSuccession` — the on-chain NFT remains in the Trust.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the challenge was first recorded.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent resolutionStatus / resolutionNarrative update.

description: Collection job descriptor — immutable creation record. Replaces the RW `vertex_maps_job` write-once row produced by `createCollectionJob`. State transitions are NOT stored on this record; they live as append-only app.etzhayyim.maps.jobEvent records keyed by TID. Per ADR-2605231400 + maps MIGRATION-TODO Phase 1 (Tier A).

jobId.description: Caller-chosen stable identifier. Kebab-case. Suggested format: '{source-slug}-{purpose}-{yyyymmddhhmm}' for uniqueness. PDS createRecord rejects rkey conflicts — caller handles or pre-checks.

sourceDid.description: Source DID this job collects from (matches an app.etzhayyim.maps.source record).

kind.description: Job purpose — drives the worker dispatch.

targetCollection.description: If the job's outputs land in a specific Lexicon collection, name it (e.g., 'app.etzhayyim.maps.feature').

bboxWest.description: WGS84 bbox west edge in microdegrees (×1e7).

bboxSouth.description: WGS84 bbox south edge in microdegrees (×1e7).

bboxEast.description: WGS84 bbox east edge in microdegrees (×1e7).

bboxNorth.description: WGS84 bbox north edge in microdegrees (×1e7).

areaDid.description: Optional region scope (matches an app.etzhayyim.maps.region DID).

params.description: Free-form source-specific parameters (e.g., feed URL, date range, batch size). Worker contract decides the shape.

createdBy.description: DID of the entity that submitted the job.

description: Operator-defined display layer for KAMI rendering. One record per logical layer that overlays the base map (e.g., 'tokyo-real-estate-heatmap', 'jp-seismic-7day'). The layer references a source DID and a MapLibre style spec. Per ADR-2605231400 + maps MIGRATION-TODO Phase 1 (Tier A).

name.description: Human-readable name.

sourceDid.description: Source DID this layer derives from (matches an app.etzhayyim.maps.source record).

kind.description: Render kind — drives the KAMI shader path.

zoomMin.description: Minimum zoom level at which the layer is visible.

zoomMax.description: Maximum zoom level at which the layer is visible.

styleSpec.description: MapLibre style spec object for the layer (paint, layout, filter). Free-form to avoid lockstep with MapLibre version.

labelCoordinatorDid.description: Optional reference to the KAMI layer coordinator that hosts this display layer (app.etzhayyim.maps.layerCoordinator).

supersedesLayerId.description: If this layer revises an earlier definition (style change, source swap), name the prior layerId. Old layer remains rkey-addressable for replay.

description: One spatial feature = one AT record. Consumed by mst-projector under shardKey = 'app.etzhayyim.maps.feature' which projects the collection into an atproto MST and emits app.etzhayyim.substrate.shardSnapshot (ADR-2605171800 + ADR-2605191655). geometry is GeoJSON-string-encoded and bbox is integer microdegrees (×1e7) because the AT lexicon schema does not support float arrays or float numbers.

label.description: Feature kind: Building / Road / River / Place / AdminArea / Spot / Port / Airport / Station / Coastline / Mountain / Lake / Railway / SeaRoute / AirRoute / BusRoute / BusStop / etc.

geometryGeoJson.description: GeoJSON Geometry object (Point / LineString / Polygon / MultiPolygon) encoded as JSON string. AT lexicon cannot hold float arrays natively.

h3Cell.description: H3 cell id (hex string) at the resolution declared by h3Resolution. Carried in the record so projector indexers (kg / spatial side-index) can partition without re-parsing geometry.

h3Resolution.description: H3 resolution (0-15). 8 ≈ neighborhood, 10 ≈ block, 12 ≈ building footprint.

bboxWestE7.description: Bounding-box west longitude in degrees × 1e7 (integer-encoded; AT lexicon disallows floats).

properties.description: Arbitrary feature properties as JSON-encoded string. Keep <16KB; larger blobs (e.g. raster tiles, photogrammetry chunks) should be pinned to IPFS separately and referenced by CID inside this field.

description: Scheme-alias DID resolver. One record per (scheme, code) pair pointing back to a canonical app.etzhayyim.maps.region record. 32 known schemes — ISO 3166-1/2, JIS X-0401/0402, FIPS, H3, S2, Geohash, Plus Code, MGRS, Maidenhead, UTM, flight-level, ICAO FIR, atmo-layer, elevation, depth-band, infra-depth, IHO sea, EEZ, bath-zone, Köppen, WWF biome, WWF ecoregion, tectonic, ICAO/IATA airport, UN/LOCODE, IANA TZ. Per ADR-2605231400 + maps MIGRATION-TODO Phase 1.

code.description: Scheme-native code (e.g., 'JP' for iso3166-1, '13' for jis-x0401 (東京都)).

canonicalUri.description: AT URI of the canonical app.etzhayyim.maps.region record this alias resolves to.

canonicalDid.description: Optional convenience copy of the canonical region's DID.

description: Job state-transition event. Append-only TID-keyed. Replaces the RW `advanceJob` UPDATE pattern with an event log; latest state derived by reading all events for a `jobUri`, sorting by `emittedAt`, taking the last. Per ADR-2605231400 + maps MIGRATION-TODO Phase 1 (Tier A).

jobUri.description: AT URI of the app.etzhayyim.maps.collectionJob record this event advances.

state.description: Job state at this point in time. Terminal states: completed / failed / skipped / superseded.

progressPctBps.description: Progress in basis points (10000 = 100%). Integer to avoid float drift.

errorClass.description: Required when state == 'failed'. Stable identifier for the failure category (e.g., 'upstream-timeout', 'parse-error', 'rate-limit').

errorDetail.description: Free-form failure detail. Required when state == 'failed'.

emittedBy.description: Worker / dispatcher DID that emitted the event.

description: KAMI visual layer coordinator DID record. 11 canonical layers per maps CLAUDE.md §Layer 1: tile / poi / route / infra / building / weather / sensor / transport / geography / satellite / event. Per ADR-2605231400 + maps MIGRATION-TODO Phase 1 (Tier A).

Legal entity record — corporations / operators / property owners / government bodies / public utilities. Discriminated by `entityType`. Per maps CLAUDE.md §Graph Schema (`vertex_legal_entity`) + ADR-2605231400 yatachain L1 target. Per MIGRATION-TODO Phase 1 (Tier A).

entityKey.description: Stable rkey-safe key. Preferred: '{entityType-slug}-{lei|taxId|registrationNumber}'. Lowercase. No leading/trailing/double hyphens.

registrationNumber.description: Issuer-specific registration number (e.g., NTA 法人番号 for JP, EIN for US, CRN for UK).

industryCode.description: ISIC Rev.4 4-digit class code or analogous (NAICS/SIC).

sourceDid.description: Source DID this record was derived from (e.g., did:web:maps.etzhayyim.com:registry:jp-nta).

description: Natural zone record — Köppen climate (5), WWF biome (14), or tectonic plate (15) = 34 canonical zones per maps CLAUDE.md §Layer 3. Constants under decadal revision cadence. Per ADR-2605231400 + maps MIGRATION-TODO Phase 1 (Tier A).

code.description: Scheme-native code (e.g., 'Af' for Köppen tropical rainforest, '1' for WWF biome tropical broadleaf, 'NA' for North American plate).

description: Ownership relation event — a LegalEntity (subject) owns/transfers/inherits/forecloses/leases a registry record (object). Append-only event log keyed by TID; chain of ownership reconstructed by reading by `subjectUri` or `objectUri` + sorting by `effectiveDate`. Per maps CLAUDE.md §Registry & Legal Entity Architecture (`edge_ownership`) + ADR-2605231400 yatachain L1.

subjectUri.description: AT URI of the LegalEntity acting as owner / transferor / lessee.

objectUri.description: AT URI of the Registry record being owned / transferred / inherited / leased.

sharePctBps.description: Ownership share in basis points (10000 = 100%). Integer to avoid float drift.

registryRef.description: Free-form reference to the source filing (e.g., 'JP-MOJ 13-01234 行 5').

supersededByUri.description: If a later record corrects this one (rare), point to the replacement. The original remains queryable for audit.

description: Canonical AdminArea / region record with multi-scheme code mapping. One record per real-world region (country, prefecture, city, etc.). Aliases under multiple geo schemes (ISO 3166, JIS, FIPS, H3, etc.) live in app.etzhayyim.maps.geoAlias records that point back to this canonical via `canonicalUri`. Per ADR-2605231400 + maps MIGRATION-TODO Phase 1 (Tier A).

nanoid.description: Stable canonical identifier (lowercase alphanumeric + hyphen, no leading/trailing/double hyphens). Used as rkey and DID path segment. Hand-picked for well-known regions (e.g., 'jp' for Japan, 'jp-tokyo' for 東京都); system-generated for bulk-pipeline-seeded regions.

name.description: Canonical English name.

displayName.description: UI display name (may differ from `name` for romanization, native script, etc.).

parentDid.description: DID of the parent region. Country regions have no parent.

centerLat.description: Latitude of region centroid (WGS84) in microdegrees (×1e7).

centerLng.description: Longitude of region centroid (WGS84) in microdegrees (×1e7).

bboxWest.description: WGS84 bbox west edge in microdegrees (×1e7).

bboxSouth.description: WGS84 bbox south edge in microdegrees (×1e7).

bboxEast.description: WGS84 bbox east edge in microdegrees (×1e7).

bboxNorth.description: WGS84 bbox north edge in microdegrees (×1e7).

codes.description: Free-form object mapping geo scheme name (e.g., 'iso3166-1', 'jis-x0401') to the region's code under that scheme. Drives the geoAlias records.

description: Registry record — land / property / business / construction-permit / operating-license / environmental-permit / zoning. Discriminated by `registryType`. Per maps CLAUDE.md §Graph Schema (`vertex_registry`) + ADR-2605231400 yatachain L1 target.

assessedValueUsdc.description: Assessed value in USDC micros (Charter-compliant fiat-free denomination). Optional.

description: Maps data source DID registry — one record per external API the maps app replaces with a path-based DID. Append-only with Supersedes edges for revision. Per ADR-2605231400 (yatachain L1) + maps MIGRATION-TODO Phase 1 (Tier A).

slug.description: Stable rkey-safe slug for this source. Format: kebab-case (lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens), matches the path segment under did:web:maps.etzhayyim.com (or 'registry-{name}' for nested registries).

did.description: Canonical path-based DID for this source. Format: did:web:maps.etzhayyim.com[:registry]:{slug-with-colons}.

externalSource.description: The external API or dataset this DID replaces (e.g., 'Nominatim (OSM)', 'Sentinel-2 / Landsat (STAC)', 'OpenFlights routes (ODbL)').

ttl.description: Time-to-live for cached records from this source. ISO 8601 duration (e.g., 'PT1H', 'P7D', 'P30D') or the literal 'permanent'.

license.description: License under which the upstream data is redistributable (e.g., 'ODbL', 'CC-BY-4.0', 'public domain', 'commercial'). Required for ADR-2605192115 compliance review.

category.description: Coarse category for grouping in UI and policy gates.

status.description: Operational status of this source's ingest path.

supersedesDid.description: When this record replaces an earlier source DID (slug change, license re-issue, etc.), name the prior DID. The old record remains queryable; reads default to the latest non-superseded record.

notes.description: Free-form operator notes — bring-up runbook references, contact info for the upstream provider, known issues.

description: Bbox + labels → GeoJSON FeatureCollection per label, read from the latest (or pinned-generation) app.etzhayyim.substrate.shardSnapshot for shardKey = 'app.etzhayyim.maps.feature'. Server resolves the snapshot → fetches the MST root from IPFS (Phase 2) or the JSON manifest (Phase 1) → walks the MST / scans matching partitions → emits GeoJSON. Bbox parameters are integer microdegrees (×1e7) to match the record schema. ADR-2605202300.

labels.description: Feature labels to include (Building / Road / River / ...). Empty = all.

h3Resolution.description: Hint for the H3 resolution the reader expects (zoom-derived). Server may pick the closest available index.

snapshotRkey.description: Optional rkey of a specific app.etzhayyim.substrate.shardSnapshot to read against (time-travel). Absent = latest.

layers.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection per label, encoded as JSON string ({"Building": {...}, "Road": {...}}). String-encoded so the AT lexicon does not need to model deeply-nested float arrays.

truncated.description: True if the result was capped by limit.

errors.name: SnapshotNotFound
errors.description: No shardSnapshot exists for shardKey = app.etzhayyim.maps.feature (or for the supplied snapshotRkey).

errors.name: BboxTooLarge
errors.description: The requested bbox exceeds the per-query area cap configured for this appview.

phase.description: 1 = JSON manifest, 2 = MST CAR. Mirrors shardSnapshot.phase.

snapshotCid.description: IPFS CID of the snapshot blob (JSON manifest or CAR).

snapshotHash.description: Phase 1 sha256 hash; absent when phase=2.

description: Altitude / depth band record — atmosphere (5), underground (4), or ocean (5) = 14 canonical zones per maps CLAUDE.md §Layer 3. Constants under ISIC-style infrequent revision. Per ADR-2605231400 + maps MIGRATION-TODO Phase 1 (Tier A).

name.description: Canonical English name.

minMeters.description: Minimum altitude/depth in integer meters relative to sea level. Negative for underground/ocean.

maxMeters.description: Maximum altitude/depth in integer meters relative to sea level.

description: AT Protocol counterpart of an Adherent SBT mint event on Base L2. The SBT is a non-transferable ERC-721 minted to a member's Smart Account when one of three trigger conditions is met (per ADR-2605192100 §1.16 + ADR-2605192300): a first donation, an explicit Charter Affirmation, or a Council-granted bootstrap mint. This record carries the trigger reference, the on-chain mint transaction hash, and the hash of the Charter Affirmation message the member signed. Constitutional: 1 SBT = 1 vote (no tiers), non-transferable, voluntary withdrawal permitted via `app.etzhayyim.member.withdrawal` (not yet authored — surfaced gap).

memberDid.description: DID of the member receiving the Adherent SBT. Per `FORK-BOOTSTRAP.md` constitutional invariant #2, member must operate a religious DID.

tokenId.description: Base L2 Adherent SBT ERC-721 token ID (unsigned, unitless serial integer; minimum 1 — token 0 is reserved per OpenZeppelin convention).

mintTxHash.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte transaction hash of the AdherentSBT.mint() call. Prefix `0x`, lowercase.

trigger.description: What caused the SBT to be minted. Single value, lowercase, hyphenated.

triggerRef.description: Optional AT URI of the triggering record: if `first-donation`, the AT URI of the `app.etzhayyim.give.usdc.donation` or `app.etzhayyim.give.land.donation` record; if `council-grant`, the AT URI of the Council proposal authorizing the grant.

affirmationHashOnchain.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the plaintext Charter Affirmation message the member signed with their DID key. The plaintext is stored separately as `app.etzhayyim.member.charter-affirmation` (not yet authored — surfaced gap). Prefix `0x`, lowercase.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at the moment of SBT mint observation.

description: SBT↔SBT internal purchase record. Per ADR-2605192115 §3 (SBT internal carve-out), purchases between two Adherent SBT holders within the religious-corp boundary are permitted — distinct from external commerce, which is prohibited. This Lexicon records the AT Protocol counterpart of the on-chain internal transfer. Both parties must hold an Adherent SBT at the moment of the transaction (verified by the InternalCommerce contract on Base L2). Allowed scope: religious goods, services rendered between adherents (e.g., translation work, hospitality), consensual support arrangements. NOT for: external SaaS sales, subscriptions to non-adherents, advertising-supported commerce. Tithe DOES NOT apply (the carveout's purpose is intra-organism commerce; the 10% tithe is for external donations only).

buyerDid.description: DID of the buyer. Must hold an Adherent SBT at txHash block.

sellerDid.description: DID of the seller. Must hold an Adherent SBT at txHash block.

amountMicros.description: Purchase amount in currency micros (6 decimal places for USDC). Integer-with-implied-units per ADR-2605190900. Minimum 1 to prevent dust-spam.

currency.description: Settlement currency. Currently only USDC is supported (per ADR-2605172100 — no fiat processors). Future expansion via Council ratification.

itemDescription.description: Free-form markdown description of what was purchased. Both parties' SBT identity is on-chain; the description records the substantive content of the exchange.

itemCategory.description: Optional category for analytics. Religious-corp-appropriate categories only.

txHash.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte transaction hash of the InternalCommerce contract call. Prefix `0x`, lowercase.

noteRef.description: Optional AT URI of an `app.etzhayyim.encrypted.record` wrapping a private note (receipt, terms, agreement details) between buyer and seller.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at the moment of internal purchase.

description: Platform API key for sk_live_*/sk_test_* murakumo access. rkey = lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw key. Per ADR-2605191358 (RW-free rewrite).

ownerDid.description: DID that owns this key. Used for billing/scoping.

scopes.description: Scope tokens, e.g. 'murakumo:inference', '*'. Empty means default 'read'.

description: Header record for an async LLM inference job. Immutable once created; status transitions live in app.etzhayyim.murakumo.inferenceJobEvent. Per ADR-2605191358 §event-sourced inferenceJob.

jobId.description: UUID; also used as rkey for direct lookup.

owner.description: DID or auth-kind tag of the requester.

promptPreview.description: First 200 chars of the user message. UI-only; not auth-sensitive.

requestBody.description: Verbatim JSON request body. May contain large messages; consider blob-ifying for very large prompts in a future revision.

description: Status-transition event for an inferenceJob. Append-only; rkey = `${jobId}~${seqZeroPadded}` so a prefix scan over rkeys returns all events for one job in order. Reduce events to derive the latest job state. Per ADR-2605191358 §event-sourced (no UPDATE).

seq.description: Monotonically increasing per job. 0 = initial pending, 1 = running, 2 = terminal.

description: Pin receipt for a large reference / training / baien dataset pinned to IPFS by the religious-corp dataset-pinner. Per ADR-2605241500. Parallels app.etzhayyim.substrate.ipfsPin (which is reserved for MST CAR shards from mst-projector). Readers can resolve `cid` from any IPFS gateway to obtain the original UnixFS tree; the optional `sha256` is an archive-level hash (deterministic tar of staging tree) that lets a consumer verify content independent of the IPFS chunker. Charter Rider §2(a)..(h) scan result (ADR-2605192200) MUST be recorded — pins where `charterRiderScan.passed = false` are NOT allowed and the pinner refuses to emit them.

name.description: Stable dataset name in canonical form, e.g. `HF:HuggingFaceTB/smollm-corpus` or `local:baien-graft-3d-260524`. Together with `revision` uniquely identifies a pin.

revision.description: Upstream revision pin. For HF datasets: the git revision SHA or tag. For HTTP sources: a content etag or capture timestamp. Free-form for `local-import`.

kind.description: Taxonomic bucket for sharding + storage policy.

cid.description: IPFS UnixFS root CID (v1, base32) returned by Kubo `/api/v0/add` (or equivalent provider call).

sizeBytes.description: Total byte size of the pinned tree (sum of leaf sizes, not including IPFS framing overhead).

sha256.description: Archive-level sha256 of a deterministic tar of the staging tree. Optional but recommended for chunker-independent verification.

providers.description: Names of pin providers that confirmed the pin. Production target ≥ 2 distinct providers (replication-factor invariant inherited from ADR-2605171800 Stage 4). Single-provider pins are allowed during bootstrap, marked by `replicationMin: 1` in the manifest row.

assignedNodes.description: DIDs of nodes that MUST hold this CID per the sharding plan. Empty array means unassigned (any node may pin opportunistically).

source.description: How the dataset was obtained upstream.

license.description: SPDX identifier or free-text license string. MUST be compatible with the Charter Compliance Rider (ADR-2605192200); first-party redistribution implies Apache-2.0 + Rider on derivative artifacts.

charterRiderScan.description: Result of pymagatama.organism.sensors.charter_rider.scan() against a deterministic sample of the dataset. Required: pins with `passed = false` MUST NOT be emitted.

manifestRowRef.description: Reference back to the row in `90-docs/baien/datasets.jsonl` that this pin record corresponds to. Either a 1-based line number (string-encoded) or a git blob CID anchor — implementation-defined for Phase 1.

description: Pin receipt emitted by ipfs-pinner after one of mst-projector's shard CAR files has been pinned to ≥1 IPFS providers (Kubo / Pinata / Web3.Storage / Filecoin via Storacha). Per ADR-2605171800 Stage 4. Readers can resolve the pinned CAR by `carCid` from any IPFS gateway and reconstruct the projected MST shard. The original snapshot record (`app.etzhayyim.substrate.shardSnapshot`) carries the MST `rootCid` that this pin's CAR contains as its single root.

shardKey.description: Collection NSID this pin covers, copied from the originating shardSnapshot. e.g. `ai.gftd.apps.threads.post`.

rootCid.description: AT-Protocol MST root CID (v1, dag-cbor) of the shard at the time of CAR flush. Matches the `rootCid` field of the originating `app.etzhayyim.substrate.shardSnapshot` record.

carCid.description: IPFS CID (v1) of the CAR file itself, returned by the pin provider. Identical across providers for a given CAR (deterministic content addressing).

snapshotUri.description: AT URI of the originating `app.etzhayyim.substrate.shardSnapshot` record, when known. Optional in Phase 1 emissions where the pinner subscribes to local CAR files directly rather than via firehose.

providers.description: Names of pin providers that confirmed the pin. Constitutional minimum at production = 2 distinct providers (per README replication factor); single-provider emissions are allowed only when ETZ_PINNER_PROVIDERS = single name and the operator explicitly opted out of redundancy.

byteSize.description: Size of the CAR file in bytes.

blockCount.description: Number of dag-cbor blocks in the CAR (root + unstored MST blocks).

description: L2 anchor receipt emitted by anchor-cron after an MST root has been committed to EtzhayyimAnchor on Base L2. Per ADR-2605171800 Stage 5b. Closes the substrate pipeline: mst-projector (rootCid) → ipfs-pinner (carCid pinned) → anchor-cron (rootHash anchored on Base). The on-chain `Anchored` event carries the same rootHash + ipfsCid; this AT record cross-references that event back to the originating `ipfsPin` record so any third party can trace a shard's full custody chain without trusting a single operator.

shardKey.description: Collection NSID this anchor covers, copied from the originating ipfsPin record. e.g. `ai.gftd.apps.threads.post`.

rootCid.description: AT-Protocol MST root CID (v1, dag-cbor). Matches `app.etzhayyim.substrate.shardSnapshot.rootCid` + `app.etzhayyim.substrate.ipfsPin.rootCid`.

rootHash.description: 0x-prefixed bytes32 = sha256(rootCid as UTF-8 bytes). Primary key in EtzhayyimAnchor.anchors mapping.

txHash.description: 0x-prefixed Base L2 transaction hash of the EtzhayyimAnchor.anchor() call. May be the zero-hash if anchor-cron observed the root was already on-chain from a prior tick and skipped the redundant tx (alreadyAnchored=true).

blockNumber.description: L2 block number at which the anchor landed (or the block of the prior anchor when alreadyAnchored=true).

logIndex.description: Index of the Anchored event in the receipt logs. Defaults to 0 when alreadyAnchored=true (no new event).

chainId.description: EIP-155 chain id. Base mainnet = 8453, Base sepolia = 84532.

contract.description: 0x-prefixed EtzhayyimAnchor contract address on the target chain.

anchorer.description: 0x-prefixed EOA that signed the anchor tx (= msg.sender on-chain). Off-chain DID resolution is the reader's responsibility.

batchSize.description: Informational record count passed to EtzhayyimAnchor.anchor() (block.batchSize on-chain). For substrate-mode anchors this is the originating shardSnapshot.recordCount when known, else 1.

alreadyAnchored.description: True when anchor-cron detected the rootHash was already anchored on-chain from a prior tick and skipped the redundant tx. The receipt still gets recorded so readers see a complete trail.

ipfsPinUri.description: AT URI of the originating `app.etzhayyim.substrate.ipfsPin` record. Required when the anchor was driven by substrate mode; absent when an external integrator submitted the anchor without an ipfsPin record on PDS.

description: Periodic snapshot emitted by mst-projector for one shard (typically one collection NSID). Forward-compatible across Phase 1 (counter-derived snapshotHash + JSON manifest) and Phase 2 (AT-Protocol MST rootCid + CAR file). Readers MUST treat absent `phase` as 1 and prefer `rootCid` over `snapshotHash` when both are present. Per ADR-2605191358 step 5 and ADR-2605191655.

shardKey.description: Collection NSID this snapshot covers. e.g. `app.etzhayyim.murakumo.inferenceJobEvent`.

phase.description: Snapshot scheme version. 1 = JSON manifest + sha-256 hash. 2 = CAR + true MST root CID. Absent ↔ 1 (back-compat).

snapshotHash.description: Phase 1 root identifier: `sha256-<hex>` of canonical-JSON record list. Deprecated when phase=2 emits; dropped in a future cleanup ADR after ≥4 week grace (per ADR-2605191655).

rootCid.description: Phase 2 authoritative root identifier: AT-Protocol MST root CID (v1, dag-cbor). Absent in Phase 1 emissions. Readers SHOULD prefer this when present.

snapshotCid.description: IPFS CID (v1) of the snapshot blob. Phase 1: JSON manifest. Phase 2: CAR v1 file (root + leaf blocks). Optional in Phase 1 emissions if the daemon could not reach the IPFS pin endpoint; required in Phase 2 (per ADR-2605191655).

description: Per-UNSPSC-code policy record consumed by the commodity_process_orchestrator Pregel cell (per ADR-2605231500). Declares what authorization gates fire when an AAT-bound agent at `did:web:c{unspscCode}.etzhayyim.com` initiates a commodity flow. Sparse — most of the 18,346 UNSPSC codes will never need an explicit manifest; the orchestrator uses safe defaults (default purpose `donation-in-kind`, council escalation threshold 0 = always escalate) when no manifest exists. Manifests are authored by Council Stewards (or the Council Lv6+ supermajority for force-sensitive / eros-gore-tagged codes).

unspscCode.description: UNSPSC commodity code (8 digits, leading zeros preserved). Used verbatim as the AT-record rkey for idempotent re-seeding.

bpmnProcessDef.description: Optional AT URI of the BPMN process_def this commodity follows (via Kyber projector per ADR-2605180600 §F). When present, the agent's LangGraph workflow fires BPMN signal `Signal:esign:{purpose}` at the appropriate gate.

defaultPurpose.description: Default `app.etzhayyim.esign.envelope.purpose` for envelopes emitted on flows under this code. MUST be a Charter-aligned commodity purpose.

forceSensitive.description: When true, the charter-compliance gate requires ForceAuthorization.preAttest() to pass (per ADR-2605192315). Applies to dual-use codes: weapons, cryptographic equipment, bio precursors, controlled chemicals.

erosGoreCategory.description: Optional category requiring Council ruling proxy per ADR-2605192400. Empty when not applicable (the vast majority of UNSPSC codes).

councilEscalationThreshold.description: Per-envelope value/count at which the envelope requires Council Lv6+ ≥3 multisig (replacing requester-only signing). 0 = always escalate (i.e., this code is never agent-driven). Phase 1 interpretation: item count. Phase 2 interpretation: USDC-equivalent (6 decimals).

auditWitnessRequired.description: When true, the yobel `audit_witness` cell is invoked for envelopes under this code (3-party witness pattern). Default false.

customsRequired.description: When true, the envelope MUST carry a `customsRef` field referencing the customs declaration record. Required for codes describing physical goods that cross national borders.

chartersAttestationRef.description: Optional AT URI of the most recent `ai.gftd.charters.attest` (or equivalent) covering this code. Snapshotted into the envelope at creation time so Council attestation drift is provable.

description.description: Optional free-text description of this code's commodity scope, why the manifest exists, and any operational notes for the agent.

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the manifest publication.

description: A single witness verdict on a yatachain record's membrane conformance. Produced by a Pregel cell selected via hash(record_cid) % len(fleet.cells) per yatachain SPEC §5. ≥3-of-5 matching attestations (default quorum) make the target record yatachain-L1-witnessed. Per ADR-2605231400.

recordUri.description: AT URI of the record being attested. Format: at://{did}/{collection}/{rkey}.

recordCid.description: Content identifier of the record being attested. Used for membrane evaluation reproducibility and as the input to hash(record_cid) % N_cells witness selection.

cellId.description: Murakumo Pregel cell ID that produced this attestation. Must match an entry in 50-infra/murakumo/fleet.toml cells. Format: PascalCase (e.g., 'TitheRoutingCell', 'CharterAttestationRequestCell').

verdict.description: The cell's verdict on whether the record passes its yatachain-membrane (Lexicon schema + Rego policy + LangGraph determinism check).

reason.description: Free-form reason. Required when verdict is 'reject' or 'escalate'. Audit-grade — surfaced in Council deliberation when escalation fires.

membraneVersion.description: Composite version string for the (Lexicon schema, Rego policy, LangGraph cell code) triple this attestation was computed against. Format: 'lex:{semver}/rego:{semver}/cell:{git-sha-7}'. Enables re-attestation when the membrane evolves.

signature.description: Cell-key signature over canonicalized (recordCid + cellId + verdict + reason + membraneVersion + attestedAt). Verified against the cell's published verification key in fleet.toml. Key rotation cadence: 90 days (fleet.cell_key_rotation_period_days).

quorumGroup.description: The 5-cell selection group this attestation belongs to. Computed as sha256(recordCid)[:16]. All 5 attestations for the same record share the same quorumGroup, enabling quorum collection by primary-key lookup.

escalationTarget.description: Required when verdict is 'escalate'. Names the escalation path: 'council' (Council Lv6+ ≥3 multisig per ADR-2605192300), 'membrane-amendment' (proposed Lexicon / Rego / cell-code change), or 'human-review' (operator intervention).

description: DNA-equivalent (L1, L2, L3) triple manifest for a yatachain-mountable record kind. A record is yatachain-valid only if all three membrane layers (Lexicon schema + Rego policy + LangGraph deterministic cell) accept it. Per yatachain SPEC §4 + ADR-2605231400.

nsid.description: The record kind this membrane rule applies to (e.g., 'app.etzhayyim.maps.building').

schemaRef.description: L1 — Lexicon schema reference. Path to a Lexicon JSON file under 00-contracts/lexicons/ with content hash.

policyRef.description: L2 — Rego policy reference. Path to a Rego module under 00-contracts/policies/ with content hash. Evaluates Charter Rider §2, doctrinal positions, and capability scope.

cellRef.description: L3 — LangGraph cell reference. Path to a Pregel cell directory under 20-actors/magatama/cells/ with content hash of the deterministic step function source. Must be replica-deterministic per yatachain SPEC §7.

quorumSize.description: Number of witness cells to select for each write (Holochain-iso default: 5). Larger = stronger guarantee, more fleet load.

quorumThreshold.description: Minimum number of matching 'accept' attestations required to mark the record yatachain-witnessed (default: 3). Must be ≤ quorumSize and > quorumSize/2 for Byzantine-fault tolerance.

escalationPolicy.description: What to do when quorum is not reached. 'reject' = drop write, surface error to caller. 'council' = escalate to Council Lv6+ ≥3 multisig (ADR-2605192300). 'pending' = retain record as unwitnessed, retry witness selection on a clock.

ciphertextOnly.description: When true, the membrane evaluates the record's envelope (signature, format) only and never decrypts the payload — used for app.etzhayyim.encrypted.* records per ADR-2605181100. The Rego policy and LangGraph cell receive a ciphertext-bytes input rather than the deserialized record.

supersedesNsid.description: If this membrane rule replaces an earlier rule for the same record kind (e.g., schema migration), name the prior rule's NSID. Old attestations remain valid against the prior rule; new writes are evaluated against this rule.

layerRef.description: Reference to a single membrane layer artifact (schema, policy, or cell) by repo-relative path + content hash. Content hash is sha256 of the canonicalized file contents — enables re-attestation reproducibility and membrane version pinning.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the layer artifact.

contentHash.description: sha256 hex digest of the canonicalized layer source. For Lexicon JSON: sorted-keys + LF newlines. For Rego: source as-is. For cell directory: sha256 over the sorted tar of the cell's tracked files.

version.description: Human-readable version label. Semver for schema / policy; git-sha-7 for cell.

description: Optional Base L2 anchor pointer for certified-mail equivalence. References an Anchored event from CheckpointAnchor.sol per ADR-2605171800. Per ADR-2605172200.

chain.description: EIP-155 chain ID. 8453 = Base mainnet; 84532 = Base Sepolia.

contract.description: 0x-prefixed CheckpointAnchor.sol contract address that emitted the Anchored event.

txHash.description: 0x-prefixed 32-byte tx hash on the chain identified by `chain`.

mstRootCid.description: Multibase-encoded CIDv1 of the MST root that included this message at anchor time.

anchoredAt.description: Block timestamp when the Anchored event was emitted.

description: RFC 5322 headers preserved from a bridge-in message to enable threading and audit. Per ADR-2605172200.

messageId.description: Original RFC 5322 Message-ID header value, including angle brackets.

references.description: References header parsed into individual Message-ID values.

receivedChain.description: Ordered list of Received: header hops (closest hop first) for audit. Only hostnames; IPs and timestamps are dropped.

originalFrom.description: Original From: header value as it appeared in the SMTP message.

originalTo.description: Original To: + Cc: header values combined.

subject.description: Original RFC 5322 Subject header (verbatim). Mirrors message.subject but preserved separately for round-trip.

description: Open Email message record. Public-content email-equivalent over atproto MST. Per ADR-2605172200.

from.description: did:plc:... | did:web:... for atproto-native sender, OR smtp:<rfc5322-addr> for bridge-in.

body.description: Inline body (text/plain or text/markdown). For larger bodies, use bodyBlob.

replyTo.description: at-URI of the message being replied to.

threadRoot.description: at-URI of the thread root. Equals replyTo for direct replies; equals the original root for deeper threads.

bridgedBy.description: DID of the SMTP bridge that authored this record. Present only for bridge-in messages.

attestation.description: DKIM/SPF/DMARC verification results. Present only for bridge-in messages.

legacyHeaders.description: RFC 5322 headers preserved for threading. Present only for bridge-in messages.

description: On-chain postage receipt for an openmail message. References a Paid event from Postage.sol on Base L2. Per ADR-2605172200.

txHash.description: 0x-prefixed 32-byte tx hash on the chain identified by `chain`.

chain.description: EIP-155 chain ID. 8453 = Base mainnet; 84532 = Base Sepolia.

contract.description: 0x-prefixed Postage.sol contract address that emitted the Paid event.

messageHash.description: keccak256 of the canonical CBOR encoding of the parent message record with `postage` field elided. Binds this payment to one specific record.

amountUsdc.description: USDC amount paid as a decimal string (e.g. '0.02'). Stored as string for precision.

paidAt.description: Block timestamp when Paid event was emitted.

description: DKIM/SPF/DMARC verification results recorded by an SMTP-in bridge. Per ADR-2605172200.

dkimDomain.description: d= tag from the DKIM-Signature header that produced the verifying signature.

spfMailfrom.description: RFC 5321 MAIL FROM domain used for SPF.

dmarcPolicy.description: p= policy declared by the From-domain DMARC record at evaluation time.

spamScore.description: Bridge-computed spam score; lower = more confident. Bridge-specific scale; clients SHOULD treat <1.0 as clean and >5.0 as likely spam.

main.description: A declaration of a Bluesky chat account.

chatDisabled.description: Set to true when the actor cannot actively participate in conversations

main.title: Direct Messages
main.detail: Send and receive direct messages via Bluesky chat

main.title: Full Chat Client (All Conversations)
main.detail: Control of all chat conversations and configuration management.

rev.description: Rev when the convo was accepted. If not present, the convo was already accepted.

main.description: Adds an emoji reaction to a message. Requires authentication. It is idempotent, so multiple calls from the same user with the same emoji result in a single reaction.

errors.name: ReactionMessageDeleted
errors.description: Indicates that the message has been deleted and reactions can no longer be added/removed.

errors.name: ReactionLimitReached
errors.description: Indicates that the message has the maximum number of reactions allowed for a single user, and the requested reaction wasn't yet present. If it was already present, the request will not fail since it is idempotent.

errors.name: ReactionInvalidValue
errors.description: Indicates the value for the reaction is not acceptable. In general, this means it is not an emoji.

facets.description: Annotations of text (mentions, URLs, hashtags, etc)
Annotations of text (mentions, URLs, hashtags, etc)

commit.description: Represents an update of repository state. Note that empty commits are allowed, which include no repo data changes, but an update to rev and signature.

seq.description: The stream sequence number of this message.

tooBig.description: DEPRECATED -- replaced by #sync event and data limits. Indicates that this commit contained too many ops, or data size was too large. Consumers will need to make a separate request to get missing data.

repo.description: The repo this event comes from. Note that all other message types name this field 'did'.

rev.description: The rev of the emitted commit. Note that this information is also in the commit object included in blocks, unless this is a tooBig event.

since.description: The rev of the last emitted commit from this repo (if any).

blocks.description: CAR file containing relevant blocks, as a diff since the previous repo state. The commit must be included as a block, and the commit block CID must be the first entry in the CAR header 'roots' list.

items.description: List of repo mutation operations in this commit (eg, records created, updated, or deleted).

time.description: Timestamp of when this message was originally broadcast.

sync.description: Updates the repo to a new state, without necessarily including that state on the firehose. Used to recover from broken commit streams, data loss incidents, or in situations where upstream host does not know recent state of the repository.

seq.description: The stream sequence number of this message.

did.description: The account this repo event corresponds to. Must match that in the commit object.

account.description: Represents a change to an account's status on a host (eg, PDS or Relay). The semantics of this event are that the status is at the host which emitted the event, not necessarily that at the currently active PDS. Eg, a Relay takedown would emit a takedown with active=false, even if the PDS is still active.

active.description: Indicates that the account has a repository which can be fetched from the host that emitted this event.

status.description: If active=false, this optional field indicates a reason for why the account is not active.

repoOp.description: A repo operation, ie a mutation of a single record.

prev.description: For updates and deletes, the previous record CID (required for inductive firehose). For creations, field should not be defined.

main.description: Begin provisioning an etzhayyim ERC725 root identity. Returns a digest the caller must sign with their intended activeKey (EOA or smart-wallet-recovered P256 via WebAuthn) and submit to completeRootProvision. Per ADR-2605212030 §D4. Phase α: provisioning is Council-gated; the digest binds to a Council proposal nonce that only Council can finalize.

dwebHandle.description: Public handle of the form `<handle>.etzhayyim.com` — becomes the did:web facade for this root.

activeKey.description: 0x-prefixed 20-byte Ethereum address that will own the new root (EOA or Smart Wallet).

purposeNarrow.description: Optional human-readable purpose statement embedded in the digest for audit.

digest.description: 0x-prefixed 32-byte digest the caller must sign with `activeKey` (EIP-191 personal_sign).

dwebHandleHash.description: 0x-prefixed 32-byte keccak256 of the canonical `dwebHandle`. Provided so the client can verify the digest derivation.

nonce.description: Single-use server nonce, valid for this provisioning attempt only.

expiresAt.description: Unix epoch seconds; the nonce is rejected after this time.

chainId.description: Target chain id (Base mainnet 8453 or Base Sepolia 84532).

contractAddress.description: 0x-prefixed address of the deployed EtzhayyimAuthz contract on the target chain.

errors.description: dwebHandle is not a valid `<handle>.etzhayyim.com` form or contains disallowed characters.

errors.description: dwebHandle is already bound to an existing active root.

errors.name: ActiveKeyInvalid
errors.description: activeKey is not a valid 20-byte 0x-prefixed Ethereum address.

errors.name: ConfigError
errors.description: etzhayyim authz backend is not configured for the requested chain.

main.description: Complete a root-identity provisioning flow started by beginRootProvision. Caller submits the signed digest plus the nonce. Backend verifies signature, gates on Council approval, then submits an EtzhayyimAuthz.provisionRoot transaction on the target chain. Returns the chain tx hash + the assigned rootId. Per ADR-2605212030.

signature.description: 0x-prefixed EIP-191 personal_sign signature (65 bytes r||s||v) of the digest issued by beginRootProvision, signed by the requested activeKey.

txHash.description: Base L2 transaction hash for the provisionRoot call.

errors.name: NonceUnknown
errors.description: nonce does not match any pending provisioning session.

errors.name: NonceExpired
errors.description: nonce was valid but expired before completion.

errors.name: SignatureInvalid
errors.description: signature does not recover to the activeKey declared in beginRootProvision.

errors.name: CouncilApprovalRequired
errors.description: the Council multisig has not yet approved this provisioning request.

errors.name: ChainSubmissionFailed
errors.description: the on-chain provisionRoot transaction reverted; see chainError for detail.

main.description: Return the full provenance chain of an etzhayyim root identity — the active key + all historical key rotations, plus the vendor predecessor link if any. Read directly from EtzhayyimAuthz events on Base L2; clients SHOULD NOT trust off-chain caches without on-chain receipt cross-check. Per ADR-2605212030 §D4.

rotations.description: All RootKeyRotated events in chronological order (earliest first).

vendorPredecessor.description: Present iff this root was created via mirrorVendorRoot.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No root with the supplied rootId exists on the target chain.

main.description: Phase P2 of ADR-2605212030 — mirror a vendor-issued ERC725 root (`did:erc725:gftd:260425:*`) into an etzhayyim root on Base L2. Caller proves control of the existing vendor root by signing a continuity digest with their original vendor signing key. Council verifies the proof off-chain and submits EtzhayyimAuthz.mirrorVendorRoot. Returns the new etzhayyim DID + tx hash. This procedure is opt-in per actor; vendor roots stay valid for historical queries until vendor deprecation.

dwebHandle.description: Public handle to bind to the new etzhayyim root.

newActiveKey.description: 0x-prefixed 20-byte address that will own the new etzhayyim root. MAY be the same as the vendor key or different.

vendorRootDid.description: Full vendor DID being mirrored, e.g. `did:erc725:gftd:260425:0xabc...`.

vendorAddr.description: 0x-prefixed Ethereum address of the vendor signer (EOA or smart-wallet).

vendorContinuityProof.description: 0x-prefixed signature by vendorAddr over `keccak256("etzhayyim-vendor-continuity" || vendorRootDid || dwebHandleHash || newActiveKey)`.

vendorRootHash.description: 0x-prefixed keccak256 of `vendorRootDid` — recorded on-chain in predecessorVendorRootHash.

errors.name: DwebHandleTaken
errors.description: dwebHandle already bound to an active root.

errors.name: VendorContinuityProofInvalid
errors.description: vendorContinuityProof does not recover to vendorAddr.

errors.name: VendorRootUnknown
errors.description: vendorRootDid does not match any known vendor-issued root.

errors.name: CouncilApprovalRequired
errors.description: the Council multisig has not yet approved this mirror request.

errors.name: ChainSubmissionFailed
errors.description: the on-chain mirrorVendorRoot transaction reverted.

main.description: Bidirectional resolution between the two etzhayyim DID surfaces: `did:web:<handle>.etzhayyim.com` and `did:erc725:base:<contract>#<rootIdHex>`. Accepts either form; returns both, plus the activeKey, the active flag, and the vendor predecessor link if any. Per ADR-2605212030 §D2.

did.description: Either `did:web:<handle>.etzhayyim.com` or `did:erc725:base:<contract>#<rootIdHex>`. Exactly one of `did` or `dwebHandle` or `rootId` must be supplied.

chainId.description: Optional. Default Base mainnet (8453). Use 84532 for Base Sepolia.

predecessorVendorRootHash.description: Present iff the root was created via mirrorVendorRoot.

predecessorVendorAddr.description: Present iff the root was created via mirrorVendorRoot.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No active root matches the supplied identifier.

errors.name: InvalidArgument
errors.description: Exactly one of `did` / `dwebHandle` / `rootId` must be provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

createdAfter.description: Filter to verifications created after this timestamp

createdBefore.description: Filter to verifications created before this timestamp

issuers.description: Filter to verifications from specific issuers

isRevoked.description: Filter to verifications that are revoked or not. By default, includes both.

main.description: Revoke previously granted verifications in batches of up to 100.

uris.description: Array of verification record uris to revoke

items.description: The AT-URI of the verification record to revoke.

revokeReason.description: Reason for revoking the verification. This is optional and can be omitted if not needed.

revokedVerifications.description: List of verification uris successfully revoked

failedRevocations.description: List of verification uris that couldn't be revoked, including failure reasons

uri.description: The AT-URI of the verification record that failed to revoke.

error.description: Description of the error that occurred during revocation.
